Its great elevation and the barren country approaching it made travel a demanding undertaking, even when the pass itself was open.
simp_chinese: 喀喇昆仑山脉在塔里木盆地与印度河上游之间构成一道高耸屏障。漫长冰川填满岩石群峰间的谷地，积雪补给山脉两侧的河流。喀喇昆仑山口将拉达克高地与通往叶尔羌的道路相连；即使山口可以通行，极高的海拔与沿途荒地也使旅途十分艰难。

english: The Karakoram rises north of the upper Indus in a vast array of peaks and glaciers. Among its highest mountains is K2, while the great Baltoro Glacier winds between steep walls of rock and ice. Meltwater from the glacier feeds the Braldu and Shigar rivers, tributaries of the Indus. The mountains form a high divide between the Indus basin and the rivers flowing north towards the interior of Asia.
simp_chinese: 喀喇昆仑山脉耸立在印度河上游以北，群峰和冰川绵延广阔。最高峰之一是乔戈里峰；巨大的巴尔托洛冰川在陡峭的岩壁与冰壁之间蜿蜒。冰川融水汇入布拉尔杜河和希加尔河，最终流入印度河。山脉在印度河流域与向北流入亚洲腹地的河流之间形成高耸分水岭。

sources.title: 1970 Geology of the Baltoro Basin by Desio s.pdf

english: The eastern Karakoram rises between Ladakh and the southern approaches to the Tarim Basin. Its high ridges and glaciers feed streams on both sides: some reach the Indus system, while others flow toward the Yarkand River. The Karakoram Pass offered a difficult route between Leh and Yarkand. In 1715 the missionary Ippolito Desideri recorded the mountains and the pass when travelling through Ladakh.
simp_chinese: 喀喇昆仑山脉东段耸立在拉达克与塔里木盆地南部入口之间。高山和冰川滋养两侧的河流：一些汇入印度河水系，另一些流向叶尔羌河。喀喇昆仑山口为列城与叶尔羌之间提供了一条艰险通道。1715年，传教士伊波利托·德西德里经过拉达克时记下了这道山脉及山口。

english:
Karakorum rose on the grassy upper Orkhon, in the old heartland of the Xiongnu, Turkic and Uyghur steppe empires, where Genghis Khan assembled his army in 1218 and his son Ögedei raised walls and the Palace of Myriad Peace in 1235. Here the Great Khans received envoys from Russian princes and the Flemish friar William of Rubruck, who found a walled town with a Muslim quarter and a Chinese one, twelve temples, two mosques and a Nestorian church, and a silver tree that poured wine for the court.

After Khubilai moved the court to Dadu, Karakorum became the seat of the Yuan administration north of the Gobi. Kaidu seized it in 1277, and Yuan troops drove him out the next year. In 1307 it became the seat of the Helin branch secretariat, which in 1312 was renamed Lingbei Province, its route taking the name Heining; and in the 1340s the city was still being rebuilt: the Xingyuan Pavilion stele was carved in 1342, and the great stupa temple was repaired between 1342 and 1346.

The fall of the Yuan in 1368 ended this prosperity. Biligtü Khan held court at Karakorum in 1370, but Ming armies under Li Wenzhong burned its walls in 1372 and returned in 1380. By the early 15th century the city was largely abandoned. In 1585 Abtai Khan raised the monastery of Erdene Zuu beside the ruins, using stone from the old town.
simp_chinese:
哈拉和林兴起于鄂尔浑河上游的草原，是匈奴、突厥、回鹘等草原帝国的旧日腹地。1218年成吉思汗在此集结大军，1235年窝阔台修筑城墙和万安宫。大汗在这里接见罗斯诸公的使者，也接待了佛兰德修士鲁布鲁克：他记下这座有城墙的城市，分设穆斯林和汉人两个居住区，有十二座佛寺、两座清真寺和一座景教教堂，宫中的银树还能向宫廷倾注美酒。

忽必烈迁都大都之后，哈拉和林成为元朝管理漠北的中心。1277年海都攻占此城，翌年被元军逐出。大德十一年（1307年）这里设立岭北行省的前身和林等处行中书省，皇庆元年（1312年）改称岭北等处行中书省，和林路改名和宁路。14世纪40年代城中仍有营建：至正二年（1342年）刻立《兴元阁碑》，1342至1346年间又重修了大佛塔寺。

1368年元朝覆亡，繁荣随之终结。北元的爱猷识理达腊（毕力克图汗）1370年以和林为驻地，但1372年明军李文忠北伐，焚毁了城墙，1380年明军再度攻入。15世纪初这座城市基本荒废。1585年阿巴泰汗在废墟旁建起额尔德尼召，用的就是旧城的石料。

english: Karakoyin is a salt lake on the edge of the Betpak-Dala desert, not far from the Sarysu River. Although the river passes nearby, the lake occupies its own closed basin. Its irregular shoreline encloses a shallow expanse whose area grows after rain, while the surrounding land belongs to the dry desert and steppe of central Kazakhstan. The nearby Koyanzhal sands are also known by the name Karakoyin.
simp_chinese: 卡拉科因是别特帕克达拉荒漠边缘的一座咸水湖，距离萨雷苏河不远。虽然河流从附近经过，湖泊本身却位于独立的内流盆地。曲折的湖岸围绕着浅水区域，降雨后湖面会扩大；周围则是中央哈萨克干燥的荒漠与草原。附近的科扬扎尔沙地也称为卡拉科因。

english: Karakuba Point lies among the Pacific islands and coastal channels off southeastern New Guinea. Communities across this region maintained maritime exchange networks long before European contact. Stone from island sources, including Fergusson, circulated between coastal societies through such maritime connections.
simp_chinese: 卡拉库巴角位于新几内亚东南岸外的岛屿和水道之间。与欧洲人接触之前，这一地区的社群早已维持海上交换网络。包括弗格森岛在内的岛屿石材通过这些联系在沿岸社会之间流通。

english: Karakul is an enclosed lake high in the eastern Pamirs, set within a great circular impact basin. A peninsula from the south and an island near the northern shore separate its shallow eastern water from a western basin more than two hundred metres deep. Rivers bring water to the lake, but none flows out; evaporation leaves its waters saline.
simp_chinese: 卡拉库尔湖是东帕米尔高处的一座内流湖，坐落在巨大的环形撞击盆地内。南岸伸出一处半岛，北岸附近有一座岛屿，将浅水的东部湖区与深逾二百米的西部湖盆分开。河流注水入湖，却没有河流流出；水分蒸发后，湖水含有盐分。

english: The northern Karakum lies south of the Khwarazm oasis and the lower Amu Darya. Its sands form part of a vast desert extending westwards toward the Caspian, while the river and its delta support a very different landscape to the northeast. Rainfall is scarce across the Karakum, and the northern Trans-Unguz section rises above the lower central desert.
simp_chinese: 卡拉库姆沙漠北部位于花剌子模绿洲和阿姆河下游以南。沙地属于向西延伸至里海方向的广大沙漠；东北方的河流与三角洲则养育截然不同的景观。卡拉库姆降雨稀少，北部外温古兹地区高于沙漠中部低地。

english: The central Karakum is a broad expanse of sand in the dry interior north of the Kopet Dag. Dunes and sparse vegetation extend across the low-lying desert, while the irrigated settlements along its margins depend on water brought from the mountains and rivers. Rain is scarce in this part of Central Asia, and the desert separates the inhabited foothills from the distant lower Amu Darya.
simp_chinese: 卡拉库姆中部是科佩特山以北干旱腹地中的广大沙地。沙丘与稀疏植被延伸于低洼沙漠，边缘的灌溉聚落则依赖山地和河流带来的水。中亚这一地区降雨稀少，沙漠隔开了有人居住的山麓与遥远的阿姆河下游。

english: The Karakum stretches across the dry interior west of the Amu Darya. In its southeastern reaches, sandy ground and salt marshes lie beyond the cultivated oases of the Murghab. Rain is scarce, and the desert presents a sharp contrast to the fields watered by rivers descending from the mountains. Across its expanse, low dunes and open spaces separate the river valleys and their settlements.
simp_chinese: 卡拉库姆沙漠横亘在阿姆河以西的干旱内陆。其东南部的沙地和盐沼，位于穆尔加布河灌溉绿洲之外。这里降雨稀少，与依靠山地河流供水的田野形成鲜明对比。沙漠中的低矮沙丘与开阔地带，将各条河谷及其聚落隔开。

english:
Around Merv, the southern Karakum was the dry margin of a river-fed oasis rather than a landscape with an immovable boundary between field and sand. The Murghab spread into the desert, and the inhabited area depended on channels carrying its water to cultivated ground. Across the late medieval and early modern centuries, maintaining or breaking these works could change where people were able to settle.

In the eighteenth century warfare made this dependence particularly visible. Forces sent by Nadir's brother Ibrahim Khan broke the dam to force Merv's fortress to surrender, leaving the town short of water and driving away much of its population. After proclaiming himself shah in 1736, Nadir brought cultivators into the region and repaired irrigation channels. In 1785 the ruler of Bukhara, Shah Murad, captured Merv, destroyed its dam and transferred inhabitants to Bukhara. Changes to the river's course reshaped the oasis margin. Sarik, Teke and Salor Turkmen subsequently became prominent inhabitants of the surrounding country. The history of these desert approaches was inseparable from waterworks, displacement and the changing reach of cultivation.
simp_chinese:
木鹿周围的南部卡拉库姆是河流绿洲的干旱边缘，田地与沙地之间并没有一条永不变动的界线。穆尔加布河在荒漠中分流，人居地带依赖沟渠向耕地供水。中世纪后期至近世，水利设施的维护或破坏，都可能改变人们能够定居耕作的位置。

十八世纪战争尤其显露出这种依赖。纳迪尔之弟易卜拉欣汗所率军队破坏水坝，迫使木鹿堡城投降，也使城市缺水，大批居民离去。1736年称沙阿以后，纳迪尔迁入耕作者并修复灌渠。1785年，布哈拉统治者沙阿穆拉德攻取木鹿，毁坝并将居民迁往布哈拉。河道变化也重塑了绿洲边缘，萨雷克、特克、萨洛尔等土库曼部族随后成为周边地区的重要居民。荒漠通道的历史因而与水利、迁徙及耕地范围的变化紧密相连。

english: East of the Merv oasis the sands of the Karakum stretch across the plains of Central Asia. The Murghab River descends from the mountains and disperses into an inland delta, allowing fields and successive cities to flourish amid the desert. Beyond the watered oasis, dunes and dry ground form a very different landscape. The contrast between river-fed cultivation and the surrounding sands has shaped the position of Merv and the routes that pass through it.
simp_chinese: 木鹿绿洲以东，卡拉库姆沙漠的沙地横亘在中亚平原上。穆尔加布河从群山流下，散入内陆三角洲，使田地和历代城市得以在沙漠中兴盛。灌溉绿洲之外，沙丘与干燥土地呈现出截然不同的景象。河水滋养的农田与周围沙海之间的反差，塑造了木鹿的位置和穿越此地的道路。

english:
The Karakum near Merv formed the dry surroundings of an oasis sustained by the Murghab River. Cultivation depended on the division and control of water, while settlement was concentrated where channels could carry it across the delta. The relationship between irrigated ground and neighbouring desert made damage to hydraulic works a direct threat to the survival of communities.

In the later eighteenth century, the struggle between Merv's Qajar rulers and Shah Murad of Bukhara transformed this landscape. Shah Murad's campaigns culminated in the destruction of the oasis's irrigation system and the removal of many inhabitants toward Bukhara. Historical sources differ over the exact dating of the dam's destruction within the 1780s, but agree on its importance to the collapse of cultivation and settlement. The consequences extended beyond a fallen town: the interruption of water reshaped the oasis margins, changing the boundary between productive land and the Karakum that surrounded it.
simp_chinese:
木鹿附近的卡拉库姆，是穆尔加布河滋养的绿洲周围的干旱地带。耕作取决于水量的分配与控制，聚落则集中在渠道能够将水引入三角洲的地方。灌溉土地与邻近沙漠的关系，使水利工程受损直接威胁社群生存。

十八世纪后期，木鹿卡扎尔统治者与布哈拉沙阿·穆拉德之间的斗争改变了这片景观。沙阿·穆拉德的征战最终摧毁绿洲灌溉体系，并将许多居民迁往布哈拉。史料对十八世纪八十年代毁坝的具体年份存在分歧，却共同显示其对耕作和聚落衰败的重要影响。后果超出一座城市的陷落：供水中断重塑了绿洲边缘，改变了可生产土地与周围卡拉库姆之间的界限。

english: Karamergen was a medieval settlement in the old delta of the Ili, south of Lake Balkhash. It stood on a route between the Ili valley and eastern Turkestan, at the edge of the desert and the river's wooded channels. Irrigation supported agriculture here, while the river and lake offered fish. The town flourished between the ninth and thirteenth centuries, when the delta formed a northern frontier of settled life in Zhetysu.
simp_chinese: 卡拉蔑尔干是伊犁河古三角洲中的中世纪聚落，位于巴尔喀什湖以南。它坐落在伊犁河谷通往东突厥斯坦的道路上，处于沙漠与河流林木水道的边缘。灌溉支持农业，河湖则提供鱼类。九至十三世纪，城镇在七河地区定居农业的北缘繁盛。

english:
Karamoja is a dry plateau of grasslands and volcanic hills, where rainfall is uncertain and cattle are central to life. Households combine cultivation with herding, moving animals to find pasture during the dry season. Livestock provide food and wealth, while ties between families help people manage herds and their movements.

Historians place the arrival of Ateker-speaking herders and farmers on the plateau around the sixteenth century. Their descendants include the Jie, Dodoth and Karimojong, the latter comprising the Matheniko, Bokora and Pian. Over the following centuries communities formed, divided and joined one another as people migrated and married. Among the Jie, political communities took shape around the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries; negotiation and reconciliation were important ways of ending conflicts between neighbours.
simp_chinese:
卡拉莫琼是一片干燥高原，草地与火山丘陵交错，降雨不稳定，牛群是生活的中心。家庭将种植与放牧结合，旱季时迁移牲畜寻找草场。牲畜提供食物和财富，家庭之间的关系也帮助人们管理牛群及其迁徙。

历史学家认为，操阿特克尔语的牧民和农民约在十六世纪来到这片高原。他们的后裔包括杰伊人、多多特人和卡拉莫琼人，后者又分为马特尼科、博科拉和皮安等群体。此后数百年间，人们迁徙、通婚，社群随之形成、分裂和联合。杰伊人的政治社群在十七世纪末至十八世纪初逐渐成形；谈判与和解是结束邻人之间冲突的重要方式。

english: Karang Brahi stands in the inland river country of Sumatra, on the upper Merangin, a tributary of the Batang Hari system. A stone inscription found here preserves an early Malay text connected with Srivijaya. Similar inscriptions at Palembang and Kota Kapur show how the rulers of that maritime power expressed their authority in several places during the late seventh century. The Karang Brahi stone is evidence that Srivijaya's political and cultural reach extended far into the hinterland of Jambi, along the rivers that connected the interior with the coast.
simp_chinese: 卡朗·布拉希位于苏门答腊内陆河谷，靠近巴当哈里水系支流默朗因河的上游。此地发现的石刻保存了一篇与室利佛逝有关的早期马来语铭文。巨港和邦加岛哥打卡普尔也有类似铭文，显示这个海上政权的统治者在七世纪末如何于不同地点宣示权威。卡朗·布拉希石刻说明，室利佛逝的政治与文化影响曾沿着连接内陆和海岸的河流深入占碑腹地。

english: The southern Cook Islands stand amid broad stretches of Pacific water. Mangaia, one of the group's southernmost islands, is surrounded by a raised coral rim and coastal reef. James Cook sighted Mangaia in 1777, when Polynesian communities had long inhabited the island and maintained connections across the surrounding seas.
simp_chinese: 南库克群岛坐落在广阔的太平洋水域中。芒艾亚是群岛最南部岛屿之一，岛屿周围有隆起珊瑚环和海岸礁石。詹姆斯·库克于1777年见到芒艾亚，当时波利尼西亚社群早已居住岛上，并与周围海域保持联系。

english: Karangan lies in eastern Borneo, near the western end of the Mangkalihat peninsula. The Karangan River flows through the area toward Sangkulirang Bay, opening a route from inland country to the sea. Nearby rises the Sangkulirang-Mangkalihat karst, a landscape of limestone hills and caves. Rivers cut through and around these formations, gathering water from the forested interior before reaching the bays and coastal lowlands of the island's eastern shore.
simp_chinese: 加朗岸位于婆罗洲东部，靠近芒卡利哈特半岛西端。加朗岸河穿过这一地区流向桑库里朗湾，形成一条从内陆通往海洋的水道。附近的桑库里朗—芒卡利哈特喀斯特地带分布着石灰岩丘陵与洞穴。河流穿过或绕过这些地貌，汇集森林内陆的水，最终抵达岛屿东岸的海湾和沿海低地。

english: Karangpurru country lies in the Victoria River region of the Northern Territory, between neighbouring Aboriginal homelands. River valleys and wooded country connect the tropical north with the drier interior. The Karangpurru are one of the language-defined groups with long connections to this part of northern Australia.
simp_chinese: 卡朗普鲁人的土地位于北领地维多利亚河地区，处在邻近原住民家园之间。河谷与林地将热带北部和更干旱的内陆连接起来。卡朗普鲁人是与澳大利亚北部这一地区有长久联系的语言群体之一。

english: Karanka refers to the Karanqas, also written Carangas or Karankas, an Aymara polity of the Bolivian high plateau. Its core territory belonged to Qullasuyu under Inca rule. Spanish colonization reorganized communities into concentrated settlements called reducciones, while tribute and the Potosí mining labour draft placed heavy demands on their inhabitants. Carangas became a colonial corregimiento, divided into districts including Totora, Sabaya and Urinoca. Silver discoveries within Carangas brought some renewed activity in the mid-seventeenth century, but did not remove the burdens of compulsory service. Eighteenth-century changes also weakened the links between highland communities and their Pacific-valley enclaves as Spanish and Creole estates expanded. Resistance ranged from avoiding colonial obligations to open revolt, including the Llanquera rising of 1732 and participation in the upheavals of 1781.
simp_chinese: 卡朗卡对应卡兰卡斯，亦写作 Carangas、Karankas，是玻利维亚高原上的艾马拉政治群体。其核心地域在印加统治下属于科利亚苏尤。西班牙殖民当局将居民重组进称为 reducciones 的集中聚落，贡赋与波托西矿业劳役又给当地带来沉重负担。卡兰卡斯成为殖民行政区，下分托托拉、萨瓦亚、乌里诺卡等地域。十七世纪中叶，当地发现银矿，带来一定的新活动，却没有消除强制劳役的压力。十八世纪，随着西班牙人与克里奥尔人的地产扩张，高原群体同太平洋河谷飞地之间的联系进一步削弱。抵抗既包括逃避殖民义务，也包括公开起义，例如1732年的扬克拉起事，以及参与1781年的动荡。

english:
The Karankawa lived along the Gulf Coast of Texas, from Galveston Bay to Corpus Christi Bay. Several coastal groups shared their language and a way of life shaped by the shallow waters between the mainland and the barrier islands. Families moved seasonally, hunting and gathering as well as fishing, and travelled through the bays in dugout canoes large enough to carry their possessions.

In 1685 La Salle established Fort St. Louis near Matagorda Bay. Conflict followed, and Karankawa warriors attacked the remaining French settlers in 1689. Spanish authorities later founded missions and a presidio in the region, but their efforts to settle coastal peoples met resistance. War broke out in 1779 after Joseph María freed Karankawa families from Mission Rosario. Despite several Spanish campaigns, the conflict continued until a peace was negotiated around 1790.
simp_chinese:
卡兰卡瓦人生活在得克萨斯湾岸，从加尔维斯敦湾延伸至科珀斯克里斯蒂湾。几个沿海群体使用共同的语言，生活与大陆和沙洲岛之间的浅水密切相连。各家族随季节迁徙，狩猎、采集和捕鱼，乘坐能装下家当的独木舟穿行于海湾。

1685年，拉萨尔在马塔戈达湾附近建立圣路易堡。冲突随之而来，1689年卡兰卡瓦战士袭击了余下的法国定居者。西班牙当局后来在此建立传教站和要塞，试图让沿海居民定居，却遭到抵抗。1779年，何塞·玛丽亚从罗萨里奥传教站解救卡兰卡瓦家庭后，战争爆发。西班牙人多次出兵，冲突仍持续至1790年前后达成和平。

english:
Karapınar grew around an Ottoman roadside foundation between Konya and Ereğli. A register of May 1560 described the site as a ruined village. Prince Selim, later Sultan Selim II, promoted its revival through a mosque complex and incentives for Türkmen settlement. About 120 households received exemption from specified extraordinary taxes. The settlement also became known as Sultaniye after its royal foundation.

Buildings alone did not secure a lasting population. In 1568–1569, water was brought roughly fifty-five kilometres from Ovacık on Karacadağ to supply the complex and five town fountains. The foundation included an inn, bath, shops and dyehouse, providing services for residents and passing travellers. A 1579 order called for surplus artisans from Niğde and Aksaray, including farriers, butchers, grocers, bakers and tailors, to settle here. Yet some residents repeatedly returned to villages and summer pastures; officials threatened to cancel exemptions and recover unpaid taxes from those who would not remain.
simp_chinese:
卡拉珀纳尔围绕科尼亚与埃雷利之间的一处奥斯曼沿路设施发展起来。1560年5月的官府登记仍称这里为一处荒废村址。后来成为塞利姆二世的王子塞利姆，通过修建清真寺建筑群和鼓励土库曼人定居来恢复聚落；约一百二十户获得指定临时赋税的减免。因这项王室营建，城镇也被称为苏丹尼耶。

建筑并未立即带来稳定人口。1568至1569年，一条约五十五公里长的水道将卡拉贾山奥瓦哲克的水引到建筑群，并供给镇内五座水泉。驿馆、浴场、商铺和染坊则服务居民及过路旅客。1579年的命令要求尼代和阿克萨赖将富余的钉蹄匠、屠户、杂货商、面包师与裁缝等迁来。然而，一些居民仍反复返回村庄及夏季牧场；官府于是威胁取消不常住者的免税资格，并追征此前未缴的税款。

english: The Karapotó are an Indigenous people of northeastern Brazil, associated with the country around São Sebastião in Alagoas. Their homeland lies inland from the Atlantic coast, in a region of rivers, forest and cultivated land between the coast and the São Francisco basin. The Karapotó form part of the diverse Indigenous peoples whose communities have endured the long history of settlement and land conflicts in the northeast.
simp_chinese: 卡拉波托人是巴西东北部的原住民族，与阿拉戈斯的圣塞巴斯蒂昂一带相联系。他们的家园位于大西洋海岸内陆，地处沿海与圣弗朗西斯科流域之间，河流、森林和耕地交错。卡拉波托人是东北部众多原住民族之一，其社区经历了当地长期的殖民定居和土地冲突。

english: The Karas country of southern Namibia is a dry upland of mountains, plains and seasonal river courses. The Great Karas Mountains rise above the surrounding arid landscape, while farther south the Fish River cuts through a deep canyon. Nama-speaking communities have long inhabited this part of southern Africa.
simp_chinese: 纳米比亚南部的卡拉斯地区是由山地、平原和季节性河道组成的干旱高地。大卡拉斯山脉高出周围荒地，更南方的菲什河则切出深邃峡谷。讲纳马语的社群长期居住在非洲南部的这片土地上。

english:
Karasahr, the ancient Yanqi, stands on the Kaidu River west of Lake Bosten, at the northern edge of the Tarim Basin. The river and the lake sustain a fertile oasis amid the surrounding dry country. Once known as Ārśi or Agni, the town was an important stop on the northern branch of the Silk Road. Buddhist communities flourished in the old kingdom, whose people spoke a language now known as Tocharian A.

From the thirteenth century the oasis belonged to the Mongol Chagatai realm. Its Turkic name, Karasahr, means Black City, and reflects the changing languages of the Tarim Basin. Islam became increasingly influential as older religious traditions receded. The town remained linked to neighbouring oases by the routes skirting the Taklamakan, while the Kaidu continued to supply the fields and the lake beyond them.
simp_chinese:
喀喇沙尔即古焉耆，位于博斯腾湖以西的开都河畔，处在塔里木盆地北缘。河流与湖泊在干旱地区维系着富庶绿洲。古城又称阿尔希或阿耆尼，是丝绸之路北道的重要一站；古代王国曾盛行佛教，居民使用的语言今称吐火罗语 A。

十三世纪起，这片绿洲属于蒙古察合台的势力范围。突厥语地名喀喇沙尔意为黑城，反映了塔里木盆地语言的变化。伊斯兰教影响逐渐增长，较早的宗教传统则日渐衰落。绕过塔克拉玛干沙漠的道路继续连接邻近绿洲，开都河则为田地和下游湖泊提供水源。

english: Karasay lies on the western Kazakh steppe, east of Lake Shalkar-Karashatau. The lake's irregular shoreline is fringed with reeds, and its broad waters offer a resting place for migrating geese. Lesser white-fronted and red-breasted geese use the lake and the neighbouring steppe during their autumn journeys across Kazakhstan.
simp_chinese: 卡拉赛位于哈萨克斯坦西部草原，在沙尔卡尔—卡拉沙套湖以东。湖岸曲折，芦苇沿岸生长，宽阔水面为迁徙的雁群提供休憩之地。小白额雁和红胸黑雁秋季穿越哈萨克斯坦时，会利用这座湖泊及附近草原。

english:
Karasjok grew beside the winding Kárášjohka within the Sámi district of Ávjovárri. Reindeer herding expanded during the seventeenth century, connecting inland winter grazing with summer pastures nearer the coast. Seasonal movements crossed older community boundaries and the competing jurisdictions of northern kingdoms. The frontier treaty of 1751 placed this country under Danish-Norwegian sovereignty, while its accompanying arrangements addressed the continuing movements of Sámi herders.

A more concentrated settlement developed alongside this mobile landscape. Log buildings for a priest and bailiff appeared in the district in 1730. A burial ground was established at Karasjok in 1766 and consecrated the following year; a timber meeting house followed in 1777–1778. The church built in 1807 gave the river settlement a lasting religious center. An account of a visit in 1827 described it among houses, hayracks and the storehouses of mountain Sámi, on a peninsula formed by the river's bends. These details show a community where settled households and the needs of people moving between seasonal grazing grounds met beside the same waterway.
simp_chinese:
卡拉绍克沿蜿蜒的卡拉什河发展，属于萨米人的阿夫约瓦里地区。十七世纪，驯鹿牧业逐渐扩大，将内陆冬牧场与较近海岸的夏牧场连接起来。季节迁徙跨越旧有社群边界，也穿过北方诸国相互竞争的管辖区。1751年的边界条约将这里划归丹麦—挪威，其配套安排也处理萨米牧民继续迁徙的问题。

沿河逐渐集中的定居点，与这种流动生活并存。1730年，地区内出现供牧师及行政官使用的木屋。卡拉绍克于1766年设置墓地，次年祝圣，1777至1778年又建起木制集会堂。1807年建成的教堂，使河边聚落有了长久的宗教中心。1827年的来访记述写到，教堂坐落在河湾形成的半岛上，周围是房屋、晾草架及山地萨米人的仓房。定居家庭与往来季节牧场的人群，由此在同一水道旁相互联系。

english: Karasor belongs to the salt-lake country of the Kazakh steppe, south of the Irtysh basin. Shallow depressions collect water without draining to the sea; evaporation leaves saline flats among the surrounding grasslands. The steppe around these basins forms part of the wide inland landscape between the hills of central Kazakhstan and the West Siberian Plain.
simp_chinese: 卡拉索尔属于哈萨克草原上的盐湖地带，位于额尔齐斯河流域以南。浅洼地积水而不通向海洋，蒸发后在周围草地间留下盐滩。这些湖盆所在的草原，是哈萨克中部丘陵与西西伯利亚平原之间广阔内陆景观的一部分。

english: Karasu lies in the Turgay steppe near the Aksuat lakes, part of the Naurzum lake system. Fresh and saline waters punctuate the grasslands and attract migrating birds, including whooper swans and geese. In wetter years the lakes are also gathering places where ducks and swans moult; during drought some basins retain water after others have dried.
simp_chinese: 卡拉苏位于图尔盖草原，靠近属于瑙尔祖姆湖群的阿克苏阿特湖。淡水和咸水湖泊点缀草地，吸引大天鹅与雁类等候鸟。水量充沛的年份，鸭与天鹅在湖区聚集换羽；干旱时，部分湖盆仍能在其他湖泊干涸后保有积水。

english: The Karasu-Aras Mountains stretch eastward across the Armenian Highlands from the Erzurum country towards the lands west of Mount Ararat. Their ridges divide a high landscape of basins and valleys, with the country of Doğubayazıt to the south and Iğdır to the north. Mountain steppe, woodland and alpine vegetation occupy different elevations of the surrounding plateau. Across this high country the rivers of the upper Euphrates and the Aras run towards distant seas on opposite sides of the watershed.
simp_chinese: 卡拉苏—阿拉斯山脉横贯亚美尼亚高地，从埃尔祖鲁姆一带向东延伸至亚拉腊山以西。山脊分隔着高地盆地和谷地，多乌巴亚泽特地区位于南侧，厄德尔位于北侧。周围高原的不同海拔分布着山地草原、林地和高山植被。在这片高地上，幼发拉底河上游与阿拉斯河分属不同水系，最终流向遥远的海洋。

english: The Kara-Suu runs through the mountains of Aksy towards the Naryn River. Its valley is cut between steep slopes, with cascades and boulders in the stream and high lakes in the surrounding ranges. Sary-Chelek lies among the mountains to the west. The Kara-Suu joins the Naryn near Tash-Kömür, carrying water from the high country into the larger river system.
simp_chinese: 哈剌苏河流经阿克西山区，向纳伦河而去。河谷切入陡峭山坡之间，溪流中可见乱石与瀑流，周围山地还有高山湖泊。萨雷切莱克湖位于西面的群山中；哈剌苏河在塔什库梅尔附近汇入纳伦河，将高地水流带入更大的水系。

english: Karatobe lies in the steppe east of the lower Ural, in a landscape crossed by the valleys of the Kaldygayty and Buldyrty rivers. These watercourses traverse a wide, dry country of grassland and shallow depressions. The lower Ural and its neighbouring steppe formed part of the grazing grounds of nomadic peoples, whose movements and livelihoods depended on the seasonal availability of pasture and water.
simp_chinese: 卡拉托别位于乌拉尔河下游以东的草原地带，附近分布卡尔德盖特河与布尔德尔特河的河谷。这些水道穿过广阔干燥的草原和浅洼地。乌拉尔河下游及相邻草原曾是游牧民族的放牧地区，其迁徙与生计依赖牧草和水源随季节的变化。

english: Karatobe is placed in the dry Mangyshlak country east of the Caspian Sea. A necropolis of the same name lies in the Mangystau region. Water sources and seasonal pasture were important to movement through the wider arid region. The Karatobe necropolis stands near a small prominent hill and contains more than two hundred monuments. Its traditional grave markers include carved stones and mausoleums, with examples from the sixteenth century onward, preserving local traditions of commemoration.
simp_chinese: 喀拉托贝位于里海以东干旱的曼格什拉克地区。曼格斯套境内有一处同名墓地。水源和季节性牧场对于整个干旱地区的迁徙十分重要。喀拉托贝墓地位于一座显眼的小丘附近，拥有二百余处纪念建筑。传统墓葬包括雕刻墓石和陵墓，其中一些可上溯到十六世纪，保存着地方的纪念传统。

english: Karatung belongs to the Nanusa Islands, a small group northeast of the main Talaud Islands. These islands lie in the open waters between Sulawesi and the southern Philippines. Raised coral islands and wooded shores mark this northern end of the Talaud chain. The sea separates Karatung from its neighbours, but also places it among the island passages that connect the wider archipelago.
simp_chinese: 卡拉通属于纳努萨群岛，位于塔劳主群岛东北方。这些小岛坐落在苏拉威西与菲律宾南部之间的开阔海域中。隆起的珊瑚岛与林木覆盖的海岸构成塔劳岛链北端的景观。大海将卡拉通与邻岛隔开，也使它处于连接广大群岛的海上通道之间。

english: The Kara-Turgay flows through the steppe of central Kazakhstan and joins the river system of the Turgay. Its waters descend from the uplands into a broad inland drainage, where rivers and lakes are scattered across a dry landscape. The Turgay basin stretches between the Mugodzhar hills to the west and the central uplands to the east, with no outlet to the ocean.
simp_chinese: 卡拉图尔盖河流经哈萨克中部草原，汇入图尔盖河水系。河水从高地流向广阔的内陆流域，河流与湖泊散布在干燥地带。图尔盖流域介于西方穆戈贾尔山丘与东方中部高地之间，没有通向海洋的出口。

english:
Karau belongs to the river country east of the Barito in southern Borneo. The Karau River, passing the district around Ampah, descends from the Kasali hills, part of the wider Meratus uplands, toward the Barito system. This identifies a river corridor and its surrounding country rather than a securely dated early town. The region is associated with Maanyan communities whose settlements occupied waterways and inland higher ground.

For the centuries before 1837, local subsistence is best understood through the older combination of field cultivation, hunting and forest products recorded in the area's history. Rivers connected settlement sites and made the wooded interior accessible, while differences between upland slopes and low country shaped the land available for cultivation. The long presence of Maanyan communities gives Karau a more specific setting than a general description of all Borneo. However, surviving local summaries do not establish a sequence of rulers, a foundation year or particular early battles here. The historical landscape is therefore one of Maanyan settlement and production along a Barito tributary, with the river linking forested hills and lower agricultural country.
simp_chinese:
卡劳属于婆罗洲南部巴里托河以东的河流地区。流经安帕一带的卡劳河发源于卡萨利山地，后者属于更广大的梅拉图斯山系，再向巴里托河水系流去。这里首先可以确定为河流走廊及其周边土地，尚不能据此确认一座具有确切建城年代的早期城镇。该地区与马安延社群相关，其居民点沿水道及内陆较高土地分布。

对于1837年以前的数百年，地方史所记载的传统组合（旱地耕作、狩猎和利用林产品）提供了较可靠的生计背景。河流连接聚落，使森林内陆可以通行；坡地与低地的差异则影响适宜耕作的土地分布。马安延社群的长期存在，使卡劳具有超出泛指整个婆罗洲的地方特征。不过，现有地方史摘要不能建立这里历任统治者的序列、建城年份或具体古代战事。其历史景观因而应理解为巴里托河支流沿线的马安延定居与生产活动，水道把森林山地和下游农耕地区相连。

english:
Karauli was a Rajput capital in eastern Rajasthan. Official district histories date its foundation to Arjun Deo in 1348. Its rulers belonged to the Yaduvanshi lineage, whose association with Krishna also shaped royal religious patronage. Palace buildings and temples together gave the capital a ceremonial landscape in which dynastic authority and devotion were closely connected.

The city developed further under Gopal Singh II in the eighteenth century. District histories credit him with enlarging the palace, improving roads and fortifications, and constructing the Madan Mohan temple. Royal building thus joined defence and government to a major centre of Krishna worship. The palace itself combined an earlier foundation with substantial eighteenth-century reconstruction. Karauli's rulers also faced the changing balance of power around Rajasthan, including the pressure of Maratha expansion. In 1817 the state entered a treaty relationship with the East India Company. By the early nineteenth century, Karauli retained its ruling house and court while its external position had become tied to British power.
simp_chinese:
卡劳利是拉贾斯坦东部的拉其普特都城。官方地方史将建城年代定为1348年，建立者为阿尔琼·德奥。统治家族属于雅杜王族，其与黑天相联系的世系观念，也影响王室宗教赞助。宫殿与寺庙共同构成都城的礼仪景观，将王朝权威和信仰紧密联系起来。

十八世纪戈帕尔·辛格二世时期，城市进一步发展。地方史将扩建宫殿、改善道路和防御设施，以及修建马丹莫汉寺归于他。王室营造因此兼顾防卫、统治和黑天崇拜，宫殿也在较早基础上经历十八世纪的大规模重建。卡劳利君主同时面对拉贾斯坦周边力量变化与马拉塔扩张的压力。1817年，邦国同东印度公司缔结条约；到十九世纪前期，王室与宫廷仍在，其对外地位已与英国势力相联系。

english: Karawala lies near the mouth of the Río Grande de Matagalpa on Nicaragua's Caribbean coast. The river crosses a low plain of pine savanna before reaching the sea, with broadleaf forest and mangroves nearby. The name belongs to an Ulwa community whose people came down the river from the interior. Waterways and wetlands distinguish this coast from the mountainous country through which the river begins its journey.
simp_chinese: 卡拉瓦拉位于尼加拉瓜加勒比海岸，靠近马塔加尔帕格兰德河口。河流穿过松树林稀树草原低地后入海，附近还有阔叶林和红树林。这里的名称属于乌尔瓦人的一个社群，其居民从内陆沿河而下。水道与湿地构成这片海岸的特点，有别于河流发源的山地。

english:
Karbala is one of the great shrine cities of Shiite Islam. It grew around the tomb of Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of the Prophet Muhammad and son of Ali, who was killed here with his companions in 680. Pilgrims visit his shrine and that of his half-brother Abbas, while the memory of their deaths is renewed in the mourning rituals of Ashura. Canals from the Euphrates bring water to a city close to the edge of the desert.

The shrines drew the patronage of rulers as well as pilgrims. During the contest between the Safavids and Ottomans for Iraq, Shah Ismail visited in 1508, and the Ottoman sultan Suleiman also made gifts after his conquest of Baghdad in 1534. A further period of Safavid rule in the seventeenth century brought building and embellishment. By the eighteenth century Karbala had become a leading centre of Shiite learning, attracting scholars and students from Iran and elsewhere.

In 1802 forces of the first Saudi state attacked the city. They killed many inhabitants and plundered the shrine of Husayn, taking treasures accumulated through generations of donations. The assault left a lasting mark on the holy city. Karbala's religious standing nevertheless continued to draw visitors to the tombs and to the institutions of learning that had grown around them.
simp_chinese:
卡尔巴拉是什叶派伊斯兰教的重要圣城之一。城镇围绕先知穆罕默德之孙、阿里之子侯赛因·伊本·阿里的陵墓发展；他与同伴于680年在此遇害。朝圣者拜访他的陵墓以及其异母兄弟阿拔斯的陵墓，并在阿舒拉哀悼仪式中重温他们遇难的记忆。幼发拉底河引出的水渠为沙漠边缘附近的城市供水。

圣地吸引统治者与朝圣者的赞助。萨法维王朝与奥斯曼帝国争夺伊拉克期间，沙阿伊斯玛仪于1508年来此朝拜；奥斯曼苏丹苏莱曼在1534年征服巴格达后也向圣地献礼。十七世纪再次处于萨法维统治下时，陵墓得到扩建与装饰。到十八世纪，卡尔巴拉成为什叶派学术重镇，吸引伊朗及其他地方的学者和学生。

1802年，第一沙特国的军队袭击城市，杀害许多居民并洗劫侯赛因陵墓，夺走世代捐献积累的珍宝。这次袭击给圣城留下深刻印记。尽管如此，卡尔巴拉的宗教地位继续吸引访客前来陵墓和其周围发展起来的学术机构。

english:
Karcag was a Cuman town in the Nagykunság whose privileges survived only through repeated struggles. Ottoman warfare devastated the settlement after the battle of Mezőkeresztes in 1596; rebuilding began around 1618–1620. Further Crimean Tatar attacks brought burning and captivity in the late seventeenth century.

In 1702 Leopold I sold the Jászkun districts to the Teutonic Order, compromising the inhabitants' cherished freedoms. The communities eventually redeemed their lands and rights, and Maria Theresa confirmed their restored privileges in her charter of 6 May 1745. These included choosing local officials and clergy and exemption from seigneurial obligations. Karcag also asserted its religious life through construction: work on a larger Reformed church began in 1743 despite official obstruction. That church was completed in 1756, then rebuilt in 1793–1797, giving the recovering town a substantial new place of worship.
simp_chinese:
考尔曹格是大库曼地区的一座库曼人城镇，其特权在反复的冲突中艰难延续。1596年迈泽凯赖斯泰什战役后，奥斯曼战争摧毁了聚落，约至1618至1620年才开始重建。十七世纪末，克里米亚鞑靼人的袭击又带来焚掠和人口被俘。

1702年，利奥波德一世将亚斯—库曼各区出售给条顿骑士团，损害了居民珍视的自由。各地后来赎回土地与权利，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚在1745年5月6日的特许状中确认恢复其特权，包括选举地方官员和牧师、免除领主义务。宗教建设也体现了城镇的坚持：居民在官府阻挠下于1743年动工兴建更大的归正宗教堂。教堂1756年完工，1793至1797年再次重建，为逐渐恢复的城镇提供了一座规模可观的礼拜场所。

english: Karcha Kala, also called Bolat-Kala, stands on a steep rock above the Cherek-Balkarsky valley. Built in the twelfth or thirteenth century, the fortress formed part of a chain of defences overlooking the mountain settlements below. Its front wall had narrow openings from which defenders could watch the valley. Local tradition associates it with the Alanic ruler Bolat. According to Timur's chroniclers, his army stormed a fortress held by a ruler named Pulad after he refused to surrender a fugitive; the defenders' homes were burned and the stronghold was not rebuilt.
simp_chinese: 卡尔恰卡拉又称博拉特卡拉，坐落在切列克—巴尔卡尔河谷上方的陡峭岩石上。这座建于十二或十三世纪的堡垒是山地防御体系的一部分，俯瞰谷中的聚落。正墙开有狭窄射孔，守军可从中监视河谷。当地传统将堡垒与阿兰统治者博拉特联系起来。帖木儿的编年史记载，一位名叫普拉德的统治者拒绝交出逃亡者，帖木儿军队遂强攻他的堡垒，焚毁守卫者的居所；堡垒此后未再重建。

english: The Kardakan is a stream of the forested country east of the Yenisei, recorded among the rivers of the Yenisei Ridge. Its valley lies within the great Siberian taiga, where streams cut through wooded hills and feed larger rivers. The waterways freeze in the long winter and carry meltwater during the short spring thaw.
simp_chinese: 卡尔达坎河是叶尼塞河以东森林地带的一条溪流，列于叶尼塞岭的地名记录之中。河谷位于广阔的西伯利亚泰加林中，溪流切穿森林丘陵，补给更大的河流。水道在漫长冬季封冻，短暂春季融化期输送雪水。

english: Karditsa stands on the western Thessalian plain, where the cultivated lowlands approach the mountains of Agrafa. The settlement grew under Ottoman rule and served as a place of exchange between the plain and the uplands. The English traveller William Martin Leake recorded it in 1810; by that time it was already a trading centre on the route between these regions. Plague struck in 1821, leaving the town severely depopulated during the years of the Greek uprising.
simp_chinese: 卡尔季察坐落在色萨利平原西部，耕作低地在这里接近阿格拉法山地。聚落在奥斯曼统治时期发展，成为平原与高地之间的交换地点。英国旅行者威廉·马丁·利克于1810年记述此城；当时它已是两地交通路上的贸易中心。1821年瘟疫袭来，使希腊起义期间的城镇人口锐减。

english: Karé lies in the dry Sahelian country near Bassikounou, on the southeastern side of the Aoukar basin. Sandstone escarpments, or dhars, frame the basin, and shallow depressions hold water after the seasonal rains. Such pools and wells sustain herds in a landscape of sparse woodland and grass. Along the dhar country towards Néma and Bassikounou, camel herding has long been an important part of pastoral life.
simp_chinese: 卡雷位于巴西库努附近的干旱萨赫勒地区，在奥卡尔盆地东南侧。被称为达尔的砂岩断崖环绕盆地，季节性降雨之后，浅洼中会积存水分。在树木和草丛稀疏的地带，这些水洼和水井供养着牲畜。沿通往内马和巴西库努的断崖地带，骆驼放牧长期是牧业生活的重要部分。

english: Karee lies near the Indwe River, in the mountainous country south of the Stormberg. North of Indwe, a spur of the Drakensberg separates the valleys of the Doorn and Waschbank rivers. Grassy uplands give way westward to the more open Karoo, where isolated ridges and flat-topped hills rise above the plains. The Stormberg itself extends eastward from the Bamboesberge, forming an outlying part of the great Drakensberg chain.
simp_chinese: 卡里位于因德韦河附近、斯托姆山脉以南的山地。因德韦以北，德拉肯斯山脉的一道支岭分隔多恩河与瓦施班克河谷。长满草的高地向西过渡为更开阔的卡鲁，孤立山脊和平顶山从平原上升起。斯托姆山脉由班布斯山向东延伸，是德拉肯斯山系的一处外围山岭。

english:
White Karelia's forest country preserved a rich tradition of runosong, carried by singers whose knowledge passed through families and communities. In the early nineteenth century, collectors crossed into this country seeking poems that remained alive in oral performance. The journeys linked remote villages with the developing literary culture of Finland, while exposing the difference between a singer's repertoire and a book assembled from many voices.

Elias Lönnrot began making collecting journeys in 1828 and reached White Sea Karelia during subsequent expeditions. In 1834 he met Arhippa Perttunen, one of the singers whose extensive knowledge contributed to his work. Lönnrot combined collected poems into the first published Kalevala in 1835. The resulting epic was an editorial composition built from oral materials, rather than a single ancient text found intact in the forest. For the inner Karelian taiga, this history belongs to the wider village world around it, where remembered songs connected local lives with an emerging national literature.
simp_chinese:
白卡累利阿的森林地域保存着丰富的鲁诺歌传统，歌者通过家庭与社群传承知识。十九世纪初，采集者来到这里，寻访仍在口头演唱中的诗歌。这些行程把偏远村落连接到芬兰正在发展的文学文化，也显出歌者曲目与汇集多种声音成书之间的区别。

埃利亚斯·伦罗特自1828年起展开采集旅行，后来多次到达白海卡累利阿。1834年，他遇见阿尔希帕·佩尔图宁，其广博歌谣知识成为编纂材料的一部分。伦罗特将所收诗歌组合，1835年出版首版《卡勒瓦拉》。史诗因此是以口传材料编成的作品，并非在森林中完整发现的古籍。这段历史属于内卡累利阿针叶林周围的村落世界，地方记忆由歌声进入新兴的民族文学。

english:
Inner White Karelia is a country of forest, lakes and marshes west of the White Sea. Its wooded interior contained inhabited villages and a rich oral culture. A particularly well-documented encounter came in 1834, when Elias Lönnrot visited Latvajärvi and listened to the Karelian singer Arhippa Perttunen. The songs preserved in such communities became important material for Lönnrot's literary work.

In the autumn of that year he travelled to Repola in search of further additions to his manuscript. The Finnish Literature Society published the first Kalevala in 1835, drawing on the collecting journeys of its secretary. Lönnrot returned to White Sea Karelia that spring and gathered another 103 songs, amounting to approximately 4,500 lines. These journeys reveal a forest region connected through singers, travellers and the transmission of verse. The epic was an edited literary composition based on oral poetry; its mythical events cannot be read as a dated chronicle of the surrounding taiga.
simp_chinese:
内白卡累利阿位于白海以西，由森林、湖泊和沼泽构成。林地内部有居民村落，也保存着丰富的口头文化。1834年，埃利亚斯·伦罗特来到拉特瓦耶尔维，听取卡累利阿歌手阿尔希帕·佩尔图宁演唱，留下了记载清楚的一次相遇。这些社群传承的歌谣成为他编写文学作品的重要材料。

当年秋季，他又到列波拉寻找补充手稿的内容。芬兰文学学会依据其首任秘书的采集旅程，于1835年出版第一版《卡勒瓦拉》。同年春天，伦罗特重访白海卡累利阿，另获103首、约4500行歌谣。这些旅程呈现出林区通过歌手、旅人与诗歌传承相互联系的一面。史诗是依据口头诗歌编辑形成的文学作品，其中的神话事件不能直接当作周围针叶林地区的纪年史。

english: The Karen Hills form the southwestern edge of the Shan highlands, a country of forested ridges and steep valleys. They join a broader chain of uplands extending towards the Dawna and Tenasserim ranges. Tropical and subtropical forests cover much of the slopes, while rivers cut through the mountain country on their way to the lowlands. The high ground separates the plains of central Burma from the valleys farther east.
simp_chinese: 克伦丘陵构成掸邦高地的西南边缘，山脊林木茂密，谷地陡峭。丘陵与向丹老、道纳山脉延伸的更大高地相连。热带和亚热带森林覆盖许多山坡，河流穿过山地流向低地。高地将缅甸中部平原与更东面的河谷隔开，连绵山岭构成了掸邦高原向南延伸的一部分。

english: The Karen Hills run south from the Shan Plateau in a succession of wooded ridges and valleys. Their forests belong to the same broad mountain region as those of the Dawna and Tenasserim ranges farther south. Streams descend from the slopes through a warm and humid landscape, while the high ground separates the central Burmese plains from the country towards the Salween. Limestone and granite contribute to the varied terrain of the range.
simp_chinese: 克伦丘陵自掸邦高原向南延伸，林木覆盖的山脊与河谷相继排列。这里的森林与更南方道纳和丹老山脉的森林同属广阔的山地地带。溪流从山坡流下，穿过温暖湿润的土地；高地则将缅甸中部平原与萨尔温江方向的地区隔开。石灰岩和花岗岩共同形成多样的地形。

english: The Karen Hills rise in southeastern Burma as a southern extension of the Shan highlands. Forested mountains and steep valleys stretch towards the Dawna range, forming a broad belt of upland country. Nattaung, the highest peak of the Karen Hills, rises above the surrounding ridges. The region supports tropical and subtropical mountain forests, with streams descending through the valleys towards the lowlands.
simp_chinese: 克伦丘陵是掸邦高地向南延伸的山地，耸立在缅甸东南部。森林山岭和陡峭河谷向道纳山脉方向展开，构成一条广阔的高地带。丘陵最高峰纳当山高出周围山脊；热带与亚热带山地森林覆盖其间，溪流沿谷地流向低地。

english: Forested mountains and steep valleys fill the Karen country west of the northern Thai basins. The ridges form part of the highlands between the Salween watershed and the lands around Chiang Mai. Tropical forests cover much of this rugged terrain, while streams cut through the hills towards the Salween and its tributaries. Karen communities inhabit parts of these mountains alongside other peoples of the borderland.
simp_chinese: 泰北盆地以西的克伦地区遍布森林山岭和陡峭河谷。这些山脊属于萨尔温江流域与清迈周边地区之间的高地。热带森林覆盖了大部分崎岖地形，溪流穿过山丘，汇向萨尔温江及其支流。克伦社群与边地的其他民族共同生活在这些山地的一部分。

english: Karendo lies on the Coronda River south of Santa Fe, in the lowlands of the Paraná basin. The settlement took its name from the Indigenous people of the area, whose presence preceded Spanish occupation. In 1664 Melchor Martínez received possession of land south of the stream now known as the Coronda, an event associated with the establishment of the later town. River channels and floodplains connect this shore with the greater Paraná.
simp_chinese: 卡伦多位于圣菲以南的科隆达河畔，地处巴拉那河流域低地。聚落以当地原住民命名，他们在西班牙人占据之前便已生活于此。1664年，梅尔乔尔·马丁内斯取得现称科隆达河的水道以南土地，这一事件与后来城镇的建立有关。河道和泛滥平原将这里的河岸连接到更大的巴拉那河。

english: Kargaly lies in the Kurti basin north of the Trans-Ili Alatau. The Uzyn Kargaly descends from the mountains, fed by glacier and snowmelt as well as rain. Its flow is strongest from spring into summer, when meltwater reaches the lower country. The river joins other streams of the Kurti system as they cross the dry plain towards the Ili.
simp_chinese: 卡尔加雷位于外伊犁阿拉套山以北的库尔特河流域。乌曾卡尔加雷河从山中流下，由冰川、融雪和雨水补给。春季至夏季融水抵达下游时，河流流量最大。河水与库尔特水系的其他河流汇合，穿过干燥平原流向伊犁河。

english: Kargaly is a river of the western Kazakh steppe, flowing into the Ilek near the site of Aktobe. Its waters join a network of tributaries draining the western spurs of the Mugodzhar hills. The Ilek itself continues towards the Ural, carrying the drainage of this dry inland country westward. Along these valleys, the channels stand out against the open land around them.
simp_chinese: 卡尔加雷河位于哈萨克西部草原，在阿克托别所在地附近汇入伊列克河。它属于排泄穆戈贾尔山西侧支脉的支流网络；伊列克河继续向乌拉尔河流去，将这片干旱内陆的水流带向西方。河谷中的水道在周围开阔的土地上清晰可辨。

english:
Kargapolye grew beside the Miass in the Trans-Ural country. The settlement was first known as Kargapolova, taking its name from the Kargapolov family. Records of the late seventeenth century place members of that family in the neighbouring Tersyutskaya settlement, part of the movement of Russian households into the river country east of the Urals.

By 1730, the village had a parish and its first wooden church, dedicated to St Nicholas. The church made Kargapolskoye a religious centre for its surrounding rural community. A replacement church followed in the later eighteenth century, with a side altar consecrated in 1780 and the principal altar in 1796. In 1805, the village became the centre of a volost within Shadrinsk district of Perm province. Parish organisation and local administration consequently accumulated at the same riverside settlement. Its early history belongs to the gradual formation of a rural centre, as a family-named village acquired a church and then responsibility for the government of neighbouring communities.
simp_chinese:
卡尔加波利耶在外乌拉尔的米阿斯河畔发展，最初名为卡尔加波洛娃，取自卡尔加波洛夫家族。十七世纪后期的记录，已将该家族成员置于邻近特尔休茨卡亚聚落，属于俄国居民向乌拉尔以东河流地域迁居的一部分。

到1730年，村内设立教区并兴建第一座木教堂，奉圣尼古拉为主保，使卡尔加波利斯科耶成为周边乡村社群的宗教中心。十八世纪后期又有新堂取代旧堂，附属祭坛于1780年祝圣，主祭坛则于1796年祝圣。1805年，村庄成为彼尔姆省沙德林斯克县属乡的行政中心。教区组织与地方行政由此逐渐汇聚于同一河岸聚落，一个以家族命名的小村，先获得教堂，再承担治理附近社群的职责。

english:
Kargasok first appears in archival records in 1640, but that date is not a securely established foundation year. The district's historical account considers the settlement to have existed earlier among the Selkup people, with Russian newcomers subsequently settling beside them. It interprets the Selkup name Kargasok as Bear Cape and also points to the Indigenous name of the Panigatka River as evidence of this older setting.

The early village stood on the small, navigable Panigatka rather than at the later Ob landing. This distinction matters when following its history: the shift toward the more convenient Ob bank belongs mainly to the nineteenth century after the period described here. The district account recalls settlers trying wheat, rye and barley on poor soils, while floodplain pasture, fishing and forest resources offered other means of support. Its earliest dated mention thus marks the appearance of an already inhabited river locality in surviving written records, rather than the beginning of human occupation.
simp_chinese:
卡尔加索克最早见于档案的时间是1640年，但这并不能确定为建村年份。地方政府的历史介绍认为，当地此前已有塞尔库普人聚落，后来到来的俄罗斯人逐渐在旁定居。该介绍将卡尔加索克这一塞尔库普语地名解释为“熊岬”，也以帕尼加特卡河的原住民名称说明更早的地方背景。

早期村庄位于可以通航的小河帕尼加特卡岸边，与后来鄂毕河畔的码头聚落有别。向较便利鄂毕河岸迁移的过程，主要发生在这里所述年代之后。地方史还回忆移民曾尝试种植小麦、黑麦和大麦，贫瘠土壤限制了收获，河漫滩草场、渔业和森林资源则提供其他生计。1640年的记录因此标志一个已有居民的河流聚落进入现存文献，而不能视作人类活动的起点。

english:
The Kargat River crosses the low Baraba country of western Siberia before joining the Chulym and the Lake Chany drainage. Forest, steppe and wetlands meet across this broad plain, where waterways and seasonal conditions have long shaped movement. In the eighteenth century Russian expansion brought fortified posts and roads through the region, linking the settlements of western Siberia with those farther east.

One of these posts stood on the Kargat. A regional history dates its relocation from Ubinsk to 1746, although the precise founding year is not established consistently in surviving accounts. Its garrison guarded travellers and settlers using the Moscow–Siberian road across the Baraba steppe. The old post, remembered in the name Forpost-Kargat, and the later town of Kargat belong to the same river district but should not be treated as a single unchanging settlement. The road drew the area into a wider network of transport and supply: horses, provisions and river crossings became practical concerns for officials, travellers and the communities along the route.
simp_chinese:
卡尔加特河穿过西西伯利亚低平的巴拉宾地区，汇入楚雷姆河，并属于恰内湖内流盆地。森林、草原与湿地在广阔平原上交错，河流和季节变化长期影响着人们的出行。十八世纪，俄国向西伯利亚扩张，在这一带修筑道路和驻防据点，将西部聚落与更东面的地区连接起来。

卡尔加特河畔就设有一处前哨。地方历史资料将其从乌宾斯克迁来的时间定为1746年，但现存说法对确切建置年份并不完全一致。驻军负责保护穿过巴拉宾草原、沿莫斯科—西伯利亚大道行进的旅人和移民。旧前哨的名字保留在福尔波斯特—卡尔加特村名中；它和后来发展的卡尔加特城同属这一河流地区，却并非始终不变的同一聚落。道路使当地融入更广阔的运输与补给网络，马匹、粮食和渡河地点都成为官员、行旅与沿线居民需要考虑的实际问题。

english:
Kargil lies within the western Himalayan country historically called Purig, which also included the Suru valley, Pashkum, Chiktan, Mulbekh and neighboring districts. Authority was divided among several small ruling houses rather than held by a single enduring regional capital. Traditions and chronicles describe contests among Sot, Chiktan and Pashkum, with the rulers of Leh and Skardu intervening in their affairs. In the seventeenth century Sengge Namgyal of Ladakh extended his power into parts of Purig, while Balti and Mughal forces contested that advance.

A more firmly dated transformation began in the summer of 1834, when Gulab Singh of Jammu sent Zorawar Singh to conquer Ladakh. His army approached through Kishtwar and Zanskar and met resistance at Sankoo in the Suru valley. Winter halted the campaign near Pashkum, and fighting resumed the following spring. Salaam Khan, remembered as Sot's last independent ruler, lost his kingdom but was subsequently employed as an administrator. The conquest bound Kargil's political fortunes more closely to Leh and Jammu, replacing the older competition among local dynasties with a new military authority.
simp_chinese:
卡吉尔位于西喜马拉雅历史上称为普里格的地区，这一地域还包括苏鲁河谷、帕什库姆、奇克坦、穆尔贝克及邻近地带。权力分属于几个小型统治家族，并未长期集中在同一座区域首府。传统与编年记述了索特、奇克坦和帕什库姆之间的竞争，列城与斯卡杜的统治者也介入其中。十七世纪，拉达克的僧格南嘉向普里格部分地区扩张，巴尔蒂和莫卧儿军队则抵抗这一推进。

1834年夏季开始了一次年代更为明确的转变。查谟的古拉布·辛格派佐拉瓦尔·辛格征服拉达克，军队经基什特瓦尔和赞斯卡尔前进，在苏鲁河谷的桑库遭遇抵抗。冬季使战事停顿于帕什库姆附近，次年春天重新交战。被记为索特最后一位独立君主的萨拉姆汗失去邦国，后来又受任处理地方行政。征服使卡吉尔的政治命运更紧密地同列城和查谟联系起来，新军事权威取代了较早地方王朝间的竞争格局。

english:
Kargilik, also known as Yecheng, lies on the southern edge of the Tarim Basin, where routes from the Kunlun Mountains meet the chain of desert oases. Mountain water supported fields, orchards, and settlement, making irrigation central to local life. Travelers moving between Yarkand, Khotan, and southern mountain approaches relied on these cultivated places for supplies and rest. The contrast between productive land and surrounding aridity gave water management particular economic and political importance.

The wider oasis region belonged to the Yarkand Khanate in the early modern period and later came under Qing rule. The administrative history of the modern county should not be assumed to describe the settlement at every earlier date. Its cultivated land connected the southern Tarim oases with routes towards the mountains, while water remained essential to everyday life.
simp_chinese:
喀格勒克又称叶城，位于塔里木盆地南缘，昆仑山道路在此同沙漠绿洲链相接。山地来水支持田地、果园和聚落，灌溉因而居于生活核心。往来叶尔羌、和田及南部山间通道的旅人，依赖这些耕作地点补给休息。绿地与周边干旱环境形成鲜明对比，使水利具有重要经济和政治意义。

近代早期，绿洲所在的广大地区属于叶尔羌汗国，后来归入清朝统治。现代县域的行政沿革不能直接视为聚落在各个早期年代的历史。当地耕地连接塔里木南缘绿洲与通往山地的道路，而水源始终是日常生活的基础。

english:
Kargopol stands on the Onega near its outlet from Lake Lacha, at a meeting of routes through the forests of the Russian North. Merchants brought salt from the White Sea coast upstream, while traders from Vologda and Beloozero came to buy it for markets farther south. Stone churches rose above a prosperous town whose reach extended from the lake country to the sea.

In 1447 Dmitry Shemyaka sought refuge at Kargopol during his struggle with Grand Prince Vasily II. As Moscow absorbed the northern lands, the town became an important commercial centre. Charters granted its merchants privileges in the salt trade: salt from Pomor works was carried to Kargopol, weighed and sold onward. The Nativity Cathedral, begun in 1552, expressed the wealth and standing of the town in the sixteenth century. During the Time of Troubles Kargopol’s wooden fort withstood assaults by Polish-Lithuanian forces in December 1612, although the settlement outside its walls was burned. Further attacks followed in 1614. The town later suffered another disaster when a fire in 1765 destroyed much of its housing and storehouses. Its surviving churches and river setting recall both the wealth of northern commerce and the hazards faced by the community that sustained it.
simp_chinese:
卡尔戈波尔坐落在拉恰湖流出奥涅加河的地方附近，是俄罗斯北方森林中多条道路的交会点。商人从白海沿岸将盐逆流运来，沃洛格达和别洛奥泽罗的商人则在此购盐，销往更南方的市场。繁荣城镇中石教堂高耸，其联系从湖泊地区一直延伸到海边。

1447年，德米特里·舍米亚卡在与大公瓦西里二世的斗争中逃到卡尔戈波尔避难。莫斯科吞并北方土地后，城镇成为重要商业中心。敕书赋予当地商人盐业贸易特权：波莫尔盐场的盐运抵卡尔戈波尔后称重，再转卖出去。1552年动工的基督诞生主教座堂体现了十六世纪城镇的财富与地位。动乱时期，卡尔戈波尔的木堡于1612年十二月抵御波兰立陶宛军队多次进攻，但城墙外聚落被烧毁。1614年又有袭击。此后城镇再遭灾难：1765年的火灾毁去大部分住宅和仓储建筑。留存的教堂与河流地理环境令人想起北方贸易的财富，也让人记得维系贸易的社区所面临的危险。

english: Karhumägi lies on the northern shore of Lake Onega, amid the forests and waterways of Karelia. A village grew here in the seventeenth century, and a factory operated there in 1703–1710 and again in 1766–1769. The surrounding country belonged to a region long connected with Novgorod; in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, Karelia became known for the wooden buildings of its villages and churches.
simp_chinese: 卡胡马吉位于奥涅加湖北岸，四周是卡累利阿的森林与水道。十七世纪时，这里出现了一座村落；1703年至1710年以及1766年至1769年，村中曾有工厂运作。周围地区长期与诺夫哥罗德保持联系。到了十六至十七世纪，卡累利阿村庄和教堂的木建筑逐渐兴盛，成为这片地区的鲜明特色。

english: Karia lies in the hills inland of the Benguela coast, in the highland country of central Angola. Old maps of the region place a chiefdom bearing the name Karia among the neighbouring Sumbi and other communities. Farther inland, the old polity of Kulembe is remembered in accounts of the plateau and in the political traditions of nearby peoples. The highlands were home to a number of distinct authorities before Portuguese influence extended beyond the coast.
simp_chinese: 卡里亚位于本格拉海岸内陆的丘陵，属于安哥拉中部高地。该地区的旧地图将名为卡里亚的酋邦与邻近的松比等社区并列。更远的内陆，高原记载和邻近各族的政治传统中还保存着古老的库伦贝政权的名称。葡萄牙势力越过海岸向内陆扩展之前，高地上已有多个各自独立的权力中心。

english: Kariîó lies on the sheltered coast of Santa Catarina, at the inlet once known as Enseada das Garoupas. Indigenous people inhabited this coast before Portuguese settlement, and the name recalls the Carijó. Settlers from the Azores later came to occupy the area. In 1824 Porto Belo became a parish, and in 1832 the settlement was raised to the status of a town, taking the name Vila de Porto Belo.
simp_chinese: 卡里奥位于圣卡塔琳娜州一处受海岸保护的湾口，旧称加鲁帕斯湾。葡萄牙人定居之前，原住民已生活在这片海岸；地名使人想起卡里若人。后来，来自亚速尔群岛的移民来到这里。1824年，波尔图贝卢设立教区；1832年，聚落升格为镇，名为波尔图贝卢镇。

english: Karikkode lies near Thodupuzha in the hilly country of central Kerala. Its Bhagavathy temple is associated with the rulers of Vadakkumkoor, who held the surrounding region before the expansion of Travancore. Local tradition tells of a Vadakkumkoor raja whose devotion brought the goddess of Kodungallur to this shrine. Nearby, old defensive earthworks recall the boundary between Vadakkumkoor and the neighbouring kingdom of Thekkumkoor, two small states that shared the inland country behind the Malabar coast.
simp_chinese: 卡里科德位于喀拉拉中部多山地带，靠近托杜普扎。当地薄伽梵蒂神庙与瓦达昆库尔统治者有关，他们在特拉凡哥尔扩张前统治周围地区。当地传说称，一位瓦达昆库尔拉贾虔诚祈祷，将科东加卢尔女神请到这座神庙。附近的古老防御壕沟令人想起瓦达昆库尔与邻国泰昆库尔之间的边界；这两个小邦共同占据马拉巴尔海岸背后的内陆地带。

english: Karima's Nile-side country is closely associated with the ancient ruins beneath Jebel Barkal. The temples and pyramids predate the period considered here by many centuries. Egypt's conquest of Sudan in 1820–1821 brought travellers accompanying or following the army to this part of the Nile. George Waddington and Barnard Hanbury visited Jebel Barkal in December 1820. Frédéric Cailliaud followed in February 1821, while Linant de Bellefonds and Alessandro Ricci came that October. Further documented visits included George Hoskins in 1833 and John Lowell with Charles Gleyre in 1835. Their descriptions and drawings preserved evidence of monuments later damaged or lost.
simp_chinese: 卡里玛的尼罗河畔地域与杰贝勒巴尔卡勒山下的古代遗址密切相连。神庙和金字塔远早于本时期。1820至1821年埃及征服苏丹，随军或循军队路线而来的旅行者到达这一河段。乔治·沃丁顿和巴纳德·汉伯里于1820年12月到访巴尔卡勒山；弗雷德里克·卡约于1821年2月前来，利南·德·贝勒丰与亚历山德罗·里奇则于当年10月抵达。随后有明确记录的来访者包括1833年的乔治·霍斯金斯，以及1835年的约翰·洛厄尔和查尔斯·格莱尔。他们的描述与图画保存了后来受损或散失的古迹信息。

sources.title: Sudan Holy Mountain Jebel Barkal and its Temples.pdf

english:
The Karimata Islands stood within the maritime approaches to western Borneo. Their eighteenth-century history included the movement of displaced political followers as well as ordinary navigation and trade. In 1765 Raja Musa, a son of a deposed ruler of Siak, settled there with followers after conflicts in his homeland. He lived at Kampong Srunai on Karimata Besar, while a commander established Kampong Siak on Serutu.

These settlements exacted tolls from passing vessels under threat, demonstrating how control of an island base could turn maritime movement into revenue. Other residents had different occupations. Chinese families at Kampong Palembang on Karimata Besar engaged in fishing and blacksmithing. In 1808 they were moved to the Kalimantan coast for reasons that remain uncertain, and Orang Laut under Badin Galang occupied the vacated settlement. The island waters therefore belonged to a changing social and political landscape in which migration, skilled work, coercive toll collection and the occupation of coastal villages were closely connected.
simp_chinese:
卡里马塔群岛位于婆罗洲西部的海上通路中。十八世纪历史不仅包括日常航行与贸易，也包括失势政治集团的迁移。1765年，锡亚克一位被废统治者之子拉惹·穆萨，在家乡冲突后率追随者定居群岛。他居住于大卡里马塔岛的斯鲁奈村，一名部将则在瑟鲁图岛建立锡亚克村。

这些聚落以威胁手段向过往船舶征收通行费，显示控制岛屿基地如何将海上移动转化为收入。另一些居民从事不同工作：大卡里马塔岛巴邻旁村的华人家庭捕鱼、打铁。1808年，他们因尚不明确的原因迁到加里曼丹海岸，巴丁·加朗率领的海人随后占据空出的聚落。因此，群岛水域属于不断变化的社会政治景观，移民、技术性劳动、强制征税与沿海村落的占用在其中紧密相连。

english:
Karimata Strait connects the South China Sea and Java Sea between Sumatra and Borneo. Its waters form part of a wider maritime region linking Malay ports, Java and western Borneo's river mouths. Navigation depends on knowledge of weather, currents and shallow waters.

During the early modern centuries, sultanates, river rulers and commercial centres held influence across the wider region. Portuguese control of Melaka and the growth of Johor and Dutch company power changed trading relationships. Merchants operated across the claims of different states.
simp_chinese:
卡里马塔海峡位于苏门答腊与婆罗洲之间，连接南海和爪哇海。它属于连接马来港口、爪哇和西婆罗洲河口的广大海洋地区，航行需要了解天气、洋流和浅水。

近代早期，广大地区的苏丹国、河流统治者和商业中心各具影响。葡萄牙控制马六甲及后来柔佛、荷兰公司势力的增长改变了贸易关系。商人跨越不同政权的主张开展活动。

english:
Karimata Strait is the broad passage between western Borneo and Belitung, linking the South China Sea with the Java Sea. Islands, reefs and shoal water broke up the crossing, while monsoon winds affected the routes that sailing ships could safely use. The strait carried traffic between the ports of Java, the Malay world and the southern approaches to China.

Its strategic importance became especially clear in 1811, when Britain prepared to invade Dutch-held Java. Sailing from Malacca, the expedition could either pass through Karimata or take a longer northeastern route around Borneo and through Makassar Strait. Stamford Raffles recommended Karimata, and Governor-General Lord Minto accepted despite objections from some naval officers. About one hundred vessels carrying roughly eleven thousand troops departed Malacca during 11–18 June. They reached Java's coast on 30 July, six weeks after Minto and Raffles had sailed. The passage thus served both older maritime exchange and a major imperial campaign. The voyage demonstrated that seasonal judgement and knowledge of a navigable route could turn a broad, island-strewn sea into a direct connection between military bases.
simp_chinese:
卡里马塔海峡是婆罗洲西部与勿里洞岛之间的宽阔通道，连接南海和爪哇海。岛屿、暗礁与浅水打断开阔海面，季风则影响帆船能够安全选择的路线。海峡承载爪哇港口、马来世界和中国南方海路之间的交通。

1811年英国准备进攻荷兰控制的爪哇时，这条通道的战略价值格外明确。从马六甲出发，远征船队可以穿过卡里马塔，也可以绕婆罗洲北部、再经望加锡海峡，走更长的东北航路。斯坦福·莱佛士主张采用卡里马塔，总督明托勋爵在部分海军军官反对下接受建议。约一百艘船载着约一万一千名士兵，于6月11日至18日间离开马六甲，7月30日抵达爪哇海岸，正是明托和莱佛士启航六周后。海峡因而既承载较早的商业往来，也成为一次重大帝国战役的航路。季节判断与航道知识，使岛屿散布的宽阔水域成为军事基地之间的直接联系。

english: The Karipuna of the upper Madeira are a Kawahiva people of the southwestern Amazon. They speak a Tupi-Guarani language related to those of neighbouring Uru-Eu-Wau-Wau and other Kawahiva communities. Their historical territory includes the Mutum-Paraná and its tributaries, as well as the country of the Jacy-Paraná, a region of rivers and forest west of the upper Madeira.
simp_chinese: 上马德拉河的卡里普纳人是亚马孙西南部的卡瓦希瓦民族。他们使用的图皮－瓜拉尼语言与邻近乌鲁埃乌瓦乌瓦乌人及其他卡瓦希瓦社区的语言相近。其历史领地包括穆通－巴拉那河及其支流，也包括雅西－巴拉那河一带；这些河流与森林位于上马德拉河以西。

english: Kariri refers here to Indigenous communities of the São Francisco hinterland, not to one centralized kingdom. In the late seventeenth century Portuguese expansion brought cattle routes, missionary settlements and new demands on Indigenous land and labour. Jesuit and Capuchin missionaries worked among different Kariri-speaking groups and recorded their languages while pursuing conversion. A manuscript by Bernard of Nantes, dated 1702, describes a Kariri mission on the São Francisco. In the wider Bahia hinterland, Ludovico Vincenzo Mamiani's Kiriri catechism of 1698 and grammar of 1699 grew out of exchanges with Indigenous speakers. Their categories were shaped by evangelization, yet they preserve traces of local knowledge.
simp_chinese: 这里的卡里里指圣弗朗西斯科河腹地的原住民群体，不代表一个统一集权的王国。十七世纪后期，葡萄牙势力向内陆扩张，带来赶牛路线、传教聚落，以及对原住民土地和劳力的新需求。耶稣会与嘉布遣会传教士在不同的卡里里语群体中活动，在推动改宗的同时记录语言。南特的贝尔纳1702年留下的手稿，描述了圣弗朗西斯科河上的一处卡里里传教站。巴伊亚腹地的马米亚尼于1698年出版卡里里语教理问答，1699年完成语法书，其材料来自与原住民使用者的交流。这些著作的分类受传教目的塑造，却保存了地方知识的痕迹。

english:
Kariwa belongs to Echigo's Sea of Japan coast, where lowlands, wooded hills and waterways connect the shore with inland valleys. The name appears in medieval documents: a record of 1313 refers to Kariwa as a district settlement, and one of 1357 names Kariwa district. When the earlier district name Mishima changed to Kariwa is not known.

In the sixteenth century, Echigo was associated with the Uesugi military house and the struggles of the Sengoku era. Later Tokugawa jurisdictions linked village production with taxation and administration. Rice cultivation, coastal movement and the heavy winter snows formed part of the wider provincial setting, though the details of individual settlements varied.
simp_chinese:
刈羽位于越后的日本海沿岸，低地、林丘和水道连接海岸与内陆谷地。中世纪文书已出现这一名称：1313年的记载提到刈羽乡，1357年的文书则称刈羽郡。此前的三岛郡何时改称刈羽郡，年代并不明确。

十六世纪的越后与上杉军事家系及战国时代的争斗相联系。此后德川时期的辖区制度将村庄生产与赋税、行政管理联系起来。稻作、沿海交通和冬季大雪构成这一地区的背景，但各聚落的具体情况有所不同。

english: Kariyan in Fars was associated with Adur Farnbag, one of the three great sacred fires of Zoroastrian Iran. Muslim geographers placed the fire at Kariyan at the time of the Arab conquest. Tradition held that priests divided the fire, keeping one part here and taking another to Fasa to protect it. The sanctuary's fame linked this small place to the religious history of Sasanian Persia and the communities that preserved its faith.
simp_chinese: 法尔斯的卡里扬与阿杜尔·法恩巴格圣火相联系；它是琐罗亚斯德教伊朗三大圣火之一。穆斯林地理学家记载，阿拉伯征服时圣火位于卡里扬。传统称祭司将火分为两份，一份留在此地，另一份移往法萨以免熄灭。这座圣所的声名，使小小的卡里扬与萨珊波斯及延续其信仰的社群联系起来。

english:
Kariyarra country extends along the Pilbara coast around present-day Port Hedland and inland towards the Yule River. Its largest rivers, the Yule and Turner, are known as Kakurrka Muri and Kapankalanha. Both belong to the sacred geography of the Warlu, the ancestral water serpent. Kariyarra traditions also trace descent to the Minjiburu spirit people, linking identity and obligations to particular places.

Engravings on the limestone ridges around Port Hedland preserve another expression of this relationship with country. Made using shells and stone, they include images associated with hunting dugongs, turtles and fish. Their individual dates are uncertain, but they form part of an enduring tradition of transmitting knowledge through marked places. Land, coastal waters and ancestral narratives together sustained a locally distinctive order before colonial settlement reached the Pilbara.
simp_chinese:
卡里亚拉人的家园沿皮尔巴拉海岸延伸，环绕今黑德兰港，并向内陆伸至尤尔河一带。当地最大的两条河流尤尔河与特纳河，分别称为Kakurrka Muri和Kapankalanha；二者都属于祖灵水蛇瓦鲁的神圣地理。卡里亚拉传统还将族群祖源追溯至Minjiburu灵人，使身份与责任同具体地点联系起来。

黑德兰港周围石灰岩山脊上的岩刻，呈现了人与家园关系的另一种表达。这些以贝壳和石片制作的图像，包含猎取儒艮、海龟与鱼类的内容。单幅岩刻的年代尚不确定，但它们属于通过有标记的地点传授知识的悠久传统。在殖民定居进入皮尔巴拉之前，土地、沿海水域与祖灵叙事共同维系着鲜明的地方社会秩序。

english:
Karkala is a Jain centre among the hills of coastal Karnataka. On a rocky height above the town stands a great monolithic image of Bahubali, the prince who renounced worldly power and attained liberation through austerity. The statue, known as Gommateshwara, was installed in 1432 under the ruler Veera Pandya. It made Karkala one of the places where the Jain tradition of monumental Bahubali images flourished.

The local ruling family continued to patronise Jain buildings in the following century. In 1586 Immadi Bhairarasa Vodeya built the Chaturmukha Basadi, a temple with entrances on four sides facing images of the Jain teachers. Its stone pillars and open plan stand opposite the hill of Bahubali. Together the statue and temple preserve the work of rulers, artisans and religious communities who sustained Jain worship in this part of the western coast.
simp_chinese:
卡尔卡拉是卡纳塔克沿海山地的耆那教中心。城镇上方的岩丘矗立着巨大的跋胡巴利整石像。这位王子放弃世俗权力，通过苦行获得解脱。雕像又称瞿摩底湿伐罗像，1432年在统治者维拉·潘迪亚治下安立，使卡尔卡拉成为耆那教大型跋胡巴利造像传统的重要地点之一。

此后一个世纪，当地统治家族继续资助耆那教建筑。1586年，伊马迪·拜拉拉萨·沃德亚修建四面神庙，四侧入口面对耆那教导师的塑像。石柱和开放式布局与对面山上的跋胡巴利像遥相呼应。雕像与寺庙共同保存了统治者、工匠及宗教社群维系西海岸这一地区耆那教信仰的成果。

english: Karkar is a volcanic island in the Bismarck Sea off northern New Guinea. Its fertile slopes rise around nested volcanic calderas, while the sea separates it from the mainland coast. The island has two major languages, Waskia and Takia; Takia-speaking communities traded pottery with people on the mainland and with neighbours on Karkar.
simp_chinese: 卡尔卡尔是新几内亚北岸外俾斯麦海中的火山岛。肥沃山坡围绕重叠的火山口升起，海水将岛屿与大陆海岸分开。岛上有瓦斯基亚语和塔基亚语两种主要语言；塔基亚语社群与大陆居民及岛上邻居交换陶器。

english: Karkar is a volcanic island off the northern coast of New Guinea, across the water from the Madang region. Archaeological work has found Madang-style pottery on Karkar and the neighbouring mainland, evidence of connections among coastal communities before colonial rule.
simp_chinese: 卡尔卡尔是新几内亚北岸外的一座火山岛，与马当地区隔海相望。考古工作在卡尔卡尔和邻近大陆发现马当风格陶器，显示殖民统治之前沿岸社群之间的联系。

english:
The Karkaraly mountains rise above the Kazakh steppe, their rocky ridges and pine woods standing out against the surrounding open plains. Streams and small lakes lie among the hills, which form part of the uplands of central Kazakhstan. The area was used by Kazakh pastoral communities whose seasonal movements crossed the steppe.

In 1824 Russian authorities opened the Karkaraly district administration near the Karkaraly and Kent hills under the statute of 1822. The district was formally opened in April, with its office located near the Kent and Karkaraly tracts. The new organisation placed local volosts under an administrative order centred on the district office. A fortified settlement followed, marking an expansion of imperial administration into the steppe and a new institutional presence among the Kazakh communities of the region.
simp_chinese:
卡尔卡拉雷山地耸立在哈萨克草原之上，岩石山脊与松林在周围开阔平原中格外醒目。溪流和小湖散布于丘陵之间，这里是哈萨克斯坦中部高地的一部分。哈萨克游牧社区利用这一地区，季节性迁徙横穿草原。

1824年，俄国当局依据1822年章程在卡尔卡拉雷和肯特山地附近设立区级管理机构。该区于四月正式设立，管理机构位于肯特和卡尔卡拉雷地带附近；新的组织以区级机构为中心管理当地各乡。随后出现了设防聚落，标志帝国行政向草原扩展，也为该地区哈萨克社区带来新的制度力量。

english: Karkevand lies southwest of Isfahan near the Zayandeh Rud, in a district of cultivated land between the city and the Zagros foothills. The river rises in the mountains and sustains an extensive oasis along its course. Pigeon towers are a striking feature of this agricultural landscape: their carefully arranged nesting holes sheltered large flocks, and their droppings were collected for use as fertilizer. Such towers stood among the fields and villages around Isfahan, including the country near Karkevand.
simp_chinese: 卡尔凯万德位于伊斯法罕西南、扎扬德河附近，地处城市与扎格罗斯山麓之间的耕作地区。河流发源于山中，沿途滋养广阔绿洲。鸽塔是这片农业景观的醒目特色：塔内精心排列的巢穴容纳大群鸽子，鸽粪被收集用作肥料。伊斯法罕周围的田地和村庄间散布着鸽塔，卡尔凯万德附近也有此类建筑。

english: Karkinit Bay is a broad arm of the Black Sea between northwestern Crimea and the mainland. Cape Tarkhankut marks its southern side, while long spits and shallow inlets divide the coast farther east. The western part is deeper than the eastern reaches, where the shore breaks into a succession of smaller bays. Its waters meet the open sea west of the Crimean peninsula.
simp_chinese: 卡尔基尼特湾是黑海伸入克里米亚西北部与大陆之间的一片宽阔海湾。塔尔汉库特角位于其南侧，向东则有长长沙嘴和浅湾分割海岸。海湾西部比东部深，东岸又分出一连串小海湾；西端的水域与克里米亚半岛外的大海相接。

english:
Karksi, known as Karkus in German, was a castle district of southern Livonia. The Order began building its fortress in the later thirteenth century; substantial stone structures followed in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. Above the steep valley, the stronghold combined a defensible site with the administrative presence of the Order. Its chapel and the church outside the gate also served the district's religious life.

The upheavals that carried Livonia from the Order's rule through later Polish-Lithuanian, Swedish and Russian power changed this landscape repeatedly. During the Great Northern War the wooden parish church burned in 1703. A replacement was built in 1730, when Field Marshal Georg Reinhold von Lieven also established a family chapel beside the approach to the castle. In 1773 the parish decided to construct a stone church among the ruins, incorporating two usable walls. Consecrated on 3 September 1778, St Peter's gave the former military precinct a lasting parish centre.
simp_chinese:
卡尔克西的德语名为卡尔库斯，是利沃尼亚南部的城堡辖区。骑士团于十三世纪后半叶开始营建堡垒，十四至十五世纪又修筑石质建筑。陡峭谷地上方的城堡既便于防守，也体现骑士团对周边地区的行政权力。堡内礼拜堂和城门外的教堂同时承担地方宗教生活的职责。

此后，利沃尼亚经历骑士团统治瓦解，以及波兰立陶宛、瑞典和俄国势力的更替。大北方战争期间，木制堂区教堂于1703年焚毁。1730年，新木教堂重建，格奥尔格·赖因霍尔德·冯·利文元帅也在通往城堡的路旁修建家族礼拜堂。1773年，堂区决定利用废墟中尚可使用的两道墙体兴建石教堂；圣彼得教堂于1778年9月3日祝圣。昔日军事院落由此成为延续地方礼拜生活的中心。

english: Karkuj stands on the Blue Nile in the Sudanese river country south of Sennar. The river descends from the Ethiopian highlands and carries its floodwaters north towards the confluence with the White Nile. Villages and cultivated land along its banks form a green corridor through the drier plains around them.
simp_chinese: 卡尔库杰位于苏丹青尼罗河畔，在森纳尔以南的河流地区。青尼罗河自埃塞俄比亚高地下行，洪水向北流向与白尼罗河的汇合处。沿岸村落与耕地在周围较干燥的平原中形成绿色走廊。

english:
Karleby, or Kokkola, became a town on 7 September 1620, when Gustavus Adolphus granted a charter to the fishing and farming village of Ristiranta. The settlement developed into a center of shipping and shipbuilding on Finland's Ostrobothnian coast. Yet its merchants were initially barred from direct foreign trade, and voyages chiefly served Turku and Stockholm. A fire destroyed much of the town in 1664.

The decisive commercial change came in 1765, when Kokkola received staple rights, helped by the advocacy of the clergyman and parliamentary representative Anders Chydenius. Merchants could now trade abroad directly. They bought tar from rural producers and shipped it to English and Mediterranean ports, connecting forest labor in the hinterland with the needs of wooden ships. Tar trading and ship ownership brought rapid growth in wealth during the early nineteenth century. The town's maritime success rested both on these productive connections and on a specific change in trading law.
simp_chinese:
卡勒比又名科科拉。1620年9月7日，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫签发特许状，将以捕鱼和农业为生的里斯蒂兰塔村升为城镇。当地逐渐成为芬兰奥斯特罗博滕沿海的航运与造船中心，但最初不能直接从事国外贸易，航线主要通向图尔库和斯德哥尔摩。1664年，一场大火又毁坏城镇的大部分建筑。

关键变化发生在1765年。牧师兼议会代表安德斯·许德纽斯积极推动，使科科拉获得对外贸易权。商人于是能够直接从乡村生产者收购焦油，运往英国和地中海港口，将内陆森林劳动同木船所需材料联系起来。十九世纪初，焦油贸易和船舶经营使当地财富迅速增长。卡勒比的海运发展，因而同时依靠乡村生产网络，以及一项明确改变商人活动范围的贸易制度。

english:
Karlivka grew beside the Orchyk River in the Ukrainian steppe. In the early eighteenth century the Russian general Johann Bernhard von Weisbach established a settlement on his estates here. In 1731 he used it as a headquarters while directing construction of the Ukrainian defensive line, a chain of fortifications intended to protect the Hetmanate and Sloboda Ukraine from raids. A separate fortification was also built at Karlivka itself.

After Weisbach's death the estate passed to Field Marshal Münnich, who called the settlement Münnichpol. In 1743 Empress Elizabeth granted it to Oleksiy Rozumovsky; after his death in 1771 it was inherited by his brother Kyrylo, the former hetman. The settlement became the centre of a large estate whose villages grew amid the cultivated lands of the Orchyk basin.
simp_chinese:
卡尔利夫卡兴起于乌克兰草原的奥尔奇克河畔。十八世纪初，俄军将领约翰·伯恩哈德·冯·魏斯巴赫在此地领地上建立聚落。1731年，他以这里为临时总部，指挥乌克兰防线的修筑；这条堡垒链旨在保护哥萨克酋长国和斯洛博达乌克兰免受袭击。卡尔利夫卡本身也建起独立的防御工事。

魏斯巴赫去世后，领地转归明尼赫元帅，他将聚落称为明尼赫波尔。1743年，伊丽莎白女皇将其赐给阿列克谢·拉祖莫夫斯基；1771年他去世后，领地由其弟、前哥萨克酋长基里洛继承。聚落成为大型庄园的中心，庄园村落在奥尔奇克河流域的耕地间逐渐发展。

english:
Karlovac was founded as a fortress among the rivers of Croatia, close to the meeting of the Kupa and Korana. Its six bastions and earthen ramparts form a star around a planned town of straight streets and a central square. Named for Archduke Charles II of Austria, it became a principal stronghold of the Military Frontier facing the Ottomans.

Construction began in 1579, following a decision to strengthen the defence of the Habsburg lands. Surrounded by a moat, Karlovac served as a command and supply centre and withstood Ottoman attacks. After the Peace of Karlowitz in 1699, its role gradually changed. The navigable Kupa and new roads towards the Adriatic, including the Karolina and Josephina roads, helped merchants carry goods between the coast and the interior. The town grew beyond its military origins as trade and crafts developed.
simp_chinese:
卡尔洛瓦茨作为一座堡垒建于克罗地亚的河流之间，靠近库帕河与科拉纳河交汇处。六座棱堡和土筑城垣围成星形，护卫着按照规划修建的直街与中央广场。城镇以奥地利大公查理二世命名，成为面向奥斯曼帝国的军事边疆主要据点。

为加强哈布斯堡领地的防御，卡尔洛瓦茨于1579年动工。城堡四周环绕护城河，既是指挥和补给中心，也抵御了奥斯曼人的进攻。1699年《卡尔洛维茨和约》签订后，它的作用逐渐改变。可通航的库帕河与通往亚得里亚海的新道路，包括卡罗利纳路和约瑟菲纳路，帮助商人在海岸与内陆之间运送货物。随着贸易和手工业发展，城镇逐渐超出了最初的军事用途。

english:
Karlstadt on the Main belonged to the prince-bishopric of Würzburg, with vineyards already recorded in the thirteenth century. The town's political and religious life was shaken by the Peasants' War in 1525. Karlsburg was destroyed, and a punitive tribunal against rebels followed in the market square.

A later religious foundation drew support from the townspeople. The Capuchin monastery's foundation stone was laid in 1670 on land supplied by the municipality; its convent building was completed in 1671 and its church consecrated in 1674. The friars preached and heard confessions in the town and surrounding villages. Secularisation closed the monastery in 1804, and the emptied church became a salt store. Citizens successfully requested its restoration in 1808 during the Grand Duchy of Würzburg. It survived the territory's return to Bavaria, and the union of the order's Bavarian and Franconian provinces secured the Karlstadt community in 1836.
simp_chinese:
美因河畔卡尔施塔特属于维尔茨堡采邑主教领，十三世纪已有葡萄栽培记录。1525年农民战争冲击城镇，卡尔斯堡遭毁，市场广场随后成为惩处起义者的法庭所在地。

稍后的宗教建设则获得市民支持。嘉布遣会修院于1670年在市政提供的土地奠基，1671年建成院舍，1674年教堂祝圣，修士在城内及周围村庄讲道、听告解。1804年世俗化时修院关闭，搬空的教堂改作盐仓。1808年，处于维尔茨堡大公国时期，市民请求恢复修院并获准。当地重归巴伐利亚后，修院继续存在；1836年修会巴伐利亚与法兰克尼亚教省合并，保障了卡尔施塔特社群的延续。

english: Karluk Peak rises among the high mountains of the Canadian interior. The surrounding country lies within the broad traditional territory of the Secwépemc, whose lands extend from the Fraser River toward the Rocky Mountains and south to the Arrow Lakes. Salmon migrations, the movements of game and the ripening of berries formed part of the seasonal cycle of Secwépemc life, connecting river valleys with the mountain country above them.
simp_chinese: 卡卢克峰高耸于加拿大内陆的群山之间。周围地区属于塞克韦佩姆人广阔的传统领地，其范围从弗雷泽河延伸至落基山脉，向南抵达箭湖。鲑鱼洄游、野兽迁移和浆果成熟，都是塞克韦佩姆人季节性生活的一部分，将河谷与上方山地联系起来。

english:
Karma Densa, also known as Karma Gon, was a monastery of the Karma Kagyu tradition in northeastern Kham. Founded by the First Karmapa in the twelfth century, it became an important seat of religious instruction. Chokyi Gyeltsen, later remembered as the First Tai Situ, was born near the monastery in 1377. The Fifth Karmapa appointed him its principal instructor, and the Situ incarnation line subsequently developed from his discipleship and succession.

Chokyi Gyeltsen received an imperial religious title in 1413, while the title Situ itself was associated with a Ming envoy and a local political office. The monastery's influence thus involved both teaching and relationships with external patrons. Later Situ incarnations maintained the institution; the Fourth Situ enlarged its monastic community in the sixteenth century. In the eighteenth century, the Eighth Situ moved the line's principal seat to Pelpung near Derge. Karma Densa remained an older centre within this wider network of monasteries, teachers and reincarnate lineages.
simp_chinese:
噶玛丹萨又称噶玛寺，是康区东北部噶玛噶举派寺院，由第一世噶玛巴于十二世纪创建，后来成为重要教学驻地。后称第一世大司徒的曲吉坚赞于1377年出生在寺院附近，第五世噶玛巴任命他为主要讲师，大司徒转世系统随后从其师承与继承关系中发展起来。

曲吉坚赞在1413年获得朝廷宗教封号，“司徒”称号本身则与明朝使者及地方政治职务相联系。寺院影响因此也涉及教学和外部赞助。后世大司徒继续维系寺院，第四世在十六世纪增加僧众。十八世纪，第八世将该转世系统的主要驻地迁往德格附近的八蚌寺；噶玛丹萨仍是这个寺院、导师和转世谱系网络中的较早中心。

english:
Karmakshi belongs to the lower Syr Darya country, where river crossings and settlements became points of competition between local communities and the expanding Khanate of Kokand. A local historical study identifies the place with the sequence of names Karmakshi and Kos-Korgan, preserving several stages in the history of the same riverine locality.

The Kokand fort of Kos-Korgan is dated in that account to about 1819–1820. Its construction brought a fortified centre into the river landscape during the early nineteenth century. Accounts differed about whether Kokand's men built both of its walls or whether a local notable contributed one, a distinction that also shaped explanations of its name, meaning a double fort. These traditions connect military expansion with the participation of people already living in the district. The fortified settlement stood within a wider world of river passage, local leadership and competition for influence along the Syr Darya.
simp_chinese:
卡尔马克希属于锡尔河下游地区，河流渡口与聚落在当地社群和不断扩张的浩罕汗国之间，成为争夺影响力的节点。一篇地方历史研究将这里同卡尔马克希、科斯科尔干等先后使用的地名联系起来，保存了同一处沿河地方的几个历史阶段。

该研究将浩罕修建科斯科尔干堡的时间置于1819至1820年前后。这使十九世纪初的河流景观中出现一处设防中心。地方记述对双重城墙的营造存在不同说法：有人认为全由浩罕人修筑，也有人认为当地显贵参与修建其中一重。这种分歧也进入“两个堡垒”这一名称的解释。相关传统将军事扩张同既有居民的参与连接起来，使这座堡垒处于锡尔河通行、地方首领与区域权力竞争交织的世界之中。

english:
Karmana's sixteenth-century history was closely associated with Qasim Sheikh, a religious teacher whose influence reached into the struggles of the Uzbek ruling houses. During the fighting of 1551, the young Abdullah Khan sought his counsel as rival forces threatened the Karmana stronghold. The sheikh's position connected religious authority with the negotiations and armed competition through which rulers sought control of Transoxiana.

In 1558, Abdullah sponsored a khanaqah for Qasim Sheikh in Karmana. This building provided a setting for religious instruction and communal practice, giving durable architectural form to the relationship between the ruler and his spiritual adviser. Qasim Sheikh died in 1578 and was buried beside the khanaqah. His tomb and the religious building became the centre of a lasting commemorative complex. Karmana's place in this history rests on more than its position between great Central Asian cities: it was also a setting where local religious leadership and the ambitions of an emerging ruler became closely entwined.
simp_chinese:
卡尔马纳的十六世纪历史与宗教导师卡西姆谢赫密切相关，他的影响进入乌兹别克统治家族的争夺。1551年战事中，敌对军队威胁卡尔马纳堡垒，年轻的阿卜杜拉汗向他寻求指引。谢赫的地位将宗教权威，与统治者争夺河中地区的交涉和武装竞争联系起来。

1558年，阿卜杜拉在卡尔马纳为卡西姆谢赫营建汗纳卡，使宗教教学和共同修持获得固定场所，也以建筑体现统治者与精神导师的关系。卡西姆谢赫1578年去世，葬于汗纳卡旁；陵墓与宗教建筑成为延续的纪念性建筑群中心。卡尔马纳因而也曾是地方宗教领袖与崛起统治者的抱负紧密交织的场所。

english: Karnak lies in an oasis northwest of Yasi, beneath the Karatau mountains. It was one of the settlements of the wider Turkistan country, where mountain streams and irrigation supported gardens and fields. Craftsmen here cast the great bronze cauldron commissioned by Timur for the shrine of Ahmad Yasawi. The vessel was carried to the mausoleum at Yasi, linking Karnak's metalworkers to one of the most important religious foundations of the Timurid age.
simp_chinese: 卡尔纳克位于牙思西北方的绿洲中，背靠卡拉套山。它是突厥斯坦地区诸聚落之一，山溪与灌溉滋养园圃和田地。当地工匠铸造了帖木儿为艾哈迈德·亚萨维圣陵订制的大铜釜。铜釜被运往牙思的陵墓，使卡尔纳克的金工与帖木儿时代最重要的宗教建筑之一相联系。

english:
Karnal lies on the northern Indian plain near the Yamuna, between Panipat and the sacred country around Thanesar. Local tradition associates its name with Karna, the hero of the Mahabharata. Under the Mughals it was a pargana of Delhi, assessed for revenue and required to provide infantry and cavalry to the imperial army.

In 1739 the Persian ruler Nader Shah invaded India and defeated the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah at Karnal. The emperor's army occupied a fortified camp, but its supplies were cut off and he submitted to the invader, who advanced on Delhi. Later in the century Sikh power grew in the region. Gajpat Singh of Jind took Karnal in 1763, built a fort and walls, and presided over an expansion of the town.
simp_chinese:
格尔纳尔位于亚穆纳河附近的北印度平原，介于伯尼巴德和塔内萨尔周围的圣地之间。地方传说将城名与《摩诃婆罗多》中的英雄迦尔纳联系起来。莫卧儿时期，这里是德里下属的帕尔加纳，须缴纳赋税，并为帝国军队提供步兵和骑兵。

1739年，波斯统治者纳迪尔沙入侵印度，在格尔纳尔击败莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德沙。皇帝的军队驻扎在设防营地，补给却被切断，他最终向入侵者屈服，后者随即进军德里。本世纪后期，锡克势力在这一带兴起。金德的加杰帕特·辛格于1763年夺取格尔纳尔，修建城墙和堡垒，城镇在他统治下有所扩大。

english: Karniki, also known as Pilyushno, was a village in the country west of Pronsk. Its parish church was dedicated to Saint Paraskeva and is recorded as dating from 1731. The parish served a number of villages in the surrounding countryside. This part of the central Russian uplands is crossed by small rivers and ravines, with farmland spread between the valleys that lead toward the Oka and the Don basins.
simp_chinese: 卡尔尼基又称皮柳什诺，是普龙斯克以西的一处村庄。当地教区教堂奉献给圣帕拉斯凯瓦，记载称其建于1731年，教区服务于周边若干村庄。俄罗斯中部高地在此被小河和沟谷切割，农田分布在通向奥卡河及顿河流域的谷地之间。

english:
Karo country extended across the highlands and their approaches to the eastern Sumatran coast. Agricultural villages maintained relationships with the Malay trading districts of Deli and Langkat, connecting the interior with the Strait of Malacca. Salt carriers remembered as perlanja sira travelled on foot between the uplands and coastal markets, exchanging inland products for a necessity unavailable from highland fields. Routes through the forest and along rivers thus linked communities on both sides of the mountain margin.

John Anderson's mission from Penang in 1823 provides a detailed early nineteenth-century view of this commercial world. He encountered Karo communities closer to the coast than later linguistic maps might suggest and distinguished the Karau-Karau from other peoples collectively called Batak. His account emphasized their cultivation and involvement in commerce. The coastal pepper economy drew on such producers before European tobacco plantations transformed the lowlands. Highland agriculture, salt exchange and connections with port rulers therefore formed an established network by the early nineteenth century, with Karo households participating in wider markets while retaining village and kinship institutions of their own.
simp_chinese:
卡罗地区包括北苏门答腊高地及其通向东海岸的地带。农业村落同碟里、朗卡特的马来贸易地区维持往来，将内陆接入马六甲海峡。被称为perlanja sira的盐贩步行于山地与沿海市场之间，以内陆物产交换高地田野无法提供的必需品。穿越森林、沿河延伸的道路，由此连接山地边缘两侧的社群。
