约翰·安德森1823年从槟榔屿出发的考察，留下了十九世纪初这一商业世界的细致记录。他接触到的卡罗社群，比后来语言分布图所显示的更靠近海岸，并把卡劳卡劳人与其他统称巴塔克的群体区分开来。他的记述特别注意当地耕作与商业参与。在欧洲烟草种植园改造低地以前，沿海胡椒经济已依靠这些生产者。高地农业、食盐交换以及同港口统治者的联系，至十九世纪初已形成既有网络；卡罗家庭参与广阔市场，同时维持自己的村落与亲族制度。

english:
Karokh, northeast of Herat, formed part of the network of valleys and local chiefships through which rulers of western Afghanistan exercised authority. Its early nineteenth-century history is closely associated with a Jamshedi family whose power depended on relations with Herat. Later local accounts credit Ibrahim Khan with obtaining Karokh as a jagir, or revenue grant, from Shah Mahmud in reward for his service.

Ibrahim is also said to have brought Jamshedi households from Kushk to settle at Karokh, establishing a local following distinct from the main body of the tribe. His death is put at about 1835, and his son Ahmad Khan succeeded him. Such land grants, migration and hereditary leadership connected a relatively small locality to the politics of Herat in the decades before 1837.
simp_chinese:
卡罗赫位于赫拉特东北，属于阿富汗西部统治者通过河谷与地方酋长领地行使权力的网络。其19世纪初历史与一个贾姆希迪家族密切相关，该家族的势力取决于同赫拉特的关系。后来的地方记述称，易卜拉欣汗因效力沙阿马哈茂德而获得卡罗赫作为贾吉尔，即收益授予地。

据说易卜拉欣还将贾姆希迪家庭从库什克迁到卡罗赫，建立了有别于部族主体的地方追随者群体；其去世时间约为1835年，随后由儿子艾哈迈德汗继承。土地授予、人口迁移与世袭领导，使这样一个较小的地方在1837年之前的数十年间与赫拉特政治连接在一起。

sources.title: 1975 Historical and Political Gazetteer of Afghanistan Vol 3 Herat and NW Afghanistan s.pdf

english:
Karor is identifiable with Karor Lal Esan, also called Kot Karor, in the Indus-side country of southern Punjab. The locality is associated with the shrine of Lal Esan. A devotional tradition explains the name Karor through the saint's recitation of the Quranic chapter Ya Sin ten million times while standing in the Indus. This is a sacred account of the place name, rather than a securely dated episode of political history.

The surrounding Layyah tract was shaped by Baloch chiefs and changing imperial authority. Layyah itself passed from Mirani to Jaskani Baloch control around 1610. In 1787 Timur Shah Durrani appointed Abdun Nabi Sarai as governor, and three years later Muhammad Khan Sadozai's government shifted its seat to Mankera. Sikh rule subsequently reorganised the wider district. These events belong to Karor's regional setting, not to a separate chronology of the shrine town. Alongside such political changes, the Indus and the religious connections centred on saints gave the locality routes and loyalties extending beyond a single settlement.
simp_chinese:
格罗尔可对应旁遮普南部印度河地区的卡罗尔拉尔伊桑，又称科特卡罗尔，与拉尔·伊桑圣陵相联系。宗教传统以圣人在印度河中站立、诵读《古兰经》雅辛章一千万遍的故事，解释Karor这一名称。这属于地名的神圣叙事，不能视为具有可靠年代的政治事件。

周围莱亚地区的历史受到俾路支首领和帝国权力更替的影响。莱亚本城约于1610年从米拉尼俾路支人转入贾斯卡尼人控制。1787年，帖木儿沙·杜兰尼任命阿卜杜勒·纳比·萨赖为总督；三年后，穆罕默德汗·萨多扎伊的政府将驻地迁往曼凯拉。锡克统治后来又改变了更广大地区的行政安排。这些事件构成格罗尔的区域背景，不能当作圣陵城镇本身的独立年表。政治变化之外，印度河和围绕圣人的宗教联系，使这里的路线与效忠关系延伸至单一聚落以外。

english: Mahra lies in the country west of the Indus, south of Dera Ismail Khan. Nearby, the mound of Mahra Dheri has yielded pottery and terracotta objects from a Bronze Age settlement, evidence of a much older history in the plain. The wider Derajat region took shape in the fifteenth century, when the Langah Sultan of Multan invited Baloch people to settle there. Later the Indus and the routes towards the Gomal Pass connected its communities with markets beyond the valley.
simp_chinese: 马赫拉位于印度河以西、德拉伊斯梅尔汗以南的地区。附近的马赫拉德里土丘出土了青铜时代聚落的陶器和陶制品，显示平原有更久远的居住史。十五世纪，木尔坦的兰加苏丹邀请俾路支人迁入，更广阔的德拉贾特地区逐渐形成。此后，印度河与通往戈马勒山口的道路将当地社群同河谷以外的市场连接起来。

english: The southern shore of Sumbawa faces the open Indian Ocean, beyond the chain of volcanic islands in the Lesser Sundas. Mountains rise above a coast indented by bays, including Cempi and Waworada. The island is separated from Lombok to the west by the Alas Strait and from islands to the east by the Sape Strait. Its southern coast looks out across open water, contrasting with the Flores Sea to the north.
simp_chinese: 松巴哇南岸面向开阔的印度洋，位于小巽他群岛火山岛链的南侧。山地高出曲折海岸，沿岸有岑皮湾和瓦沃拉达湾等海湾。阿拉斯海峡将它与西方龙目岛隔开，萨佩海峡则分隔东面的岛屿。南岸面向大洋，与北面的弗洛勒斯海景观不同。

english: Between Crete and Rhodes, the Karpathian Sea takes its name from the island of Karpathos. Together with neighboring Kasos, the island lies along a route from Crete toward Rhodes and the southeastern Aegean. Karpathos was closely connected with Rhodes in antiquity and the Middle Ages. In 1306 it passed to the Venetian Cornaro family, who held it until 1538, when the Ottomans took possession of the island.
simp_chinese: 卡尔帕索斯海位于克里特与罗得之间，得名于卡尔帕索斯岛。该岛与邻近的卡索斯岛位于从克里特通往罗得和爱琴海东南部的航路上。古代和中世纪，卡尔帕索斯与罗得联系密切。1306年，岛屿转归威尼斯的科尔纳罗家族，直到1538年奥斯曼人取得它。

english: Karpathos lies in the southeastern Aegean, an island whose history was closely tied to nearby Rhodes. Its cities appeared on the tribute lists of the ancient Delian League, and the island later lost its independence to Rhodes. In 1304 it was granted to Genoese corsairs, but two years later passed to Andrea Cornaro of Venice. His family held Karpathos until the Ottomans took it in 1538. The island rebelled during the Greek War of Independence in 1821–22, but returned to Ottoman rule. In 1835 Sultan Mahmud II granted Karpathos the #italic maktu#! tax system, under which a fixed annual sum was assessed for the island instead of separate assessments for each household.
simp_chinese: 卡尔帕索斯位于爱琴海东南部，历史上与附近的罗得岛关系密切。岛上的城市见于古代提洛同盟的贡赋名册，后来卡尔帕索斯失去独立，受罗得控制。1304年，该岛被授予热那亚海盗为采邑，两年后转归威尼斯的安德烈亚·科尔纳罗。科尔纳罗家族统治该岛，直到1538年奥斯曼人夺取它。希腊独立战争期间，岛民于1821至1822年起义，但随后重归奥斯曼统治。1835年，苏丹马哈茂德二世准许卡尔帕索斯采用#italic 马克图#!税制，为全岛核定年度总额，而非逐户计算税额。

english:
Karpenisi's mountain setting made it a centre of both learning and armed resistance under Ottoman rule. Local inhabitants joined the uprisings of 1600 and 1611. Between 1645 and 1661, Eugenios Giannoulas's school helped give the town a reputation as a cultural centre despite the insecurity of the period.

In 1684 the armatolos Livinis rebelled and won a victory near Goliani. Venetian forces later plundered Karpenisi, and the settlement returned to Ottoman rule after the Treaty of Karlowitz. Its strategic position in central Roumeli again mattered during the Greek Revolution of 1821: local captains proclaimed revolt, suffered defeat and then regrouped to expel the Ottoman forces. In August 1823 Markos Botsaris was killed fighting at nearby Kefalovryso. Karpenisi's early modern history was therefore shaped by a succession of schools, local military leaders and campaigns that connected this inland town with the larger struggles of Greece.
simp_chinese:
卡尔派尼西的山地位置，使它在奥斯曼统治下既成为学术中心，也成为武装抵抗据点。当地居民参加了1600年与1611年的起事；1645至1661年间，欧根尼奥斯·吉安努拉斯创办的学校，又使城镇在动荡环境中获得文化中心的声誉。

1684年，地方武装首领利维尼斯起兵，并在戈利亚尼附近取得胜利。威尼斯军队后来劫掠卡尔派尼西，卡尔洛维茨条约签订后，聚落重新归入奥斯曼统治。1821年希腊革命中，它在鲁梅利中部的战略位置再度重要：地方首领宣布起义，遭受失败后重新集结，并将奥斯曼军队逐出城镇。1823年8月，马尔科斯·博察里斯在附近的凯法洛夫里索战死。学校、地方军事首领与接连的战役，将这座内陆山城与希腊更广泛的斗争联系起来。

english:
Karpokhar lies near Sankoo in the Suru Valley, within the historical country of Purig. Here the lands of western Ladakh faced towards Kashmir and Baltistan as well as the Tibetan plateau. The nearby principality of Kartse had Buddhist rulers and an older heritage of monumental rock carvings. Muslim preachers arriving through Baltistan from the sixteenth century gradually brought a different religious tradition into the valley.

Karpokhar became associated with the scholar and saint Syed Mir Hashim, whose shrine preserved the memory of that teaching. Local accounts connect conversion with the patronage of the ruling family of Kartse, including a Balti royal wife. Political allegiance also changed: Deldan Namgyal's seventeenth-century campaigns brought Kartse and neighbouring principalities under Ladakhi control, while the wars involving Tibet and Mughal Kashmir unsettled that arrangement. In the eighteenth century Suru formed part of Purig, which was for a time assigned to a younger branch of the Ladakhi royal house. The valley's cultivated ground and settlements lay amid these intersecting loyalties, and Karpokhar's religious importance grew from the same connections that joined local courts to scholars and families beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese:
卡波卡位于苏鲁河谷桑库附近，属于历史上的普里格地区。这里的西拉达克土地同时面向克什米尔、巴尔蒂斯坦与青藏高原。附近卡尔策小邦原由佛教君主统治，留下了巨型摩崖造像的古老传统。十六世纪起，取道巴尔蒂斯坦而来的穆斯林传教者，逐渐将另一种宗教传统带入河谷。

卡波卡与学者、圣者赛义德·米尔·哈希姆关系密切，其圣陵保存着传教活动的记忆。地方叙述将信仰转变同卡尔策王族的支持联系起来，其中包括一位巴尔蒂王妃。政治隶属也多次变化：十七世纪德勒南杰的征伐使卡尔策及邻邦归入拉达克控制，随后涉及西藏与莫卧儿克什米尔的战争又动摇了这一安排。十八世纪苏鲁属于普里格，后者一度由拉达克王室支系单独治理。河谷耕地和聚落置身于交错的权力关系之中；卡波卡的宗教地位，也随着地方宫廷、学者及跨山家族之间的往来而成长。

english: Karpas Mahal takes its name from cotton, the produce for which the wooded hills east of Chittagong were known. Chakma chiefs governed communities in this upland country and dealt with merchants from the Bengal plains. In the early eighteenth century a Chakma ruler arranged to provide cotton tribute to the Mughal authorities in return for trade. The name came to designate the tribute-paying country, where relations with the plains coexisted with the authority of local hill leaders.
simp_chinese: 卡普斯玛哈尔因棉花得名，吉大港以东森林覆盖的山地以这种物产闻名。查克玛首领治理高地社群，也与孟加拉平原的商人往来。十八世纪初，一位查克玛统治者安排向莫卧儿当局缴纳棉花贡赋，以换取贸易机会。这个名称后来用于指称纳贡地区；当地与平原的联系，与山地首领的地方权威并存。

english: Karroun lies in the inland Wheatbelt of Western Australia, near Karroun Hill. Dry woodland and low rocky rises mark the country between the southwestern districts and the interior. This landscape forms part of the wider Aboriginal country of the region, known and traversed long before European settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡伦位于西澳大利亚内陆麦田区，靠近卡伦山。干旱林地与低矮岩丘构成西南地区和内陆之间的景观。这片土地属于更广阔的原住民地区，欧洲人定居很久以前，人们便已熟悉并穿行于此。

english:
Kars stands on a high plateau where roads from Anatolia meet those leading into Armenia and the Caucasus. Its citadel overlooks the river and town, while the domed Church of the Holy Apostles recalls the period when Kars was a capital of the Armenian Bagratid kings. The city's position made it a stronghold of exceptional importance to the powers competing for the eastern frontier.

Timur's invasion devastated Kars in the late fourteenth century. In 1579 the Ottoman commander Lala Mustafa Pasha rebuilt the fortress and the damaged town, providing mosques, a bridge and a governor's palace. The new provincial centre guarded approaches to Iran and Georgia, but the wars between the Ottomans and Safavids brought fresh destruction; Shah Abbas's campaign damaged the city in 1604. Kars continued to face armies from beyond the frontier. Nader Shah besieged it in the eighteenth century, and Russian troops stormed the fortress in 1828 during the Russo-Ottoman War. The peace settlement returned Kars to Ottoman rule the following year. The stronghold remained a symbol of the contested highlands and the repeated struggles to control the roads through them.
simp_chinese:
卡尔斯坐落在高原上，安纳托利亚道路与通往亚美尼亚和高加索的道路在此相接。城堡俯瞰河流与城镇，带穹顶的圣使徒教堂令人想起卡尔斯曾是亚美尼亚巴格拉图尼诸王都城的时代。城市的地理位置使它成为争夺东部边疆的各方极为重视的要塞。

十四世纪末，帖木儿的入侵使卡尔斯遭到破坏。1579年，奥斯曼将领拉拉·穆斯塔法帕夏重建了堡垒与受损的城镇，并修建清真寺、桥梁和总督府。新的行省中心守卫通往伊朗与格鲁吉亚的道路，但奥斯曼与萨法维的战争又带来新的破坏；1604年沙阿阿拔斯的军队毁坏了城市。卡尔斯继续面对来自边疆之外的军队。十八世纪纳迪尔沙阿围攻此城；1828年俄奥战争期间，俄军攻破堡垒。次年的和平条约将卡尔斯归还奥斯曼帝国。这座要塞依然是争夺高地及其道路的反复战争的象征。

english:
Kars lies at the edge of the Cilician plain, where the lowlands meet the mountains of the interior. Known in Ottoman records as Kars-ı Zülkadriye or Kars-ı Maraş, it belonged to the country of the Dulkadir Türkmen. The town's Alacami preserves a long sequence of religious use: a Roman building was adapted as a church, then a minaret was added when it became a mosque in 1489.

Kars served as a winter administrative centre for the Dulkadir rulers in the later fifteenth century. In 1515 their lands came under Ottoman rule, and Kars became part of the administrative district of Maraş. Its distinctive name helped distinguish it from other places called Kars, while the layered masonry of the Alacami bore witness to the succession of communities that had used the site.
simp_chinese:
卡尔斯位于奇里乞亚平原边缘，是低地与内陆山地相接之处。奥斯曼文献称它为祖勒卡德里耶卡尔斯或马拉什卡尔斯，属于杜勒卡迪尔土库曼人的领地。城中的阿拉清真寺保留了漫长的宗教使用史：罗马建筑曾改为教堂，1489年又增建尖塔，成为清真寺。

十五世纪后期，卡尔斯曾是杜勒卡迪尔统治者的冬季行政中心。1515年，其领地转入奥斯曼统治，卡尔斯成为马拉什辖区的一部分。特别的名称有助于将它与其他同名的卡尔斯区分开来；阿拉清真寺层叠的石墙则见证了先后在此使用建筑的不同社群。

english: The high country around Kars rises between the valleys of the southern Caucasus and eastern Anatolia. The Allahuekber Mountains stand above a broad plateau cut by streams and smaller plains, while wooded slopes cover parts of the uplands farther south and east. Elevation and the distance from the sea bring severe winters to the region. The mountains and plateaus form a rugged transition between the upper river valleys and the plains around Kars, with passes threading through their long ridges.
simp_chinese: 卡尔斯周围的高地耸立在南高加索与安纳托利亚东部的谷地之间。阿拉胡埃克贝尔山脉俯瞰广阔高原，溪流与小型平原切分着高地，更南、更东的部分山坡覆盖森林。海拔与远离海洋的位置使这一地区冬季严寒。山地与高原构成上游河谷和卡尔斯周围平原之间崎岖的过渡地带，山口穿行于绵长的山脊之间。

english: The uplands west of Kars rise into the Allahuekber and Güllü ranges, between the upper basins of the Kura and Araks. Deep valleys cut the high plateaus, and pine forests cover parts of the slopes around Sarıkamış. Above the trees lie mountain meadows and bare summits, exposed to the long, snowy winters of the eastern Anatolian highlands.
simp_chinese: 卡尔斯以西的高地升起为阿拉胡埃克贝尔与居尔吕山脉，位于库拉河与阿拉斯河上游流域之间。深谷切开高原，萨勒卡默什周围部分山坡覆有松林。林线上方是高山草甸和裸露峰顶，面对安纳托利亚东部高地漫长多雪的冬季。

english: The Kars highlands are a landscape of broad plateaus, hills and river valleys at the meeting of Anatolia and the Caucasus. The plateau extends east towards the Arpaçay and is bordered by mountains around Sarıkamış. Its elevation brings a severe continental winter, with snow on the heights and open grasslands across the rolling ground. Streams cut through the plateau towards the larger valleys beyond.
simp_chinese: 卡尔斯高地位于安纳托利亚与高加索的交接处，由广阔高原、丘陵和河谷组成。高原向东延伸至阿尔帕恰伊河谷，边缘是萨勒卡默什周围的群山。海拔使这里的大陆性冬季严寒，山上积雪，起伏的地面覆盖开阔草原。溪流切穿高原，流向外侧更大的河谷。

english: Karsun’s documented seventeenth-century role was that of a fortified outpost at the meeting of the Barysh and Karsunka rivers. In 1647, Tsar Aleksei Mikhailovich sent Bogdan Khitrovo to organize a new defensive line on the Russian state’s southern approaches. Karsun became an important point on the Karsun–Simbirsk line, which used fortified settlements and forest barriers to obstruct raids from the steppe. The foundation date belongs to this military settlement, and does not demonstrate that the surrounding country had previously been empty. A contemporary royal account describes the new barrier between the Barysh and Sura rivers as extending fifty-three versts, with Karsun on the Barysh at a major route used by raiders. This places the town within a connected defensive landscape rather than an isolated castle. Its early history chiefly concerns its foundation and military purpose, rather than the size of its civilian economy.
simp_chinese: 卡尔孙在十七世纪有据可查的职能，是位于巴雷什河与卡尔孙卡河汇流处的设防据点。1647年，沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇派遣博格丹·希特罗沃，在俄国南部通道组织新的防线。卡尔孙成为卡尔孙-辛比尔斯克防线的重要节点；这条防线利用设防聚落与林木障碍，阻挡来自草原的袭击。这一建置年代属于军事聚落的形成，不能据此断言周边此前无人居住。当时的沙皇记述称，巴雷什河与苏拉河之间的新障碍线长五十三俄里，而巴雷什河上的卡尔孙正处于袭击者往来的一条主要通道上。由此可见，城镇属于相互连接的防御地域，并非一座孤立城堡。其早期历史主要涉及营建与军事目的，而非民用经济的规模。

english: Karta Pintingga is a Kaurna name for Kangaroo Island, across the waters south of mainland Australia. The island is connected to the traditions of Kaurna, Ramindjeri and Ngarrindjeri peoples; a story of Ngurunderi describes an ancestral journey to the island and beyond. In the early nineteenth century sealers visited and lived on the island, bringing Aboriginal women from the mainland into their camps.
simp_chinese: 卡塔平廷加是考纳人对袋鼠岛的称呼，这座岛屿隔海位于澳大利亚大陆以南。它与考纳、拉明杰里和恩加林杰里人的传统相联系；恩古伦德里故事讲述了祖先前往此岛及更远处的旅程。十九世纪初，猎海豹者到访并居住在岛上，将大陆原住民妇女带到他们的营地。

english: The country around Kartaly lies on the southeastern side of the southern Urals, where the Kartaly-Ayat and other tributaries flow east across the steppe toward the Tobol basin. The rivers cut through open grassland, bordered in places by willows along their banks. This is a landscape of broad plains and river valleys at the meeting of the Ural foothills and the Kazakh steppe.
simp_chinese: 卡尔塔雷一带位于南乌拉尔山地的东南侧，卡尔塔雷阿亚特河及其他支流向东穿过草原，流向托博尔河流域。河道穿行于开阔草地之间，部分河岸生长着柳树。这里是乌拉尔山麓与哈萨克草原相接的地方，平原广阔，河谷纵横。

english:
Kartauzh was the centre of the Konda principality, a Mansi polity in the forested river country of western Siberia. Its rulers belonged to a dynasty related to the princes of Pelym, whose larger principality included Konda as a subordinate domain. The settlement was known as Konda town, and remained a seat of local authority even after the loss of independence.

Russian forces campaigning beyond the Urals captured Kartauzh and took its prince Agay and his family prisoner in the winter of 1593–94. The old ruling family nevertheless continued to play a part in governing Konda. In the seventeenth century, relatives of the princes resided at Kartauzh and oversaw local people subject to fur tribute. A Russian decree of 1624 sought to keep the princes Vasily and Fyodor from visiting Great Konda, but their relatives still exercised authority there.
simp_chinese:
卡尔陶日是孔达公国的中心。这一曼西人政权位于西西伯利亚的森林与河流地带，其统治家族与佩雷姆诸公同族，孔达也是佩雷姆公国下属的领地。这里又称孔达城，失去独立后仍是地方权力的所在地。

1593—1594年冬，越过乌拉尔山的俄军攻占卡尔陶日，俘获阿盖王公及其家人。然而旧统治家族仍参与孔达的管理。十七世纪，王公的亲族居于卡尔陶日，管辖缴纳毛皮贡赋的当地居民。1624年的俄国敕令试图禁止瓦西里和费奥多尔两位王公前往大孔达，但他们的亲族仍在那里行使权力。

english: Karu Pana lies on the Caribbean coast of eastern Venezuela, at the site of Carúpano. Small settlements grew in the valleys behind its harbour, where the mountains approach the sea. In 1647 Bishop Damián López de Haro visited Carúpano Arriba and established a chapel dedicated to the Holy Cross. Carúpano Arriba, Guayacán and Macarapana later expanded towards the coast, gradually forming a larger settlement around the harbour.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁帕纳位于委内瑞拉东部加勒比海岸，即卡鲁帕诺所在地。港口后方山地逼近海洋，小聚落在谷地间发展。1647年，主教达米安·洛佩斯·德阿罗到访上卡鲁帕诺，并建立献给圣十字的礼拜堂。上卡鲁帕诺、瓜亚坎和马卡拉帕纳后来向海岸扩展，逐渐在港口周围形成更大的聚落。

english: The Karu Pana coast faces the Caribbean off the Carúpano coast of eastern Venezuela, where small settlements linked farming valleys with the islands. By 1647 the neighbouring valleys held several hundred people, including Indigenous families, Africans, mixed-descent residents and farmers who traded between Margarita and the mainland. Bishop Damián López de Haro's visit that year led to a chapel at Carúpano Arriba. Houses spread toward the port, and by 1742 Carúpano had become a separate parish. An earthquake in December 1797 badly damaged the parish church, and a replacement was under construction by 1830.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁帕纳海岸面向加勒比海，位于委内瑞拉东部卡鲁帕诺一带，小型沿海聚落把农业河谷与岛屿市场连接起来。地方史记载，到1647年，邻近河谷已有数百居民，包括原住民、非洲人、混血居民，以及往来玛格丽塔岛与大陆经商的富裕农户。同年主教达米安·洛佩斯·德阿罗到访，随后在上卡鲁帕诺设立小教堂。房屋逐渐向港口扩展，1742年卡鲁帕诺已独立设立堂区。1797年十二月的地震严重损坏了教堂，到1830年替代建筑已在施工。

english: The Karuah River flows into Port Stephens on the eastern coast of New South Wales. Its tidal estuary opens into a broad sheltered harbour behind coastal headlands. The Worimi people have longstanding connections to the estuary, its waterways and the surrounding shore, which they knew long before British settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁阿河流入新南威尔士东岸的斯蒂芬斯港。潮汐河口通向海岸岬角后方的宽阔避风港。沃里米人长期与河口、水道及周围海岸保持联系；英国人定居之前，他们早已熟悉这些地方。

english: The Karuk lived along the middle Klamath River, among the steep mountains and forests of northern California. Their name means “upriver,” in contrast to the Yurok people farther downstream. Salmon returning from the ocean were central to Karuk life, as were acorns gathered from the surrounding oak woods. A spring ceremony welcomed the first salmon before people fished with dip nets, traps and weirs. The river joined villages along its course and carried fish into the heart of Karuk country.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁克人居住在加利福尼亚北部克拉马斯河中游，周围是陡峭的山地和森林。他们的名称意为“上游”，与更下游的尤罗克人相对。从海洋返回的鲑鱼是卡鲁克人生活的核心，周围橡树林出产的橡实也十分重要。春季，人们举行迎接第一条鲑鱼的仪式，然后用抄网、鱼陷和鱼堰捕鱼。大河将沿岸村庄连接起来，也把鱼群带入卡鲁克人的腹地。

english:
The Karumba coast lies at the mouth of the Norman River on the southern Gulf of Carpentaria. River water, tidal channels and the shallow gulf meet here, making the shore part of a broader estuarine landscape. The country is associated with Indigenous communities whose relationships to the coast preceded the later colonial port.

Matthew Flinders sailed past this area in 1802 during his survey of Australia's coastline. His passage placed the river-mouth coast within an expanding European chart of the gulf, but preceded permanent colonial settlement by many decades. The site acquired its later roles as a telegraph station and coastal transport point only after the period of these early voyages. For the early nineteenth century, its documented maritime encounter belongs to the survey of the gulf's shores, within an existing Indigenous coastal country.
simp_chinese:
卡伦巴海岸位于卡奔塔利亚湾南部、诺曼河河口。河水、潮汐水道与浅海在这里交汇，使海岸成为更广阔河口景观的一部分。本地原住民社群同沿岸的联系，早于后来的殖民港口。

1802年，马修·弗林德斯测绘澳大利亚海岸时从这一带驶过。他的航行使河口海岸进入不断扩展的欧洲海湾图绘，但距离永久殖民定居仍有数十年。此地作为电报站及沿海运输节点的后期职能，都在这些早期航行之后才出现。就十九世纪初而言，这次有记录的海上接触属于海湾沿岸勘测的一部分，发生的背景则是已经存在的原住民海岸土地。

english: Karunga lies in the flat country of the Cuvelai basin, east of the Kunene. Shallow channels called iishana carry seasonal floodwater south across the plain. The wider basin is home to Ovambo communities, whose royal lines traditionally follow descent through women; the Kwanyama are among the northern Ovambo peoples.
simp_chinese: 卡伦加位于库内内河以东的库韦莱盆地平地上。称为伊沙纳的浅水道将季节性洪水向南带过平原。广阔的盆地是奥万博诸社群的家园，其王室传统上按母系继承；夸尼亚马人是北部奥万博人群之一。

english:
Karur stands on the Amaravati River in the inland Tamil country. It was an ancient centre of the Chera rulers, whose names appear in inscriptions on nearby Aru Nattar Malai. Finds of coins and ornaments attest to exchanges that reached beyond southern India. The town also has an old temple of Pasupatisvara, dedicated to Shiva.

Karur and its surrounding country passed among the Cholas, Pandyas and other powers over the centuries. Its position between the Kaveri valley and the western approaches made it a place of strategic importance. Under later rulers, temples continued to receive gifts and preserve inscriptions, while the river valley sustained the settlements around them. In the eighteenth century the Kongu region became part of the contest between Mysore and the British; after the fall of Tipu Sultan in 1799, it passed to the East India Company.
simp_chinese:
卡鲁尔坐落在泰米尔内陆的阿马拉瓦蒂河畔，是古代切拉统治者的中心之一。附近阿鲁纳塔尔山的铭文留下了这些君主的名字，出土的钱币和饰物则表明当地与南印度以外存在交流。城镇还有一座古老的帕苏帕蒂斯瓦拉神庙，供奉湿婆。

数百年间，卡鲁尔及其周边先后归朱罗、潘迪亚等政权统治。它处于高韦里河谷与西部通道之间，地位重要。后世统治者时期，神庙继续接受捐赠并保存铭文，河谷也维系着周围聚落。十八世纪，贡古地区成为迈索尔与英国争夺的对象；1799年蒂普苏丹败亡后，这里转归东印度公司。

english: Kahror Pakka lies in the plains of southern Punjab, east of Lodhran and near the Sutlej country. The settlement is associated with the shrine of Ali Sarwar, traditionally said to have come from a Lodhi family after Babur’s victory over the Lodhis. Its position in the flat riverine region placed it among the towns and villages of the lower Punjab, where the great rivers and their channels shaped settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡罗尔帕卡位于旁遮普南部平原，在洛德兰以东，靠近萨特莱杰河地区。当地有阿里·萨尔瓦尔的陵墓，传说他出身洛迪家族，在巴布尔击败洛迪人后定居于此。这座聚落处在旁遮普南部平坦的河流地带，众多河流及其水道塑造着这里的城镇与村落。

english: Karuwali country lies in the dry inland of western Queensland. The Karuwali are an Aboriginal people whose lands adjoin those of the Maiawali in the wider Diamantina region. River channels, plains and waterholes form part of a landscape in which the flow of water changes greatly with irregular rain.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁瓦利人的土地位于昆士兰西部干旱内陆。他们是原住民族群，其土地与更广阔的迪亚曼蒂纳地区迈亚瓦利人土地相邻。河道、平原与水潭构成当地景观的一部分，水流随不规律的降雨而显著变化。

english: Karvandar lies in the mountains of Iranian Baluchistan, where the headwaters of the Bampur River gather. The river flows south past Damin and Iranshahr, then turns west towards Bampur and the Jaz Murian basin. Water can disappear into the porous deposits of the valley and emerge again farther downstream. In this dry country the river and its valley sustain cultivated land between the hills.
simp_chinese: 卡尔万达尔位于伊朗俾路支斯坦山区，班布尔河的源流在此汇集。河流向南经过达明和伊朗沙赫尔，再转向西方，流往班布尔及贾兹穆里安盆地。水流有时渗入河谷疏松沉积层，在下游重新涌出。在干旱地区，河流及其谷地为山丘之间的耕地提供水源。

english: Karvuna was the name of a district on the western Black Sea coast of Dobruja and of a port marked on medieval sea charts. Its coastal lands formed part of the principality associated with the rulers Balik and Dobrotitsa. Archaeological evidence places the centre of that principality at the fortress of Kaliakra, on a rocky cape projecting into the sea. The name Karvuna appears on portolan charts from the fourteenth century, when mariners used them to find harbours along this coast.
simp_chinese: 卡尔瓦纳是多布罗加西黑海沿岸一片地区的名称，也是中世纪海图所标记的一处港口。沿海土地属于与巴利克和多布罗季察两位统治者有关的公国。考古证据表明，该公国的中心位于伸入海中的岩石海角，即卡利亚克拉要塞。十四世纪起，卡尔瓦纳之名出现在航海图上，水手凭借这些海图寻找沿岸港口。

english:
Karwar is a harbour on the Kanara coast near the mouth of the Kali River. Its sheltered inlet linked the Arabian Sea with routes through the Western Ghats to inland markets such as Hubli. Pepper from the hills of Sonda, cardamom and cotton cloth passed through the port, attracting merchants from Arabia and beyond. Under Bijapur, Karwar became one of the most important ports on the western coast.

In 1638 the English Courteen Association established a trading house at nearby Kadwad, later incorporated into the East India Company’s network. The English bought and sold cloth and spices in a trade connecting the coast with weaving centres on the plateau. Shivaji raided Karwar in 1665 and the Marathas later gained influence in the area. On the northern bank of the Kali, the rulers of Sonda built Sadashivgad fort in 1715, adding another stronghold to a coast contested by regional rulers and European merchants.
simp_chinese:
卡尔瓦尔是卡纳拉海岸的港口，靠近卡利河口。受庇护的海湾将阿拉伯海与穿越西高止山脉、通往胡布利等内陆市场的道路连接起来。松达山地出产的胡椒、小豆蔻与棉布经此港转运，吸引阿拉伯等地的商人。比贾布尔统治时期，卡尔瓦尔成为西海岸最重要的港口之一。

1638年，英国科廷商社在附近卡德瓦德设立商馆，后来并入东印度公司的贸易网络。英国商人买卖布匹和香料，使海岸与高原上的织造中心相连。希瓦吉于1665年袭击卡尔瓦尔，马拉塔人后来在此地获得影响力。卡利河北岸，松达统治者于1715年修建萨达希夫加德堡，为地方政权与欧洲商人争夺的海岸增添了一座要塞。

english:
Karymkary lies on the right bank of the Ob, in the Khanty river country of western Siberia. Nearby was Karing-vosh, remembered as the Sterlet Town, one of the settlements of the Koda principality. Its fortified site stood north of the present village beside Karymkarsky Sor lake. Archaeological dating places this stronghold in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries; another fortified site farther northeast spans the late fifteenth to mid-seventeenth centuries.

Koda's rulers belonged to the Alachev family. During Russian expansion into Siberia, their cooperation with Moscow allowed them to retain substantial local authority, including tribute collection and jurisdiction over dependent Khanty communities. This arrangement connected Indigenous political structures with the advancing Russian state. The Karymkary country consequently formed part of a network of fortified river settlements, rather than an isolated forest outpost. Its early history combines Khanty authority along the Ob with the negotiated and unequal relationships through which Russian rule took shape.
simp_chinese:
卡雷姆卡雷位于鄂毕河右岸的西西伯利亚汉特人河流地域。附近的卡林沃什意为“小体鲟城”，曾是科达公国的聚落之一。其堡寨遗址坐落在今村以北的卡雷姆卡尔索尔湖旁，年代属于十六至十七世纪；更东北的另一座堡寨则延续于十五世纪末至十七世纪中叶。

科达统治者来自阿拉切夫家族。俄国向西伯利亚扩张时，他们与莫斯科合作，得以保留相当的地方权力，包括向所属汉特社群征收贡赋及行使司法权。这种安排将原住民政治结构与推进中的俄国国家联系起来。卡雷姆卡雷一带由此属于河流堡寨构成的网络。它的早期历史，结合了鄂毕河沿岸的汉特权威，以及俄国统治逐渐形成时经由协商建立的不平等关系。

english:
Karystos occupied a fortified landscape in southern Euboea, where Castello Rosso overlooked the district from the foothills of Mount Ochi. Built from red stone on an earlier Byzantine stronghold, the castle became a focus of Latin lordship. The waterfront fortress of Bourtzi formed another part of the town's medieval coastal defences, linking control of the harbour with protection inland.

The fourteenth century brought competing claims to Karystos. Documents show negotiations involving the Hospitallers and Venice in the 1350s; the final Venetian acquisition followed in 1366. Ottoman conquest in 1470 began a much longer period of rule. Settlements developed around Castello Rosso, including Myloi and nearby villages, making the hilltop fortress a continuing centre of the district. The Greek rising of 1821 did not secure the area by military victory. Ottoman forces withdrew in 1833 under the diplomatic settlement, bringing Karystos into the Greek state near the end of the period.
simp_chinese:
卡里斯托斯位于埃维亚岛南部的设防地带，奥希山麓的红堡俯瞰周围地区。这座以红色石材建造、利用更早拜占庭堡址的城堡，成为拉丁领主统治的中心。海滨布尔齐堡则属于城镇中世纪海防的一部分，将港口控制与内陆防御联系起来。

14世纪，各方争夺卡里斯托斯。文献显示，1350年代医院骑士团与威尼斯参与相关谈判；威尼斯最终于1366年取得当地。1470年的奥斯曼征服开启了更长的统治时期。米洛伊及邻近村落等聚落环绕红堡发展，使山顶堡垒继续充当地区中心。1821年的希腊起义未能通过军事胜利取得这里。1833年，奥斯曼军队依据外交安排撤离，卡里斯托斯在这一时期结束前成为希腊国家的一部分。

english:
Karytaina rises above the Alpheios River near its meeting with the Lousios. Its castle crowns a steep rocky hill, built in the thirteenth century by Geoffrey of Briel, a Frankish baron of the Principality of Achaea. The stronghold commanded approaches between the Arcadian plateau and the western plains, while a stone bridge carried travellers across the river below.

The Byzantines recovered Karytaina in 1320, and the Ottomans took it in 1460. After a period of Venetian rule, the town returned to Ottoman hands in 1715 and prospered as a district centre and market, even as the old castle fell into disrepair. During the Greek War of Independence, Theodoros Kolokotronis restored the fortress and used it as a base and a place of refuge.
simp_chinese:
卡里泰纳高踞阿尔菲奥斯河畔，靠近卢西奥斯河汇入处。城堡耸立在陡峭岩峰上，由亚该亚公国的法兰克男爵布里埃尔的若弗鲁瓦于十三世纪修建。要塞控制着阿卡迪亚高原与西部平原之间的通道，山下的石桥则让旅人得以渡河。

拜占庭人于1320年收复卡里泰纳，奥斯曼人又在1460年占领此地。经过一段威尼斯统治后，城镇于1715年重归奥斯曼，作为地区治所和市场日益繁荣，旧城堡却逐渐荒废。希腊独立战争期间，西奥多罗斯·科洛科特罗尼斯修复堡垒，将它作为据点和避难所。

english: Karzin lies in the warm southern valleys of Fars, near Qir and the routes towards the Persian Gulf. It was known as a town with many date palms, watered by the Zakan River and protected by a strong fortress. The district belonged to the wider country of Ardashir Khurra, whose centre lay to the north at Firuzabad. Fields, palm groves and fortified settlements occupied the valleys between the long parallel ranges of the southern Zagros.
simp_chinese: 卡尔津位于法尔斯南部温暖谷地，靠近基尔和通往波斯湾的道路。这是一座有许多椰枣树的城镇，扎坎河为其供水，坚固堡垒提供防护。当地属于更广阔的阿尔达希尔胡拉地区，中心位于北面的菲鲁扎巴德。田地、椰枣林和设防聚落分布在南扎格罗斯平行山脉之间的谷地里。

english:
Kaş occupied the site of Antiphellos on the mountainous Lycian coast. Known in Turkish as Andifli, the settlement faced the Mediterranean beneath steep cliffs, with the island of Kastellorizo a short distance offshore. Its inherited name recalled its ancient role as the harbor of Phellos, the inland settlement above it. Tombs and the coastal theater preserved traces of that earlier port within the landscape of the later town.

After Seljuk rule weakened, the surrounding country came under the Teke principality. Ottoman expansion subsequently brought this coast into the sultan's lands; the municipal history associates its incorporation with Bayezid I. Through the early modern centuries Andifli remained distinct from Kasaba in the interior, where the district's administrative center was located. The harbor and the inland seat thus occupied different places, connected across the rugged terrain of southern Anatolia. The coast's succession of Lycian, Byzantine, Seljuk and Ottoman names left Andifli with several historical identities, while its position between the uplands and the sea continued to define its setting.
simp_chinese:
卡什位于利西亚多山的海岸，承接古代安提费洛斯城址，土耳其语旧称安迪夫利。聚落背靠陡崖、面向地中海，近海便是卡斯特洛里佐岛。旧名保留着它作为山上费洛斯城港口的渊源；古墓与海边剧场也使早期港城的遗迹留在后来聚落的地景之中。

塞尔柱统治衰弱以后，周围地区归特克侯国控制，随后奥斯曼扩张将这段海岸纳入苏丹领土，地方市史将其归于巴耶济德一世时期。近世的安迪夫利与内陆卡萨巴仍是不同地点，后者才是当时的地区行政中心。港口与治所分别居于山海之间，经由崎岖地形相互联系。利西亚、拜占庭、塞尔柱和奥斯曼的相继统治留下了层层地名与遗存，背山面海的位置则始终构成安迪夫利的地理特点。

english:
Kasa was a district of Tango whose history became closely linked to Tanabe Castle and its town. Hosokawa Fujitaka established his residence there around 1581; the exact building chronology is uncertain, but a Noh performance held in the new residence in 1588 shows that it was largely ready by then. In 1600 the castle became the scene of the siege of Tanabe, one of the struggles preceding the battle of Sekigahara.

Under the Kyōgoku and Makino houses, Tanabe remained a centre of government. Fire transformed the town in 1727: after much of the castle town burned, the domain ordered the fishing settlement of Yoshihara, formerly north of the castle, to move to the right bank of the Isatsu River. Local memory was also gathered in the Kasa district geography begun by the domain retainer Isoda Kansui in 1735, which described villages, revenues, temples and changes to the castle town.
simp_chinese:
加佐是丹后的一郡，其历史后来与田边城及城下町紧密相连。细川藤孝约于1581年在此营建宅邸；具体建造进程尚不确定，但1588年“田边新殿”举行能会的记录表明，当时建筑已大致具备规模。1600年，这里成为田边笼城战的战场，该战属于关原之战前的一系列冲突。

京极氏、牧野氏统治时，田边继续担任领内行政中心。1727年的火灾改变了城镇面貌：城下大部焚毁后，田边藩命原居城北的吉原渔民迁往伊佐津川右岸。地方记忆也汇入藩士矶田闲水于1735年开始编写的加佐郡地志，书中记述村庄、收入、寺社，以及城池和城下町的变迁。

english: Kasai occupies the western part of the Tokachi plain, between the Tokachi and Satsunai rivers and the Hidaka Mountains. Before Japanese settlement expanded across the plain, Ainu communities lived in villages along the rivers and used the surrounding forests and waterways. The rivers descend from the mountains across a broad inland basin before reaching the Pacific. Place names in the region preserve traces of its Ainu inhabitants and their relationship with the land.
simp_chinese: 河西位于十胜平原西部，介于十胜川、札内川与日高山脉之间。日本人向平原大规模移居之前，阿伊努社群居住在沿河村落，利用周围森林和水道。河流从山地流过宽阔的内陆盆地，最终抵达太平洋。当地地名保存着阿伊努居民及其与土地关系的痕迹。

english: Kasakaupuyau is a long lake in the Caniapiscau country, its Naskapi name describing a narrow, brushy place. Other names recall fishing from its shores: the Naskapi also call it Waapinikuskaan, the lake where one fishes at dawn, while the Inuit name Irqasarvik refers to fishing with a line. The lake drains into the Caniapiscau River and lies along an inland route used by Naskapi travellers.
simp_chinese: 卡萨考普亚乌是卡尼亚皮斯科地区的一座狭长湖泊，其纳斯卡皮语名称描述了狭窄而灌木丛生的地方。其他名称则让人想起岸边的捕鱼活动：纳斯卡皮人也称它为瓦皮尼库斯坎，即“黎明捕鱼之湖”；因纽特语的伊尔卡萨维克则指用钓线捕鱼的地方。湖水流入卡尼亚皮斯科河，湖泊也位于纳斯卡皮旅人使用的内陆道路上。

english: Kasan was a small township north of Akhsi in the Fergana Valley, associated with the river that watered the larger centre downstream. Babur's memoirs give an unusually intimate picture of it around the turn of the sixteenth century. He praised its climate and the little gardens lining the watercourse, and recalled a rivalry with the people of Osh over which township possessed the more beautiful surroundings. This comparison places Kasan within a network of cultivated river settlements, each with its own local reputation. The town also lay within the contested inheritance of the Timurid princes. In 1494 Babur's young brother Nasir Mirza was at Kasan with his guardian, Ways Laghari, while Mahmud Khan advanced on Akhsi. The memoir's gardens and the prince's residence offer complementary glimpses of the same place: a modest, cultivated township connected to the larger politics of Fergana through its river and its ruling family.
simp_chinese: 渴塞是费尔干纳盆地阿赫昔以北的一处小城，与流向下游大城的河流相联系。《巴布尔回忆录》留下了约十五世纪末至十六世纪初的鲜明印象：巴布尔称赞这里的气候，以及沿着水道排列的小园圃，还提到渴塞人与奥什人相互争论，认为自己的城镇风景更加优美。这种比较展现了河谷农业聚落之间各有声誉的地方生活。渴塞也处在帖木儿诸王争夺的家族领地之中。1494年，马哈茂德汗进军阿赫昔时，巴布尔年幼的弟弟纳昔儿·米尔扎正与监护人韦斯·拉加里住在渴塞。园圃与王子寓居的记载，从两个侧面呈现出同一地点：它虽是规模不大的农业城镇，却通过河流和统治家族，与费尔干纳更广阔的政治世界保持联系。

english:
Kasaragod lies on the northern Malabar coast near the Chandragiri River. Its old Malik Dinar mosque at Thalangara is built in the regional Kerala style and is associated by tradition with an early Muslim preacher. The town’s religious life reflects the long presence of Muslim communities along the trading coast.

In the seventeenth century Shivappa Nayaka of Keladi strengthened his hold on the coast with a chain of forts. Chandragiri fort, built above the river southeast of Kasaragod, was one of these strongholds. Its position commanded the waterway and the approach to the sea. The fort formed part of the Nayakas’ efforts to control a coast divided among local rulers and visited by overseas merchants from across the Arabian Sea.
simp_chinese:
卡萨拉戈德位于马拉巴尔北部海岸，靠近昌德拉吉里河。塔兰加拉的古老马利克·迪纳尔清真寺采用喀拉拉地方建筑风格，传统将它与一位早期穆斯林传教者联系起来。城镇的宗教生活反映出穆斯林社群在贸易海岸上的悠久存在。

十七世纪，凯拉迪的希瓦帕·那耶迦以一系列堡垒加强对海岸的控制。建于卡萨拉戈德东南方河畔高地的昌德拉吉里堡便是其中之一，其位置控制水道和通往海洋的进路。堡垒属于那耶迦统治者控制这段海岸的努力：当地分属不同首领，也有海外商人往来。

english: Kasba Lake lies in the northern Canadian interior at the head of the Kazan River system. Its name preserves an Indigenous geographical vocabulary: In Dene usage kasba means “white partridge,” referring to the ptarmigan. The lake appears in Samuel Hearne's account of his northern journey in 1771. On 6 February he reached the side of a lake he called Cossed Whoie, or Partridge Lake; his chart labelled it Rock Partridge. This is Kasba Lake. The names tie an eighteenth-century travel record to Dene knowledge of the country, and show how Indigenous words and their English translations could take different forms on explorers' maps.
simp_chinese: 卡斯巴湖位于加拿大北部内陆，是卡赞河水系的源头湖泊。它的名称保存着原住民的地理词汇：在德内人的用法中，kasba意为“白鹧鸪”，所指为雷鸟。 该湖出现在塞缪尔·赫恩1771年的北行记述中。2月6日，他抵达一座称为Cossed Whoie或“鹧鸪湖”的湖边，地图上又将其标为Rock Partridge。这座湖就是卡斯巴湖。这些名称把18世纪的旅行记录同德内人对当地的认识联系起来，也显示原住民语词及其英语译名如何在探险者地图上形成不同写法。

english: Kaseg was a medieval settlement in Lika, in the country between the Velebit mountains and the interior of Croatia. A charter of King Béla IV mentioned it in 1263, and it served as the seat of the local vicar and archdeaconry of the bishopric of Nin. The district was later drawn into the frontier struggles between the Ottoman and Habsburg realms. The settlement that grew here became known as Gospić.
simp_chinese: 卡塞格是利卡的一处中世纪聚落，位于韦莱比特山脉与克罗地亚内陆之间。贝拉四世国王1263年的文书提及此地；它曾是宁主教区地方代牧和副主教辖区的驻所。后来，这片地区卷入奥斯曼与哈布斯堡之间的边境争斗。此处逐渐发展起来的聚落后来被称为戈斯皮奇。

english: Kasekete is associated with the early centres of the Mutapa state in northern Zimbabwe. Archaeological remains in the Dande and nearby country preserve evidence of settlements connected with Mutapa rulers. The rise of these centres in the fifteenth century marked a shift of political power towards the lands below the Zambezi escarpment.
simp_chinese: 卡塞克特与津巴布韦北部穆塔帕国家的早期中心有关。丹德及邻近地区的考古遗迹保留了与穆塔帕统治者相关的聚落证据。这些中心在十五世纪兴起，显示政治权力向赞比西断崖下方的土地转移。

english: Kasembe lies in the northern Luangwa valley, south of the Mwaleshi's meeting with the greater river. The Mwaleshi descends from the Muchinga escarpment through gorges and waterfalls, carrying clear water to the valley floor even in the dry season. Nearby are the Kalamulilo hot springs; mopane trees cover stretches of the warm lowland, giving way to miombo woodland on the escarpment.
simp_chinese: 卡森贝位于卢安瓜河谷北部，在姆瓦莱希河与大河汇合处以南。姆瓦莱希河从穆钦加陡崖流下，穿过峡谷和瀑布，即使在旱季也向谷底输送清澈河水。附近有卡拉穆利洛温泉；温暖低地上生长着莫帕内林，到了陡崖则逐渐被米翁博疏林取代。

english: Kasenga stands in the Bangweulu country, a landscape of shallow lakes, wooded ground and extensive wetlands in the upper Congo basin. Lake Bangweulu receives the Chambeshi and many smaller rivers, and drains southward through the Luapula. The lake and its surrounding swamps spread during the rains, and as the flood receded, grassland appeared along their margins for grazing. The dry rises between the channels carried villages, and the islands and reed beds supplied fish, fibre and building material. Canoes and footpaths linked the settlements, and the people who lived here traded fish and salt with the inland chiefdoms, while cattle herders brought their animals to the seasonal pastures.
simp_chinese: 卡森加位于班韦乌卢地区，这里是刚果河上游流域的浅湖、林地与广阔湿地。班韦乌卢湖接纳钱贝希河与许多小河，湖水经卢阿普拉河向南流出。雨季时湖泊与周围沼泽扩张，洪水退去后，湖畔边缘露出草地，供牲畜放牧。 水道之间较干的高地上建有村落，湖中岛屿和芦苇沼泽提供鱼类、纤维与建材。独木舟与小径把各聚落连接起来，居民与内陆酋邦交换鱼和盐，牧人则把牲畜赶到季节性草场。

english:
Kasesi lies in northern Moxico, in the inland country of rivers, woodland and cultivated clearings. Farming, hunting and fishing drew on varied resources across the region, and the seasonal rains set the rhythm of planting and travel. Villages were spread along the streams, with fields cleared from the woodland around them.

Lunda political traditions reached parts of this broad interior, while communities kept their own institutions and leaders. Trade routes carried ivory, wax and captives through a chain of intermediaries toward the western markets. Portuguese claims on the coast did not at first produce direct rule over the interior, which remained a patchwork of chiefdoms with their own alliances.
simp_chinese:
卡塞西位于安哥拉莫希科北部，周围是河流、林地与耕地交错的内陆。人们通过耕作、狩猎和捕鱼利用各种资源，季节性降雨决定了播种与行动的节奏。村落沿溪流分布，周围的林地被开垦为田地。

隆达政治传统影响了这一广阔内陆的部分地区，各社群同时保留了自己的制度与首领。贸易路线经由一连串中间人，把象牙、蜡和俘虏运往西方市场。葡萄牙在海岸提出的主权要求，起初并没有转化为对内陆的直接统治，内陆仍是由各自结盟的酋邦组成的拼合图景。

english: Kaset Sombun lies in the western part of the Khorat Plateau, near the forested Phu Khiao highlands. Streams from the mountains feed the Nam Phrom and the wider Chi River system. Valleys and plains lie below the wooded slopes, creating a varied landscape at the edge of the plateau. The rivers flow eastwards through northeastern Thailand before joining the Mekong drainage.
simp_chinese: 甲色颂汶位于呵叻高原西部，靠近森林覆盖的普乔高地。山间溪流补给南蓬河及更广阔的芝河水系，谷地和平原分布在有林山坡下方，使高原边缘形成多样地貌。这些河流向东穿过泰国东北部，最终汇入湄公河水系。

sources.title: 02ทะเบียนรายนามพื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำEng-3.pdf

english:
Kasevo, also known as Petropavlovka, was a village on the Shyvyryalka River in the western Ural country, now absorbed into Neftekamsk. Its inhabitants belonged to the category of palace peasants, rather than peasants owned by a private landlord. Grain cultivation was their principal occupation. A census of 1710 counted 42 inhabitants, while the first revision of 1719 recorded 136 peasant souls; these figures came from different administrative enumerations.

The village suffered during Pugachev's rebellion, when one of the rebel leader's associates ravaged the settlement and burned its church. A new Church of Saints Peter and Paul opened in 1825. From 1796 Kasevo lay in Birsk district of Orenburg province. These records place it within the agricultural settlements and changing administrative divisions west of the Urals, while the destruction and rebuilding of its church provide a local thread through the upheavals of the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese:
卡谢沃又称彼得罗巴甫洛夫卡，原是乌拉尔西部希维里亚尔卡河畔的村庄，后来并入涅夫捷卡姆斯克。居民属于宫廷农民，并非私人地主名下的农民，主要从事粮食种植。1710年人口调查记有42名居民，1719年第一次人口清查则登记136名农民人丁；两项数字来自不同的行政统计。

普加乔夫起义期间，一名起义军首领的同伙劫掠村庄，并烧毁教堂。新的圣彼得与圣保罗教堂于1825年开放。自1796年起，卡谢沃隶属奥伦堡省比尔斯克县。这些记录将村庄置于乌拉尔以西的农业聚落及行政区划变动之中，而教堂的毁坏与重建，则为十八世纪末至十九世纪初的动荡留下了一条具体的地方线索。

english:
Kasha Tampu, or Cajatambo, belonged to an Andean region reorganised after the Spanish conquest through encomiendas and then a corregimiento. The new jurisdiction established in 1576 reunited much of the territory of the earlier Inca province. Paths climbed the river valleys from the coast and joined routes towards Huaylas and Huánuco, carrying people and goods between settlements.

From the late sixteenth century, textile workshops sent cloth and sheep's wool through this network, while mining drew further traffic towards the coast. Silver discovered at Chingos in 1584 raised hopes of another Potosí, but within a few years miners were ruined and the centre failed to meet those expectations. Churches founded across the district in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries also gave the reorganised settlements new places of worship, adapted by local builders to Andean materials and Christian ritual.
simp_chinese:
卡沙坦普，即卡哈坦博，所在的安第斯地区在西班牙征服后先被划入各托管地，后来又设立行政辖区。1576年确立的新辖区重新整合了早期印加行省的大部分土地。道路从海岸沿河谷上行，接入通往瓦伊拉斯、瓦努科的路线，在聚落之间运送人员与货物。

十六世纪末起，纺织作坊通过这一路网输出呢布与绵羊毛，矿业又增加了通往海岸的运输。1584年钦戈斯发现白银，一度令人期待出现另一个波托西，但数年之后矿业经营者已陷入破产，矿区未能达到最初的期望。十六世纪至十七世纪初，各地聚落也建起教堂；地方工匠结合安第斯材料与基督教仪式需要，为重组后的社区营造新的礼拜场所。

english: Kashagawigamog is an Anishinaabe name meaning “lake of long and winding waters,” a fitting description of the narrow lake among the wooded hills north of the Kawartha waters. It forms part of a chain of lakes and rivers used by Indigenous travellers. Anishinaabe people continued to journey along the Gull and Burnt river systems to hunt, fish, trap and trade in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 卡沙加维加莫格是阿尼希纳贝语地名，意为“狭长蜿蜒水域之湖”，恰如其分地描绘了卡沃萨水域以北林木山丘中的这座狭湖。它是原住民旅人使用的一系列湖泊和河流的一部分。阿尼希纳贝人沿加尔河与伯恩特河水系旅行，在周围地区狩猎、捕鱼、设陷阱并进行交换。

english:
Kashan lies in a narrow oasis between the Karkas mountains and the great desert of central Iran. The spring at nearby Fin supplies water to gardens and settlements along the mountain foot. South of the city, the ancient mounds of Sialk bear witness to habitation reaching back thousands of years. Kashan itself grew into an important Islamic town, renowned for its crafts and the markets that linked the desert edge to the Iranian plateau.

Medieval Kashan became celebrated for fine pottery and lustre-painted tiles. Its potters worked with a hard, light-coloured body made largely of ground silica, and their wares travelled far beyond the town. The city's name became associated with glazed tilework in Persian and Arabic. After the Mongol destruction of 1224, ceramic production revived, and under the Ilkhanids workshops continued to make decorated vessels and architectural tiles.

Under the Safavids Kashan reached a new height of prosperity. Shah Abbas I favoured the city and developed the royal gardens at Fin, where spring water filled pools and fountains. The court often stopped there on journeys between its residences, and the shah chose to be buried in Kashan after his death in 1629. The oasis remained a place where royal patronage, commerce and skilled craftsmanship met at the edge of the desert.
simp_chinese:
卡尚坐落在卡尔卡斯山与伊朗中部大沙漠之间的狭长绿洲中。附近芬泉为山麓聚落和园林供水。城南锡亚尔克古丘见证了数千年前的人类居住；卡尚本身则成长为重要的伊斯兰城镇，以手工业和连接沙漠边缘与伊朗高原的市场闻名。

中世纪卡尚以精美陶器和金属光泽彩绘砖著称。陶工使用主要由研磨硅石制成的坚硬浅色胎体，作品远销城外。城市名称在波斯语和阿拉伯语中也与釉面砖相联系。1224年蒙古军队毁城后，陶业重新兴起；伊儿汗国时期，工坊继续制造装饰器皿和建筑砖饰。

萨法维统治下，卡尚进入新的繁荣时期。阿拔斯一世偏爱此城，扩建芬皇家园林，泉水注入池塘与喷泉。宫廷往返各驻地时常在此停留，沙阿1629年去世后按其意愿葬于卡尚。这片绿洲使王室赞助、贸易和精湛工艺在沙漠边缘汇聚。

english: Kashary lies in the valley of the Olkhovaya, amid the uplands between the Don and the Donets. The settlement was known as Verkhne-Olkhovaya when it first appeared in surviving records in 1790. That year its sixty-two households contained 383 peasants. Lands along the river belonged to the Pozdeyev and Sulin families, who established the sloboda and divided their holdings among their heirs. The Olkhovaya valley gave its earliest recorded name to the community that later became Kashary.
simp_chinese: 卡沙雷位于奥利霍瓦亚河谷，坐落在顿河与顿涅茨河之间的高地上。1790年，聚落首次见于现存文献，当时称为上奥利霍瓦亚。该年斯洛博达有62户，共383名农民。沿河土地属于波兹杰耶夫和苏林家族，他们建立聚落，并将地产分给继承人。奥利霍瓦亚河谷赋予了这处后来称为卡沙雷的社区最早有记录的名称。

english:
Kashatagh was the centre of an Armenian melik principality whose ruling family also maintained a seat at Khnatsakh. Between the fifteenth and eighteenth centuries the Melik-Haykazyans exercised a measure of local autonomy. Their lineage was associated with the Khaghbakyan-Proshyan princely house. A surviving mansion near the Tsitsernavanits tributary of the Aghavno River is attributed to Melik Haykaz I in the late fifteenth century.

Built on an artificial terrace against a rocky hillside, the residence combined domestic rooms, ceremonial space and an enclosing wall. Architectural investigation identified three adjoining halls fronted by an arched porch. A two-storey structure on the western side placed living accommodation below an upper reception chamber, covered by a barrel vault. These arrangements gave the melik a setting for household life and the reception of visitors within one compound. The residence belongs to a wider tradition of melik mansions in Artsakh and Syunik, while its particular plan preserves the material setting of Kashatagh's local ruling house.
simp_chinese:
卡沙塔格曾是亚美尼亚梅利克领地的中心，统治家族在赫纳察赫也设有驻所。十五至十八世纪，梅利克—海卡兹扬家族保持一定地方自治，其世系与哈赫巴克扬—普罗什扬诸侯家族相联系。阿哈夫诺河支流齐策尔纳瓦尼茨河附近的一座宅邸，被研究者归于十五世纪末的梅利克海卡兹一世。

宅邸建在岩石山坡上的人工台地，居住房间、礼仪空间与围墙组成同一院落。建筑调查辨识出三座并列厅堂，入口正面设拱廊。西侧两层建筑下层供起居，上层是筒形拱顶覆盖的会客厅，领主在此接见来访者。它属于阿尔察赫与休尼克地区梅利克宅邸的建筑传统，具体布局则保存了卡沙塔格地方统治家族的生活与礼仪环境。

english:
Kashaya country on the northern California coast included Metini, a village occupied for centuries before Russian colonization. Families moved seasonally between ridges, foothills and shore camps. Abalone, mussels, fish and sea plants complemented inland acorns and game; sea salt was gathered for use and exchange with neighbouring peoples.

In 1812 the Russian-American Company founded Fort Ross at Metini, bringing Russian and Alaskan settlers into Kashaya territory. In 1817 Kashaya leaders met Leontii Hagemeister in an agreement through which the company claimed permission to maintain its colony. Kashaya labour contributed to the settlement's agriculture, while work and intermarriage linked local people with the newcomers. The fort's farms were intended to provision Russian Alaska, and its hunting supplied the fur trade. Within a generation, an established Indigenous coastal landscape had become part of a commercial network stretching across the North Pacific.
simp_chinese:
加利福尼亚北部沿海的卡沙亚人土地包括梅蒂尼村，在俄罗斯殖民开始前，这里已有数百年的居住历史。家庭随季节在山脊、山麓与海岸营地之间移动，鲍鱼、贻贝、鱼和海生植物补充内陆的橡子与猎物，海盐则用于自用及与邻近群体交换。

1812年，俄美公司在梅蒂尼建立罗斯堡，俄罗斯与阿拉斯加移民进入卡沙亚人的土地。1817年，卡沙亚首领与列昂季·哈格迈斯特会面达成协议，公司据此主张获准维持殖民据点。卡沙亚人的劳动支持了聚落农业，工作与通婚又将当地人与新来者联系起来。堡垒农场旨在供应俄属阿拉斯加，狩猎则服务于毛皮贸易。在一代人的时间里，既有的原住民沿海生活地域，已进入横跨北太平洋的商业网络。

english:
Near the mouth of the Albany River, Kashechewan lies in the low country of western James Bay. Its name preserves a Cree word for the strong current of the river, known to the Mushkegowuk before it acquired its English name. The river brought people and furs from inland hunting grounds to the coast, where the Hudson's Bay Company established Fort Albany in the late seventeenth century.

The fort became a prize in the rivalry between French and English traders. An expedition from Québec captured it in 1686, and the English recovered it in 1693. The Mushkegowuk continued to trade with the small numbers of company men at the posts along the bay, drawing on relationships and routes that long predated their arrival.
simp_chinese:
卡舍切万位于奥尔巴尼河口附近、詹姆斯湾西部的低地。它的名称保留了形容河水湍急的克里语词汇，穆什凯戈乌克人在河流得到英文名之前便已使用。人们沿河将内陆猎场的毛皮带到海岸；十七世纪末，哈得孙湾公司在河口建立奥尔巴尼堡。

法英商人的竞争使这座堡垒成为争夺目标。1686年，一支来自魁北克的远征队攻占堡垒，英国人于1693年夺回。穆什凯戈乌克人继续与据点里人数不多的公司人员贸易，利用的社会关系和道路远早于这些商人的到来。

english: Kashigarh is remembered for its earthen fort in the Chhattisgarh country. The stronghold belongs to a landscape once shaped by the rulers of Ratanpur, the Kalachuri capital of Dakshina Kosala. Fortified places and temple centres marked this kingdom across the plains and their adjoining hills. The remains of Kashigarh preserve the name of one such stronghold, while the wider country passed into Maratha hands in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 卡希加尔因一座土堡而为人所知，位于恰蒂斯加尔地区。这里所在的土地曾受南拘萨罗卡拉丘里王朝的拉特纳普尔统治者影响。要塞与寺庙中心散布于平原及附近丘陵，留下这个王国的印记。卡希加尔遗址保存了其中一处堡垒的名称，而十八世纪这片广大地区转入马拉塔人之手。

english: Kashima in Hitachi was anchored by Kashima Jingū, whose early seventeenth-century rebuilding records the patronage of the Tokugawa rulers. Tokugawa Ieyasu donated a main sanctuary in 1605 in thanksgiving for victory at Sekigahara. When a new sanctuary was built fourteen years later, that earlier building was moved to become the Okumiya within the shrine precinct. In 1619, the second shogun, Tokugawa Hidetada, provided the present main group of halls: the sanctuary, connecting chamber, offering hall and worship hall. Their arrangement made successive stages of worship part of a single architectural ensemble. These donations gave the sacred site a material connection with the new shogunate. Kashima also entered the literary geography of Edo Japan: Matsuo Bashō visited in 1687, a journey remembered in his Kashima travel account. The shrine’s history supplies concrete local evidence without assigning its privileges or buildings to every settlement in the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 常陆国鹿岛以鹿岛神宫为重要中心。十七世纪初的营建，留下了德川统治者赞助当地神社的具体记录。1605年，德川家康为酬谢关原之战获胜而奉献本殿。十四年后新建社殿时，这座较早的建筑被迁往境内，成为奥宫。1619年，第二代将军德川秀忠奉献了现存主要殿宇组合，包括本殿、石之间、币殿和拜殿，将不同祭祀空间组织为相连的建筑群。这些营建使神宫与新成立的幕府建立了可见的物质联系。鹿岛也进入江户时代的文学地理：松尾芭蕉于1687年前来参拜，此行留下《鹿岛纪行》。神宫的历史为当地提供了明确线索，但其建筑与待遇不能直接推广为周围每座聚落的共同经历。

english:
The Kashima coast faces the Pacific on the eastern side of Japan, beside the agricultural country of Hitachi. Fishing communities worked a shore exposed to ocean swells, while rivers and nearby lakes linked coastal activity with the inland plains. Safe passages, weather knowledge and familiar landing places were essential to navigation. The sea provided food and transport but could also bring severe storms and shipwreck.

The wider region held religious importance through Kashima Shrine, whose traditions connected local sacred space with warriors and pilgrims across Japan. During the Tokugawa period, coastal shipping became increasingly important to the supply of Edo. Vessels carrying rice and other goods from northeastern domains travelled along Pacific routes, connecting provincial production with the growing shogunal capital. Crews relied on experience and local knowledge to navigate difficult coastal conditions.
simp_chinese:
鹿岛滩面向日本东部太平洋，旁侧是常陆农业地区。渔业社区在受远洋涌浪影响的海岸劳动，河流与附近湖泊则把沿海活动同内陆平原连接起来。安全水道、天气知识和熟悉登陆点，是航行的重要条件。海洋提供食物与运输，也可能带来强风和船难。

鹿岛神宫赋予这一地区宗教意义，其传统将地方圣地同日本各地的武士和朝圣者联系起来。德川时期，沿海航运对江户的补给日益重要。装载东北诸藩稻米等货物的船只沿太平洋航线行驶，把地方生产同不断发展的幕府都城连接起来。船员依靠经验和地方知识应对艰难海况。

english: Kashin stood on the Kashinka River, with a hilltop kremlin protected by the river and deep ditches. It became part of the Moscow state in 1485, but its religious institutions remained central to local life. In 1650 Tsar Aleksei Mikhailovich came with his family for the transfer of Princess Anna of Kashin's relics from the Dormition Cathedral to the Resurrection Cathedral. He made substantial gifts to churches and monasteries and ordered improvements to the town's fortifications, gates and bridges. The later eighteenth century brought another kind of rebuilding. A regular town plan was approved in 1777, and the coat of arms granted in 1780 displayed three mortars of white pigment, recalling a local manufacturing speciality. The combination of river defences, pilgrimage and civic rebuilding gave Kashin a distinct history within the towns of the Tver country.
simp_chinese: 卡申坐落在卡申卡河畔，山上的克里姆林由河流与深壕保护，1485年并入莫斯科国家。宗教机构继续深刻影响地方生活。1650年，沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇携家人到访，参加安娜公妃圣髑从圣母安息主教座堂移至复活主教座堂的仪式；他向城内教堂与修道院捐赠财物，并下令修整防御设施、城门和桥梁。十八世纪后期，卡申又经历新的城市规划：1777年获准实行规整布局，1780年的市徽则绘有三只盛放白色颜料的臼，纪念当地著名的生产行业。河流防御、宗教朝礼和市政重建，构成这座特维尔地区城镇的具体历史面貌。

english:
Kashipur lies below the hills of Kumaon, near the site of the ancient settlement of Govishana. The Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang visited Govishana in the seventh century and described a lofty, defensible town surrounded by groves and pools. Kashipur takes its later name from Kashinath Adhikari, a governor serving the Chand kings of Kumaon and credited with founding the town.

In the latter half of the eighteenth century Nand Ram, the governor, became effectively independent and established a local kingdom. His successor Shib Lal ceded Kashipur to the British in 1801. During the Anglo-Nepalese War the town played a part in the campaign that brought Kumaon under Company rule. In 1824 Bishop Heber visited on his way to Almora and described Kashipur as a Hindu place of pilgrimage.
simp_chinese:
加希布尔位于库马昂山麓，靠近古代戈维沙纳聚落的遗址。七世纪中国僧人玄奘到访戈维沙纳，记述它地势高峻、易守难攻，周围有树林和池塘。加希布尔后来的名字来自卡希纳特·阿迪卡里，他是侍奉库马昂昌德诸王的总督，被认为建立了这座城镇。

十八世纪后半叶，总督南德·拉姆取得事实上的独立，建立地方王国。其继承者希布·拉尔于1801年将加希布尔割让给英国。英尼战争期间，这座城镇参与了使库马昂转入公司统治的军事行动。1824年，赫伯主教前往阿尔莫拉途中到访，称加希布尔是一处印度教朝圣地。

english: Kashkanteniz is a shallow salt lake in the dry country south of Lake Balkhash. Its elongated basin lies among the plains of the Moyynkum region, where the extent of the water changes with the seasons. The lake and its surrounding salt flats stand out amid the arid steppe, a reminder that even an inland basin can gather the waters that run down from the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 喀什坎腾吉兹是巴尔喀什湖以南干旱地带的一座浅盐湖。狭长的湖盆位于莫因库姆地区的平原之间，水域范围随季节变化。湖泊与周围盐地在干旱草原上格外醒目，展示了内陆洼地如何汇集周围土地流来的水。

english:
Kashkarantsy lies on the White Sea's Tersky Coast, where salmon fishing tied coastal livelihoods to monastic estates. In 1470 the Novgorodian noblewoman Marfa Boretskaya transferred her coastal holding, including fishing grounds around Kashkarantsy, to the Solovetsky Monastery. The property remained monastic for almost three centuries.

An inventory from 1669 gives an unusually concrete picture of the fishing establishment. It listed a new chapel, monks' quarters, a dining building, four storehouses, twelve fishing nets and seven boats. Salt, cooking facilities and structures for smoking and drying fish completed the operation. These details show how worship, residence, boat work and preservation of the catch occupied the same coastal site. Kashkarantsy's history was shaped by the practical organisation needed to turn seasonal salmon runs into a durable food supply.
simp_chinese:
卡什卡兰齐位于白海捷尔斯基海岸，鲑鱼捕捞将居民生计与修道院地产联系起来。1470年，诺夫哥罗德贵族玛尔法·博列茨卡娅将沿海领地，包括卡什卡兰齐周边渔场，转交索洛韦茨基修道院。此后近三个世纪，这处产业一直归修道院所有。

1669年的清册留下了异常具体的渔业场景：新建的小教堂、僧舍、食堂、四座仓库、十二张渔网和七艘船。清单还列出盐、炊事设施，以及熏鱼和晾鱼建筑。礼拜、居住、船务和鱼获保存，由此集中在同一处滨海场所。卡什卡兰齐的历史，离不开把季节性鲑鱼洄游转化为可长期储存食物所需的组织与劳动。

english: Kashmar stands on the southern side of the Kuh-e Sorkh in Khorasan, in a district long associated with Torshiz. The historic town of Torshiz lay farther west before its centre moved east toward Kashmar during the eighteenth century. Kashmar's Friday Mosque belongs to the late eighteenth century; its brick structure, courtyard and iwan reflect the continuing importance of communal worship in the town.
simp_chinese: 卡什马尔位于呼罗珊的库赫索尔赫山南麓，所在地区长期与托尔希兹的名称相联系。历史上的托尔希兹城原在更西面，十八世纪城市中心才向东移往卡什马尔一带。卡什马尔的主麻清真寺建于十八世纪末，其砖砌建筑、庭院和伊万厅体现了集体礼拜在城镇中的持续重要性。

english: The mountains northeast of the Kashmir Valley rise into the great Himalayan range. Their snow-covered ridges enclose the valley opposite the lower Pir Panjal, while the Sind River descends through the mountains towards the Jhelum. High passes lead east towards Ladakh, and tributary streams carry meltwater into the cultivated country below. In winter snow closes many of the routes that cross these heights.
simp_chinese: 克什米尔谷地东北的山岭向大喜马拉雅山脉升起。积雪山脊与对面较低的比尔潘贾尔山脉共同环抱谷地，信德河则穿过群山流向杰赫勒姆河。高山口向东通往拉达克，支流将融雪送入下方的耕作地区。冬季积雪会封闭许多越岭道路。

english: Kashmore lies beside the Indus at the northern approach to Sindh, where the river descends from the Punjab towards the lower valley. The broad floodplain is shaped by changing channels and seasonal inundation. Cultivation depends on water drawn from the river, while routes along its banks connect Sindh with the lands upstream. The nearby dry country rises westward towards the hills of Balochistan.
simp_chinese: 卡什莫尔位于印度河畔、信德北部入口处，河流从旁遮普向下游河谷流去。不断变化的水道和季节性洪水塑造了宽阔平原。耕作依靠从河中引出的水，沿岸道路则将信德与上游地区连接起来。附近干燥土地向西升起，通往俾路支斯坦山地。

english: Kashtruk is the Indigenous name associated with the Gastre country of northern Patagonia, a dry plateau crossed by routes in several directions. The nearby stream and plain bear the same name. The area lay on an Indigenous route through the plateau towards the Chubut River, linking stopping places across a landscape where reliable water was precious. Its name preserves a connection with the Gününa Küne people of the region.
simp_chinese: 卡什特鲁克是巴塔哥尼亚北部加斯特雷一带的原住民名称。这片干燥高原上，多条道路向不同方向延伸，附近的溪流和平原也以此得名。通向丘布特河的原住民路线穿过高原，把各处歇脚地连在一起；在这片土地上，可靠的水源尤为珍贵。地名保存了这里与居努纳库内人的联系。

english:
Kasihta, also written Cusseta, was one of the principal Muscogee towns whose history joined the Ocmulgee country to the Chattahoochee valley. Muscogee oral traditions placed Kasihta among the founding communities of their people. These traditions describe migrations and relationships between towns, preserving a political past that cannot be reduced to the history of a single fixed settlement.

After the Yamasee War of 1715–1716, the Lower Creek towns were established along the Chattahoochee. Cusseta appears among them on the Herbert map of 1725 and again on the Mitchell map of the mid-eighteenth century, alongside Coweta and other neighbouring communities. The maps record a river landscape occupied by distinct towns, rather than an undifferentiated frontier. Kasihta's identity thus combined its own community and traditions with participation in the larger Muscogee confederacy. Its name survived changes of settlement and the growing colonial pressure upon the river country, retaining the memory of a town central to Muscogee accounts of their origins.
simp_chinese:
卡西塔亦写作库塞塔，是马斯科吉人的重要城镇之一，其历史连接着奥克马尔吉河地区与查塔胡奇河谷。马斯科吉口述传统将卡西塔列为族群的创始社群之一，讲述城镇间的迁徙与关系。这些传统保存的是政治共同体的历史，难以简单等同于一处始终未曾迁移的聚落。

1715至1716年亚马西战争之后，下克里克各镇在查塔胡奇河沿岸形成聚落。1725年的赫伯特地图已将库塞塔与考韦塔等邻近社群标在河畔，十八世纪中叶的米切尔地图仍记录了相近的城镇分布。地图展现的是由不同城镇共同占据的河流世界，每个城镇都有自己的身份。卡西塔既保有自身传统，又参与较大的马斯科吉联盟；即使聚落位置改变、殖民扩张带来的压力日益加重，其名称仍延续着这个重要社群在马斯科吉起源叙述中的地位。

english:
Kasimov stands on the Oka amid the forests of the Meshchera country. Once known as Gorodets Meshchersky, it became the seat of a Tatar khanate under Muscovite overlordship. Its mosques and tombs recall a Muslim ruling house and a community whose history was closely intertwined with that of the Russian state.

In the middle of the fifteenth century Qasim, a son of the Kazan khan Uluğ Muhammad, entered the service of Grand Prince Vasily II and received the town that took his name. The rulers of Kasimov were Chinggisids, but their authority was constrained by Moscow, which nominated or confirmed them and appointed a Russian governor. They collected tribute from a population that included Mordvins, Meshcherans, Russians and Tatars. The town also offered refuge to other displaced Tatar princes, some of whom served Moscow in campaigns against rival khanates.

The khanate lasted until the death of its last ruler, Fatima Sultan, in 1681, after which its lands passed directly under Russian administration. Kasimov remained a town of Russian and Tatar communities on the Oka. Its surviving religious buildings and mausoleums preserve a distinctive legacy of the time when a Muslim court stood within the orbit of Moscow. The river carried the town’s connections beyond its immediate hinterland, joining the Oka to the Volga and to the markets of central Russia.
simp_chinese:
卡西莫夫坐落在梅晓拉林地中的奥卡河畔，旧称梅晓拉哥罗杰茨，后来成为莫斯科宗主权下鞑靼汗国的都城。清真寺和陵墓令人想起这个穆斯林统治家族及其社群，也见证了它们与俄罗斯国家交织的历史。

15世纪中叶，喀山汗兀鲁·穆罕默德之子卡西姆投奔莫斯科大公瓦西里二世，获得了这座后来以他命名的城镇。卡西莫夫统治者是成吉思汗的后裔，但其权力受到莫斯科限制：大公任命或确认汗位，并派遣俄罗斯总督。汗向莫尔多瓦人、梅晓拉人、俄罗斯人和鞑靼人等居民征收贡赋。这里也为其他失去领地的鞑靼王公提供避难之所，其中一些人为莫斯科效力，参与对敌对汗国的战争。

1681年，末代统治者法蒂玛苏丹去世，汗国领地随之直接归俄罗斯管辖。卡西莫夫仍是奥卡河畔俄罗斯人与鞑靼人共同生活的城镇；宗教建筑和陵墓保存了穆斯林宫廷曾存在于莫斯科势力范围内的独特遗产。奥卡河也将城镇与更远的地区相连，通过伏尔加河通往俄罗斯中部的市场。

english: Kashipur lies in the uplands of southern Odisha, in a country of wooded hills and river valleys. The area formed part of the Kalahandi state, where local estates governed territory between the coastal plain and the interior. The hills surrounding Kashipur belong to the Eastern Ghats, a landscape crossed by streams and occupied by farming and forest communities. Their ridges separate the inland country from the lower lands toward the Bay of Bengal.
simp_chinese: 卡西布尔位于奥里萨南部高地，周围是林木覆盖的丘陵与河谷。此地曾属于卡拉汉迪邦，地方领地在海岸平原和内陆之间管理土地。卡西布尔周边山地属于东高止山脉，溪流穿行其间，农耕与森林社群生活于此。山脊将内陆地区与通向孟加拉湾的低地分隔开来。

english:
Käsivarsi belongs to the far northwestern fell country of Lapland. Sámi reindeer pastoralism became established here during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, linking seasonal grazing lands across what later became national frontiers. Herding families moved toward the Arctic coast in summer and returned inland with the seasons. Fishing and handicrafts complemented a livelihood dependent on access to different parts of this mountain landscape.

In 1751 Denmark-Norway and Sweden, which then included Finland, agreed on a northern boundary. The line crossed established Sámi land-use areas. An accompanying agreement, the Lapp Codicil, therefore recognised customary movement with reindeer across the border, as well as related rights and obligations. It acknowledged that herders required land on both sides rather than a livelihood contained within one state. Finland's transfer to Russian rule in 1809 changed the political setting again. For Käsivarsi's early modern communities, the meaning of a frontier consequently depended on how rulers dealt with inherited seasonal routes and access to pasture.
simp_chinese:
卡西瓦伦即拉普兰最西北部的卡西瓦尔西山地。十七、十八世纪，萨米驯鹿牧业在此发展，将后来分属不同国家的季节牧场联系起来。牧民夏季向北冰洋海岸移动，再随季节返回内陆；捕鱼与手工艺补充生计，而放牧依赖使用群山中不同地域。

1751年，丹麦—挪威与当时包括芬兰的瑞典议定北方边界，新线穿过萨米既有土地利用区。附加的《拉普法典》因而承认依习惯携鹿群越境迁移，以及相关权利和义务，明确牧民需要边界两侧土地。1809年，芬兰转归俄国统治，政治环境再次改变。对近世卡西瓦尔西社群而言，边界的实际意义，因此取决于统治者如何对待继承的季节路线与牧场使用。

english: The forested mountains between the Pelly and upper Liard rivers form part of the homeland of the Kaska Dena. Families travelled through this rugged country in seasonal rounds, hunting and gathering across river valleys and high ground. Some journeyed to the Pelly when salmon returned, while others hunted along the Liard and its tributaries. The Ross and Pelly confluence was a meeting place for travellers crossing between these watersheds.
simp_chinese: 佩利河与利亚德河上游之间森林覆盖的山地，是卡斯卡德内人家园的一部分。各家庭随季节穿行于崎岖的河谷和高地，狩猎采集。有些人会在鲑鱼洄游时前往佩利河，另一些人则沿利亚德河及支流狩猎。罗斯河与佩利河的汇合处是往来于不同流域的旅人聚集之地。

english: Kaskankaham lies near the Sangamon River in the prairie country west of Decatur. In 1830 Thomas Lincoln's family arrived from Indiana and built a homestead on high ground on the river's north bank. The land was suitable for farming, but illness and a severe winter persuaded the family to move on the following year. Abraham Lincoln left separately and later settled at New Salem, farther down the Sangamon.
simp_chinese: 卡斯坎卡汉靠近迪凯特以西草原地区的桑加蒙河。1830年，托马斯·林肯一家从印第安纳迁来，在河流北岸的高地建立家园。这里的土地适合耕作，但疾病与严冬促使家人在次年迁走。亚伯拉罕·林肯则另行离开，后来在桑加蒙河下游的新塞勒姆定居。

english:
The Kaskaskia River flows southwest across the Illinois country to join the Mississippi. It takes its name from one of the peoples of the Illinois, whose villages and fields once lay across the region. The French explorers Jolliet and Marquette visited a Kaskaskia village on the upper Illinois River in 1673, opening a period of sustained contact with French traders and missionaries.

In 1703 Kaskaskia people and Jesuit missionaries established a settlement near the river's mouth. French traders settled alongside them, and the village grew into a centre of the Illinois country. Epidemics, including smallpox in 1704, took a heavy toll on the Kaskaskia people. A French earthwork fort was built in 1759, shortly before the territory passed to Britain. Kaskaskia later became the capital of the Illinois Territory in 1809.
simp_chinese:
卡斯卡斯基亚河向西南流经伊利诺伊地区，汇入密西西比河。河流得名于伊利诺伊人的一支，他们的村庄和田地曾分布在广大地区。1673年，法国探险者若利埃和马凯特访问了伊利诺伊河上游的一座卡斯卡斯基亚村庄，由此开始了与法国商人和传教士长期接触的时期。

1703年，卡斯卡斯基亚人和耶稣会传教士在河口附近建立聚落。法国商人也在他们身旁定居，村庄逐渐发展为伊利诺伊地区的中心。包括1704年天花在内的疫病给卡斯卡斯基亚人造成严重损失。1759年，法国人在此建造土筑堡垒，不久这片领地便转归英国。1809年，卡斯卡斯基亚又成为伊利诺伊领地的首府。

english: The Kaskinampo lived in the lower Tennessee and Cumberland river country, where broad bottomlands and river islands gave good ground for corn and beans. French accounts of the early eighteenth century placed an earlier home on the Cumberland, and around 1701 the people appear on an island in the Tennessee. Both rivers carried forms of their name, and the Tennessee kept the name long after the people had moved. After the early eighteenth century the Kaskinampo no longer appear as a separate community; they merged with the Koasati and other Muskogean-speaking groups who travelled the river routes between the Mississippi and the southern Appalachians.
simp_chinese: 卡斯基南波人生活在田纳西河与坎伯兰河下游一带，这里的宽阔河滩与河中小岛适合种植玉米和豆类。十八世纪初的法国记载称，他们早先住在坎伯兰河畔；约1701年，他们已出现在田纳西河的一座岛上。两条河都曾带有他们名称的形式，田纳西河上的这个名字在人群迁走之后仍沿用了很久。十八世纪初以后，卡斯基南波人不再作为独立社群出现，他们并入了科阿萨蒂人及其他讲穆斯科格语的群体，这些人沿密西西比河与南阿巴拉契亚之间的河道往来。

english:
Kaslinsky takes its name from the Kasli district of the southern Urals. The ironworks at Kasli was founded in 1747 by Yakov Korobov, a merchant from Tula. Five years later Nikita Demidov bought the works, incorporating it into the holdings of a family with factories across the Urals and Siberia. During the eighteenth century the plant smelted cast iron and processed it into ploughshare, strip and lump iron.

At the beginning of the nineteenth century, the merchant Lev Rastorguev acquired the factory for 700,000 roubles. Kasli later became celebrated for ornamental cast iron, but its earlier output supplied much more practical needs. The succession of merchant and industrialist owners places the locality within the expansion of privately owned Ural ironmaking during the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese:
卡斯林斯基之名对应南乌拉尔的卡斯利地区。1747年，来自图拉的商人雅科夫·科罗博夫在卡斯利建立铁厂。五年后，尼基塔·杰米多夫买下工厂，将它纳入其家族遍布乌拉尔和西伯利亚的产业。十八世纪，铁厂冶炼生铁，再将其加工成犁铧铁、条铁和块铁。

十九世纪初，商人列夫·拉斯托尔古耶夫以七十万卢布购得铁厂。卡斯利后来以装饰性铸铁闻名，较早时期的产品则主要满足实际生产需求。商人与实业家相继经营这座铁厂的经历，展示了十八世纪至十九世纪初乌拉尔私人冶铁业扩张的一段地方历史。

english: Kasris Kari guarded a passage at the northern edge of Dvaleti, the mountainous country between Kartli and the lands of the Ossetians. The Georgian geographer Vakhushti described a great gate of rock and mortared stone built across the river to prevent passage without leave. Beyond it lay the narrow valleys and towered settlements of Dvaleti, whose mountain routes were passable for only part of the year. Control of these northern approaches mattered to the Georgian kings, though their authority over the highlands weakened as the kingdom fragmented.
simp_chinese: 卡斯里斯卡里扼守着德瓦列季北缘的一处通道。德瓦列季山地位于卡特利与奥塞梯人居地之间，峡谷狭窄，村落中立有塔楼，山路一年只有部分时节可以通行。格鲁吉亚地理学家瓦赫什蒂记述，这里横跨河流筑有一道巨大的石门，用岩石和灰浆砌成，以阻止未经许可的人通过。格鲁吉亚诸王重视这些通往北方的入口，但随着王国分裂，他们对山地的控制也逐渐削弱。

english: Kassai is the country of the upper Kasai River, which rises on the Angolan plateau and flows north towards the Congo basin. Its headwaters and tributaries cut across uplands, where falls and rapids interrupt their descent. The great river gathers waters from a wide inland region before joining the Congo, linking the wooded plateau to the immense river system farther north.
simp_chinese: 卡赛位于卡赛河上游流域。这条河发源于安哥拉高原，向北流向刚果盆地；源流和支流切过高地，瀑布与急流时而打断河道。卡赛河汇集广阔内陆的水流，最终注入刚果河，把林木覆盖的高原与北方庞大水系连接起来。

english: Kassala lies beside the seasonal Gash River, beneath the striking granite hills of eastern Sudan. The river descends from the Eritrean highlands and spreads into a delta in the dry plains. Before the growth of the town, the Gash country was used by Beja pastoral communities, for whom grazing and access to water were central to life in the Atbai.
simp_chinese: 卡萨拉位于季节性加什河畔，苏丹东部醒目的花岗岩山丘脚下。河流自厄立特里亚高地下行，在干燥平原展开为三角洲。城镇发展以前，加什地区是贝贾牧民使用的土地；在阿特拜地区，牧场与水源对他们的生活至关重要。

english:
Kassali lies in the wooded interior of central Congo, in the Lomami basin, where rivers cut through a mosaic of forest and savanna. Farming supplied the household, with cassava, maize and groundnuts grown on cleared ground. Fishing in the streams, hunting in the woods and the gathering of palm products and wild fruit added to the food supply, and paths and waterways carried goods between neighbouring villages.

To the west, along the Sankuru and Kasai rivers, the Kuba kingdom kept a court famous for its woodcarving, embroidered raffia cloth and royal ritual. Farther south and east, between the upper Lomami and Lualaba rivers, Luba political and cultural ideas spread across the central savanna, and by the eighteenth century Luba chiefs and their followers had extended their influence over a broad part of the region. Kassali's people lived between these centres of power and drew on both.
simp_chinese:
卡萨利位于刚果中部的内陆林地，处在洛马米河流域，河流穿过森林与稀树草原交错的地带。农业供养家庭，人们在开垦的空地上种植木薯、玉米和落花生。溪流中捕鱼，林中狩猎，采集棕榈产品和野果，小径与水道则把相邻村落联系起来。

西面沿桑库鲁河与开赛河，库巴王国保有一座以木雕、刺绣棕榈布和王室礼仪闻名的宫廷。更南面、洛马米河上游与卢阿拉巴河之间，卢巴的政治与文化观念扩散到中部草原；到十八世纪，卢巴首领及其追随者的影响已覆盖该地区的大片地方。卡萨利的居民生活在这些权力中心之间，并从两者中汲取了资源与礼仪。

english: Kassandreia is the inland town on the Kassandra peninsula that was known as Valta during the Ottoman period. The name recalls ancient Cassandreia, but the old city near the peninsula's neck and the inland settlement should be distinguished. Valta had become an important commercial centre by the sixteenth century, and its ecclesiastical importance was marked by the presence of a metropolitan seat. The destruction of 1821 broke this pattern of town life. Residents subsequently returned, and Valta grew again by drawing people from neighbouring settlements that had also been devastated. Its recovery was therefore a process of gathering displaced communities as well as rebuilding houses. Valta's history combines regional commerce, religious administration and the reconstruction that followed the upheaval of 1821.
simp_chinese: 卡桑德拉是卡桑德拉半岛内陆的城镇，奥斯曼时期名为瓦尔塔。这一名称呼应古代卡桑德雷亚，但半岛颈部附近的古城与这处内陆聚落应区别理解。瓦尔塔至十六世纪已成为重要商业中心，主教座的存在也显示其宗教行政地位。1821年的毁坏打断了原有城镇生活。居民后来返回，附近同样遭破坏聚落的人口也向这里集中，瓦尔塔因而重新成长。复苏既包括重建住房，也包括离散社群的重新汇聚。地方商业、宗教行政与1821年动荡之后的重建，共同构成瓦尔塔的历史脉络。

english: Malemba lay in the interior of Angola, in the country between the Kwango and the central highlands. It was already named among the region's political centres in an account of an eastward Portuguese expedition of 1607–1608. Later in the seventeenth century, the expanding kingdom of Kasanje made conquests in Malemba and neighbouring lands. Its campaigns brought speakers of several languages under the authority of the kinguri, as the rulers of Kasanje were known.
simp_chinese: 马伦巴位于安哥拉内陆，处在宽果河与中央高地之间。1607至1608年葡萄牙人向东远征的记载已将它列为当地政治中心之一。十七世纪后期以前，不断扩张的卡桑杰王国在马伦巴及邻近地区进行了征服。这些征战使操多种语言的居民置于卡桑杰统治者的权威之下；这些统治者被称为金古里。

english:
Cassel stood on the Fulda as the residence of Hesse's landgraves. The town council's struggles for greater independence in the later fourteenth century failed, leaving princely government a powerful influence over its development. In the sixteenth century Landgrave Philip's support for the Reformation made his capital a Protestant political center, defended by fortifications that successive rulers continued to improve.

A new town grew outside those defenses after Landgrave Karl's concession of 1685 offered French Protestant refugees religious protection and economic assistance. Paul du Ry planned the Oberneustadt with the Karlskirche at its center. Its ordered streets contrasted with the older town within the walls. Among the newcomers was the clothmaker Daniel Landré, whose family established a combined dwelling, business house and textile manufactory. A princely privilege in 1725 assisted their enterprise, which employed forty-one workers the following year. The dismantling of the fortifications began in 1767, opening space between old and new districts. Cassel's transformation thus joined court patronage, refugee skills and manufacturing to the reshaping of the city's streets.
simp_chinese:
卡塞尔坐落于富尔达河畔，是黑森领地伯爵的驻地。十四世纪后期，市议会争取更大独立的努力未能成功，诸侯政府继续深刻影响城市发展。十六世纪，菲利普伯爵支持宗教改革，使首府成为新教政治中心；他加强的城防，此后又经历代统治者不断改进。

1685年，卡尔伯爵向法国新教难民提供宗教保护与经济支持，城墙外由此兴建新城区。保罗·迪里规划了以卡尔教堂为中心的上新城，整齐街道与墙内旧城形成鲜明差别。移民中有制呢匠丹尼尔·朗德雷，他的家族建立兼具住宅、商号和纺织作坊功能的建筑。1725年的诸侯特许扶助其经营，次年工场已雇用四十一名工人。1767年开始拆除防御设施，旧城与新城之间的空间也逐渐打开。宫廷赞助、难民技艺和制造业，共同参与了卡塞尔街区的重塑。

english: Kassengue lies in the country north of the Upemba lakes, near Lulenge and Kabongo. The Luba kingdom's centre was in the wider Kabongo region. During the eighteenth century its rulers extended their influence north of the Upemba Depression, drawing tribute and engaging in trade with neighbouring communities.
simp_chinese: 卡森圭位于乌彭巴湖群以北，靠近卢伦盖和卡邦戈。卢巴王国的中心在广阔的卡邦戈地区。十八世纪，卢巴统治者将影响力扩展至乌彭巴洼地以北，向邻近社群征收贡赋并进行贸易。

english: Kasserine lies in the uplands of western Tunisia, amid mountains and plains near the Algerian frontier. In Roman times the settlement was called Cillium. Its remains include the mausoleum of the Flavii, a family tomb bearing a lengthy Latin inscription. Archaeological evidence around the ancient town shows farms and olive cultivation spreading into the surrounding steppe during the Roman period.
simp_chinese: 卡塞林位于突尼斯西部高地，处在靠近阿尔及利亚边境的山地与平原之间。罗马时代这里称为基利乌姆。遗迹包括弗拉维家族陵墓，墓上刻有长篇拉丁文铭文。古城周围的考古证据显示，罗马时期农庄与橄榄种植向附近草原扩展。

english:
Kassinga lies in the southern Angolan interior, in the highland country of Huíla, where plateaus rise above river valleys and woodland. Communities across this country combined cultivation, livestock keeping and exchange to suit the altitude and the rainfall. Maize, sorghum and beans were grown on the plateau fields, while cattle and goats grazed the upland grass.

During the early modern centuries, the highlands of southern Angola connected to the political networks and commerce that reached inland from the Portuguese coastal settlements. Imported goods such as cloth and metal reached the interior through intermediaries, while the trade in captives and recurring warfare placed pressure on villages. African rulers and communities pursued their own alliances, and the highland peoples kept their herds and markets at the centre of local life.
simp_chinese:
卡辛加位于安哥拉南部内陆的维拉高地，高原之上河谷与林地交错。各地社群根据海拔与降雨，将耕作、畜牧与交换结合起来。高原田地种植玉米、高粱和豆类，牛与山羊则在高地草场上放牧。

近代早期，安哥拉南部高地与自葡萄牙沿海据点向内陆伸展的政治网络和商业相连。布匹、金属器具等舶来品经中间人进入内陆，而俘虏贸易与反复的战争给村落带来压力。非洲统治者与社群各自结盟、追求利益，高地居民则以畜群和集市维系地方生活。

english: Kassongo lies in the sandy country near Luengue, between the Cuito and Cuando rivers. The Luengue is a seasonal watercourse; pools and lakes can persist in its basin even during dry years. Woodland and grassland alternate across this broad interior, with riparian forest along the floodplains.
simp_chinese: 卡松戈靠近卢恩圭，位于奎托河与宽多河之间的沙地。卢恩圭是一条季节性水道，即使在干旱年份，其流域中仍可留存水池和湖泊。这片广阔内陆的林地与草地交错，洪泛平原沿岸还生长着河岸森林。

sources.title: Final Report Luengue Luiana and Mavinga survey.pdf

english:
Kastamonu lies in a mountain valley of the western Pontic range, on the road between Ankara and the Black Sea port of Sinop. A Byzantine town until the 13th century, it was then ruled by the Turkmen beylik of Hüsameddin Çoban, and in 1309 Süleyman Pasha of the Candarids took it, making it the seat of a beylik that also held Sinop and Safranbolu. Ibn Battuta stayed forty days in the city in the 1330s and found it one of the largest and finest towns, with plentiful goods and low prices.

The Candarid beys fought one another over the inheritance, and in 1339 İbrahim took Kastamonu. His successors balanced between the Ottomans, Kadı Burhan al-Din of Sivas and Timur. Copper and iron from the mines around Küre were shipped from Sinop to Genoese and Venetian merchants, and the Candarids struck copper coins with two fish on them. Most of the town's baths, caravanserais, mosques and madrasas date from this age. İsfendiyar Bey, who ruled until 1439, made terms with Murad II in 1423 and kept Kastamonu as a tribute-paying vassal. Mehmed II absorbed the beylik in 1461, and Suleiman the Magnificent later made Kastamonu the centre of an Ottoman province.
simp_chinese:
卡斯塔莫努位于本都山脉西段的一处山谷，处在安卡拉通往黑海港口锡诺普的道路上。13世纪之前这里是拜占庭的城镇，后归属胡萨梅丁·乔班的突厥侯国；1309年，詹达尔王朝的苏莱曼帕夏攻取此城，使之成为同时拥有锡诺普和萨夫兰博卢的侯国驻地。14世纪30年代，伊本·白图泰在这里住了四十天，称它是最大、最美的城市之一，货物丰富，价格低廉。

詹达尔诸贝伊为继承权相互攻伐，1339年易卜拉欣夺得卡斯塔莫努。其后继者在奥斯曼、锡瓦斯的卡迪·布尔汉丁和帖木儿之间周旋。库雷一带矿山出产的铜和铁由锡诺普运出，卖给热那亚和威尼斯商人，詹达尔人还铸造了印有两条鱼的铜币。城里大多数浴场、商队驿站、清真寺和经学院都建于这个时期。统治到1439年的伊斯芬迪亚尔贝伊于1423年与穆拉德二世议和，作为纳贡的藩属保有卡斯塔莫努。1461年，穆罕默德二世吞并了这个侯国，后来苏莱曼大帝又把卡斯塔莫努定为一个奥斯曼省的中心。

english:
Kastelholm is a castle on Åland, the island group between Sweden and Finland. Originally surrounded by water, it guarded a strategic part of the routes across the Baltic and became the seat of the governor of the surrounding district. Its stone buildings were enlarged over generations, with walls and a bailey protecting the castle and its harbour.

First mentioned in 1388, Kastelholm endured repeated struggles for control of the islands. In 1507 the Danish commander Søren Norby attacked the castle. Gustav Vasa later used it as a royal hunting residence, and in 1571 the deposed Erik XIV and Karin Månsdotter were held there. A fire damaged it in 1619; after its administrative district was abolished in 1634, the castle gradually lost its importance. Another fire in 1745 left much of the old fortress ruined.
simp_chinese:
卡斯特尔霍尔姆是奥兰群岛上的一座城堡，群岛位于瑞典与芬兰之间。城堡原本四面环水，守卫穿越波罗的海航路的战略地段，并成为周围地区长官的驻地。石建筑历经数代扩建，城墙与外堡保护城堡及港湾。

卡斯特尔霍尔姆首次见于1388年文书，此后经历了多次争夺群岛控制权的冲突。1507年，丹麦指挥官瑟伦·诺比袭击城堡。古斯塔夫·瓦萨后来将其用作王室狩猎住所；1571年，被废黜的埃里克十四世和卡琳·蒙斯多特曾被囚于此。1619年火灾损毁城堡，1634年其行政辖区被撤销后，城堡逐渐失去重要性。1745年另一场火灾使旧要塞大部沦为废墟。

english:
Kastoria stands on a peninsula jutting into Lake Orestiada, beneath the mountains of western Macedonia. Its many Byzantine churches bear witness to the long history of a town whose fortunes came to rest on a distinctive craft: the working of fur. Kastorian craftsmen made garments from small pieces of pelts, and their merchants carried the finished goods far beyond the lake.

By the seventeenth century, the fur trade had brought prosperity and connections with Constantinople and cities farther north. Merchants who made their fortunes abroad endowed churches and schools in their home town, while substantial houses rose along its narrow streets.
