The decorated mansions that survive from the later Ottoman period recall the wealth and tastes of Kastoria's trading families.
simp_chinese:
卡斯托里亚坐落在伸入奥雷斯蒂亚达湖的半岛上，西马其顿的群山环绕四周。城中众多拜占庭教堂见证了它漫长的历史，而一种独特的手艺也为这座城镇带来了繁荣：工匠将零碎的皮毛拼接成衣，商人则把成品运往湖区之外的远方。

到十七世纪，毛皮贸易已为卡斯托里亚带来财富，使它与君士坦丁堡及更北方的城市相连。在外经商致富的人资助故乡的教堂和学校，宽敞的宅邸也沿着狭窄的街道兴建。奥斯曼统治后期留下的装饰华丽的宅第，至今仍反映着城中商人家族的财富与品味。

english: Kastornoye lies on the Olym River, a tributary of the Sosna in the Don basin. The river bends through a landscape of uplands and ravines on the old southern frontier of the Russian state. Local tradition recalls a wooden fort and watch post on the steep right bank, established to guard against steppe raids. By the eighteenth century Kastornoye was a village in a district where rivers and their valleys shaped settlement.
simp_chinese: 卡斯托尔诺耶位于奥雷姆河畔；这条河是顿河流域索斯纳河的一条支流。河水在高地和沟壑间转弯流淌，所在地区曾是俄罗斯国家的南部边疆。当地传说记载，陡峭的右岸曾建有木堡和哨所，以防备来自草原的袭击。到十八世纪，卡斯托尔诺耶已是一处村庄，河流与河谷深刻影响了周围的聚居格局。

english: Kastsyukovichy stands on the Zhadunka River in the Dnieper basin of eastern Belarus. The settlement appears in written records in 1508 under the name Kastsioukova, within the lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania associated with Mstsislaw. It remained a small community well into the eighteenth century: a count for 1730 recorded thirty-five hearths. Such figures describe households or taxable domestic units rather than an exact number of inhabitants. The first partition of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth transferred the village to the Russian Empire in 1772. By 1784 it was recorded with eighty-nine hearths and belonged to Mogilev governorate. These scattered entries trace a growing settlement whose rulers and administrative affiliations changed while its river setting remained the same. Its early history is therefore best followed through village names, household counts and the incorporation of this part of the Lithuanian-Ruthenian borderlands into imperial Russian government.
simp_chinese: 卡斯秋科维奇位于白俄罗斯东部、第聂伯河流域的扎敦卡河畔。1508年的文献以卡斯秋科瓦之名记载了这处聚落，当时它属于立陶宛大公国与姆斯季斯拉夫相关的领地。直到十八世纪，它仍是一处规模不大的村落：1730年的记录只有三十五户。“户”或“炉灶”属于家庭及赋税统计单位，不能直接换算为确切人口。1772年，波兰立陶宛联邦第一次被瓜分，此村随周边土地转归俄罗斯帝国。到1784年，登记户数增至八十九，行政上属于莫吉廖夫省。这些零散记载勾勒出一个逐步扩大的河畔聚落，也留下了当地从立陶宛大公国统治转入俄国行政体系的轨迹。村名、户数和隶属关系的变化，是理解其近代早期历史最明确的线索。

english:
Kasukuak was the Alutiiq community associated with the later village of Akhiok in southern Kodiak. Its earlier location was at Humpy Cove, rather than the site occupied by the modern village. Russian fur traders established the community as a base for sea-otter hunting, bringing its people into the commercial organization of Russian America.

By the early nineteenth century, this economy also depended on preserved fish. At nearby Alitak, at the entrance to Olga Creek, Alutiiq workers processed salmon under Russian supervision. Historians link that station economically with Akhiok: work concentrated at Olga Creek during the salmon season and shifted back to Akhiok for the rest of the year. The smallpox epidemic of 1837 disrupted this network; thirteen Alitak residents subsequently moved to Aiaktalik. Hunting settlements and seasonal fishing stations had bound the southern bays together, while introduced disease threatened the communities sustaining them.
simp_chinese:
卡苏夸克是与后来阿克希奥克村相关的阿鲁提克社群，早期地点在汉皮湾，与现代村址不同。俄罗斯毛皮商人将这一聚落建成猎取海獭的据点，使居民进入俄属美洲的商业组织。

到十九世纪初，这套经济也依赖鱼类保存。在邻近、奥尔加溪入口处的阿利塔克，阿鲁提克劳动者在俄罗斯人监督下加工鲑鱼。研究者认为该站与阿克希奥克存在经济联系：鲑鱼季节的作业集中在奥尔加溪，其余时间转回阿克希奥克。1837年的天花疫情打乱了这套联系，十三名阿利塔克居民随后迁往艾阿克塔利克。猎獭聚落与季节性鱼业站将南部海湾连接起来，而传入的疾病又威胁着维系它们的社群。

english:
Kasumne belongs to the Plains Miwok country along the Cosumnes River, where acorns and salmon sustained settlements linked to the delta waterways. The river and its marshes supported food gathering, fishing and movement between neighbouring communities. In October 1808 Gabriel Moraga's mounted expedition reached the Cosumnes before continuing north to the American and Feather rivers.

Mission expansion increasingly drew people out of this inland country. San José's baptismal records identify forty-one Cosomnes from the Wilton region among new converts in the last three months of 1834. Further baptisms continued even as the Mexican government began secularising the missions. San José ceased to be a landholding institution in November 1836. During 1837, Plains Miwok people there faced the choice of returning to their Sacramento Valley homelands or remaining as workers on the ranches replacing mission estates.
simp_chinese:
卡苏姆尼属于科苏姆尼斯河沿岸的平原米沃克人地区。橡子和鲑鱼供养着与三角洲水道相连的聚落，河流及沼泽提供采集、捕鱼和往返邻近社群的条件。1808年10月，加夫列尔·莫拉加率领的骑马考察队抵达科苏姆尼斯河，随后继续北上美洲河与羽毛河。

传教站的扩张逐渐将居民从这片内陆家园带走。圣何塞传教站的洗礼簿记载，1834年最后三个月的新教民中，有四十一名来自威尔顿地区的 科索姆内斯人。墨西哥政府开始推行传教站世俗化后，洗礼仍在继续。1836年11月，圣何塞不再作为拥有地产的传教机构运行。到1837年，站内的平原米沃克人面临选择：返回萨克拉门托河谷家园，或留在取代教会庄园的牧场劳动。

english: Kasungu lies on the plateau of central Malawi, in a region associated with the Chewa. Local chiefly traditions remember Lukwa as a holder of lands in the Kasungu country. The Chewa preserved accounts of migration from the Luba country of central Africa before their communities became established in the highlands of Malawi.
simp_chinese: 卡松古位于马拉维中部高原，是与切瓦人相关的地区。当地酋长传统记述，卢夸曾在卡松古一带拥有土地。切瓦人的口述传统还保留了他们从中非卢巴地区迁徙、后来在马拉维高地定居的故事。

english:
Kasur lies south of Lahore, overlooking the alluvial country of the Beas and Sutlej. Its name means forts or palaces, and the city grew from a group of fortified settlements known as kots. It is also the resting place of the Sufi poet Bulleh Shah, whose shrine stands in the city.

Kheshgi Pashtuns from Kabul settled here during Babur's reign in 1525, building small forts that formed the nucleus of Kasur. Under Akbar, new neighbourhoods named for the heads of Pashtun families added to the town, which prospered through trade under Mughal rule. As Mughal power declined, Ahmad Shah Durrani captured Kasur and Sikh forces attacked it in 1747 and 1763. Ranjit Singh took the city in 1807, bringing it into his expanding kingdom.
simp_chinese:
卡苏尔位于拉合尔以南，俯瞰比亚斯河与萨特莱杰河的冲积地区。城名意为堡垒或宫殿，城市由数座称作科特的设防聚落发展而来。苏菲诗人布勒沙也安葬于此，城中建有他的陵祠。

1525年巴布尔统治期间，来自喀布尔的赫什吉普什图人定居于此，修建小堡垒，成为卡苏尔的核心。阿克巴在位时，以普什图家族首领命名的街区进一步扩展了城镇；在莫卧儿统治下，这里因贸易而繁荣。莫卧儿势力衰落后，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼占领卡苏尔，锡克军队又在1747年和1763年先后攻城。1807年，兰吉特·辛格夺取此城，将其纳入不断扩张的王国。

english: Kasuswapaskau lies near Lake Aigneau on the Ungava Peninsula. The Aigneau River widens into this lake before joining the Rivière aux Mélèzes; its waters then continue down the Koksoak to Ungava Bay. The lake and river lie in a landscape of northern lakes and low tundra vegetation.
simp_chinese: 卡苏斯瓦帕斯考位于安加瓦半岛，靠近艾尼奥湖。艾尼奥河在这里展宽成湖，随后汇入梅莱兹河；河水再沿科克索克河流入安加瓦湾。湖泊与河流周围是遍布水面的北方苔原，植被低矮。

english: Kata Kuna belongs to the country of the Río Cuarto, also called the Chocancharava, in the central Argentine plains. The river descends from the Sierras de Córdoba and runs east across the lowlands, where its lower course is known as the Saladillo. Its waters link the mountain slopes with a broad plain of grassland and wetlands. Indigenous communities knew these valleys long before the Spanish names of the rivers were established.
simp_chinese: 卡塔库纳属于阿根廷中部平原的夸尔托河地区，这条河也称乔坎查拉瓦河。河流从科尔多瓦山脉下降，向东穿越低地，下游称为萨拉迪略河。河水连接山坡与广阔的草地、湿地平原。在西班牙语河名出现很久以前，原住民社群已熟悉这些谷地。

english: Katagata lies along the Nagara River in Mino, where fishing with trained cormorants has a long history. An early place name in the district was Ukai, meaning cormorant fishing, recorded in a tenth-century geographical work. Fishers worked from boats, controlling birds on lines to catch fish in the river. The practice became a distinctive part of life on the Nagara, handed down through generations of fishing households.
simp_chinese: 方县位于美浓长良川沿岸，驯鸬鹚捕鱼的传统源远流长。十世纪地理文献记载，郡内已有名为“鸬饲”的地方。渔人乘船操纵系绳的鸬鹚，在河中捕鱼；这一技艺由渔家世代相传，成为长良川生活的特色。

english:
Katahdin, the “Great Mountain” of the Penobscot, rises above the forests of northern Maine. Its steep granite massif stands apart from the neighbouring ranges, with exposed alpine ground on its high summit. In the beliefs of some Indigenous people it was the home of the storm spirit Pamola, and a place to be approached with caution.

John Gyles passed near the mountain while travelling with Abenaki hunting parties after his capture in 1689, and described it as higher than the White Hills above the Saco River. In 1804 a surveying party including Charles Turner and two Indigenous guides made the first recorded ascent. They set out from the West Branch of the Penobscot in the morning and reached the summit that evening.
simp_chinese:
卡塔丁山是佩诺布斯科特人所说的“大山”，高耸于缅因北部森林之上。陡峭的花岗岩山体与邻近山脉相隔，山顶裸露着高山地带。在一些原住民的信仰中，这里是风暴之灵帕莫拉的居所，需要谨慎接近。

约翰·贾尔斯于1689年被俘后，随阿贝纳基狩猎队经过山峰附近，称它比萨科河上方的白山还要高。1804年，包括查尔斯·特纳和两名原住民向导在内的一支测绘队完成了首次有记载的登顶。他们早晨从佩诺布斯科特河西支出发，当晚到达山顶。

english:
Kataka, now commonly called Cuttack, stands between the Mahanadi and its Kathajodi distributary in Odisha. Its Barabati Fort became the seat of successive ruling houses. Anangabhima III transferred his capital here in the thirteenth century, and the city subsequently served the Ganga, Gajapati and Bhoi rulers. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, two rings of outlying forts on the riverbanks helped defend Barabati. Mukundadeva added a nine-storey palace within its walls in 1560.

The city passed to the Afghan rulers of Bengal in 1568, the Mughals in 1592 and the Marathas in 1751. These changes preserved its importance as a centre from which Odisha was governed. The East India Company took Cuttack in 1803, bringing another long period of rule from Barabati to an end.
simp_chinese:
卡塔卡，即今通常所称的克塔克，位于奥里萨的马哈纳迪河与其分流卡塔焦迪河之间。巴拉巴蒂堡是历代统治者的驻地。十三世纪，阿南加比马三世将都城迁至这里，此后城市先后服务于恒伽、加贾帕蒂和博伊王朝。十五至十六世纪，两条河岸上的外围堡垒组成两道防线，护卫巴拉巴蒂堡。1560年，穆昆达德瓦在堡内增建了一座九层宫殿。

1568年，城市落入孟加拉的阿富汗统治者手中；1592年归莫卧儿，1751年又归马拉塔。政权更替期间，克塔克继续作为治理奥里萨的中心。1803年，东印度公司占领克塔克，巴拉巴蒂堡作为地方统治驻地的漫长历史由此进入新的阶段。

english: Katanga is the copper-bearing country of south-central Africa, where wooded uplands stretch between the Lualaba and the lands towards the Luapula. Long before the great industrial mines, copper moved through African networks of exchange and served as a valued material for ornaments and tools. Luba, Lunda and neighbouring rulers held influence across different parts of this broad interior region.
simp_chinese: 加丹加是非洲中南部的产铜地区，林木覆盖的高地在卢阿拉巴河与通往卢阿普拉河的土地之间延伸。大型工业矿山出现以前，铜已通过非洲的交换网络流通，是制作饰物和工具的珍贵材料。卢巴、隆达及邻近的统治者在这片广阔内陆的不同地区拥有影响。

english: Katara lies west of the Serra da Leba, below the high escarpment separating Angola's coastal plain from the Chela plateau. Water descending from the plateau has cut deep gorges through the cliffs at places such as Tundavala. To the west, isolated rocky hills rise above the dry Namibe lowlands.
simp_chinese: 卡塔拉位于莱巴山脉以西、分隔安哥拉沿海平原与谢拉高原的高大断崖下方。从高原流下的水在通达瓦拉等地切出深峡。西面的纳米贝干燥低地上，孤立的岩丘拔地而起。

sources.title: Introducing the highlands and escarpments of Angola and Namibia.pdf

english:
The Katataibo forest corresponds to the Kakataibo country of Peru's eastern Andean approaches, around the Aguaytía, San Alejandro and Sungaroyacu rivers. Kakataibo is a Panoan language; many of its speakers identify themselves as uni, meaning people or true people. Their territory lay beyond the settled centres from which Franciscan missionaries tried to extend their influence into the Ucayali country.

Missionary incursions between 1727 and 1736 encountered groups called Carapachos in the reports, later identified with the Kakataibo. In 1757 the Kakataibo forced missionaries to withdraw, and around 1790 they continued to obstruct outsiders' navigation on the Aguaytía. These encounters made control of river access a practical expression of local autonomy. They also unfolded within relationships with neighbouring Indigenous societies, including competition over metal tools introduced through mission networks. The forest's colonial history was therefore shaped by selective access and resistance as well as by connections across the eastern foothills.
simp_chinese:
卡塔泰博丛林对应秘鲁安第斯山东麓的卡卡泰博地区，围绕阿瓜伊蒂亚、圣亚历杭德罗与孙加罗亚库诸河展开。卡卡泰博语属于帕诺语系，许多使用者自称uni，意为“人”或“真正的人”。他们的土地位于殖民定居中心之外，方济各会传教士试图从那些中心向乌卡亚利地区扩展影响。

1727至1736年间，传教士进入这一地区，在记录中遇到了称作Carapachos的群体，后来被认作卡卡泰博人。1757年，卡卡泰博迫使传教士撤离；约1790年，仍阻止外来者沿阿瓜伊蒂亚河航行。控制河道通行，是地方自主权的切实体现。这些接触也置身于原住民邻族之间的关系中，包括对传教网络带来的金属工具的竞争。森林的殖民时期历史，因此既有山麓地带的联系，也有对外来进入的选择与抵抗。

english: Katataskatikw lies in the interior of the Labrador Peninsula, a country of lakes, rivers and rocky ridges between the Labrador coast and Ungava Bay. Innu-speaking Naskapi families travelled this land in small bands, following caribou herds through the seasons and hunting smaller game, birds and fish. Their movements followed the freezing and thawing of lakes and rivers. From 1830 the Hudson's Bay Company operated Fort Chimo on Ungava Bay, and its traders began to send goods and collect furs along inland routes.
simp_chinese: 卡塔塔斯卡蒂克位于拉布拉多半岛内陆，这里湖泊、河流与岩脊交错，介于拉布拉多海岸与昂加瓦湾之间。说因努语的纳斯卡皮人以小群体在这片土地上迁移，跟随驯鹿群的季节迁徙，并猎取小型动物、水鸟和鱼类。他们的行动随湖河的封冻与解冻而变化。1830年起，哈得孙湾公司在昂加瓦湾经营奇莫堡，商人沿内陆路线运入货物、收购毛皮。

english:
Kataysky refers to the fortified settlement that became Kataysk, near the junction of the Katayka and Iset rivers east of the Urals. The first stockade is conventionally dated to 1655 and associated with Pankraty Perkhurov. Repeated destruction led to rebuilding: the earlier sites lay close to dense pine woods, while the third fort occupied a higher promontory protected by the river, a ravine and ditches.

Its defenses enclosed more than a garrison. A surviving description lists four gate towers, an Epiphany church, a judicial office, a powder cellar and three storehouses. By 1695 the settlement included fifty-eight Cossack households and 269 peasant households. Kataysk also stood on the road between Moscow and Tobolsk. Goods were sold locally or forwarded toward the Irbit fair and other Siberian settlements. Its history therefore combines a defended frontier post with administration, food storage and commercial movement along a major overland route.
simp_chinese:
卡泰斯基指后来发展为卡泰斯克的堡寨聚落，位于乌拉尔以东卡泰卡河与伊谢季河交汇附近。第一座堡寨通常定年为1655年，与潘克拉季·佩尔胡罗夫的建置活动有关。堡寨多次毁坏后重建：早期选址紧靠茂密松林，第三座则迁到较高河岬，利用河流、深沟和人工壕沟加强防御。

防御设施内并非只有驻军。保存的描述列出四座门塔、主显节教堂、司法公署、火药窖及三座储藏仓。1695年，聚落记有五十八户哥萨克和二百六十九户农民。卡泰斯克还位于莫斯科与托博尔斯克之间的道路上，货物既在当地出售，也运往伊尔比特集市及其他西伯利亚聚落。堡寨的地方职能由此同时涵盖防御、行政、物资储备和长途贸易。

english: Kâte is a Papuan language of the mountainous Huon Peninsula in northeastern New Guinea. It belongs to the Finisterre–Huon group of languages. The country of its speakers lies among steep ridges and valleys inland from the coast, within a region of many neighbouring language communities.
simp_chinese: 卡特语是新几内亚东北部多山的休恩半岛上的一种巴布亚语言，属于菲尼斯特雷—休恩语群。其使用者的土地位于海岸内陆陡峭山脊与河谷之间，周围分布着众多相邻语言社群。

english: The Katen is a tributary of the Khor River in the forested mountains east of the Ussuri. Its waters descend through the Sikhote-Alin country before joining the larger river, which flows west towards the Ussuri. Steep slopes, taiga and narrow valleys shape the basin, while the streams provide routes through the uplands. The river forms part of a network of waterways joining the mountain interior to the Amur system.
simp_chinese: 卡滕河是乌苏里江以东森林山地中霍尔河的一条支流。河水从锡霍特山地流下，汇入向西流往乌苏里江的干流。陡坡、泰加林和狭窄河谷构成这里的地貌，溪流则提供穿越高地的通道。这条河属于将山地内陆与黑龙江水系连接起来的水道网络。

english: Katende belongs to the country of the Lunda and Luvale in eastern Angola, near the watershed between the Kasai and the upper Zambezi. Woodland, grassland and rivers spread across this interior plateau. Katende was a chiefly name associated with the Luvale and Lunda communities of the region, whose lands extended across the waterways and plains north of the Zambezi. The Kasai drains north towards the Congo, while the Zambezi turns south and east.
simp_chinese: 卡滕德位于安哥拉东部隆达人与卢瓦莱人的地区，靠近开赛河和赞比西河上游之间的分水岭。林地、草原和河流分布在内陆高原上。卡滕德是与当地卢瓦莱和隆达社群相关的首领名称，这些社群的土地延伸至赞比西河北方的河流与平原。开赛河向北流往刚果河，赞比西河则转向南方和东方。

english: Katepwewi is the Cree name associated with the Qu'Appelle River, which winds through a broad valley in the southern prairie. Lakes interrupt its course, and the valley has long served as a corridor for travel and exchange. Its Cree name is linked to a story of a voice calling along the river; French speakers later rendered the name as Qu'Appelle, “who calls?” Indigenous people hunted in the valley long before the arrival of fur traders.
simp_chinese: 卡特普维是与夸佩勒河有关的克里语名称。这条河蜿蜒流过南部草原的宽阔河谷，沿途串起湖泊；河谷长期是旅行与交换的通道。克里语河名与河边传来呼唤声的故事有关，法语使用者后来将其译为“夸佩勒”，意为“谁在呼唤？”毛皮商到来很久以前，原住民已在谷地狩猎。

sources.title: cree place names on map 2 with macrons and place names not on map  2 .pdf

english: Kath, the old capital of Khwarazm on the lower Amu Darya, survived the loss of its political primacy as a smaller town. Ibn Battuta passed through in 1333 on the journey from Gurganj to Bukhara and described a prosperous settlement. Later in the fourteenth century Timur devastated Kath during his struggle with Tokhtamysh, before having its walls rebuilt. The river repeatedly proved as consequential as warfare. Shifting channels and floods had already damaged the old city, even while irrigation supported the surrounding fields. In the seventeenth century further flooding destroyed canals. Anusha Khan of Khiva, who ruled from 1663 to 1685, responded by digging the Yarmish canal and building a fortress on the opposite, left bank of the Amu Darya, moving Kath's remaining population there. The old right-bank ruins acquired the name of the local shrine of Shaikh Abbas Wali.
simp_chinese: 柯提是阿姆河下游的花剌子模旧都，失去政治中心地位之后，仍以较小城镇延续。伊本·白图泰于1333年从玉龙杰赤前往布哈拉时经过，记述其规模虽小却颇为繁荣。十四世纪后期，帖木儿在与脱脱迷失争战期间破坏柯提，后来又命人重筑城墙。河流的影响并不亚于战争：渠道灌溉支撑周围农田，河道变迁和洪水也反复侵蚀城址。十七世纪又有洪水冲毁旧渠，希瓦汗阿努沙在1663至1685年的统治期内开凿亚尔米什渠，并在阿姆河左岸建堡，将柯提剩余居民迁往对岸。右岸旧城废墟则逐渐以当地谢赫阿巴斯·瓦利陵墓之名为人所知。

english: Katha lies on the western bank of the Irrawaddy in northern Burma. The river winds between forested hills before entering the broader central lowlands. A Shan and Burmese village stood here beside the great waterway, whose course connects the upper river country with settlements downstream. The hills and tributaries around Katha form part of the varied landscape of the upper Irrawaddy basin.
simp_chinese: 杰沙位于缅甸北部伊洛瓦底江西岸。大河在有林的丘陵之间蜿蜒，随后进入更广阔的中部低地。这里曾有掸族与缅族村落，坐落在连接上游地区和下游聚落的大河旁。周围丘陵与支流共同构成伊洛瓦底江上游流域多样的景观。

english:
Kathmandu, long known as Kantipur, is a city of palaces, temples and courtyards in the heart of the Nepal Valley. Its Newar inhabitants developed a rich urban culture at a meeting point of routes between India and Tibet. Hindu shrines and Buddhist monasteries share the sacred landscape, while the skills of Newar artists travelled far beyond the valley. Swayambhu's great stupa and the temple of Pashupatinath are among the places that draw worshippers here.

For centuries Kathmandu was ruled by the Malla kings, whose courts patronised the arts and whose neighbours at Patan and Bhaktapur maintained courts of their own. In 1628 the Portuguese Jesuit João Cabral passed through and recorded his reception by the king. A century and a half later Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha laid siege to the valley's kingdoms. His forces took Kathmandu in 1768, and the city became the capital of the expanding Nepalese state. The Gorkhali court continued to build in the valley's established architectural traditions.
simp_chinese:
加德满都长期称为坎提普尔，是尼泊尔谷地中心的一座宫殿、寺庙和庭院之城。这里处于印度与西藏之间的交通交会处，尼瓦尔居民发展出丰富的城市文化。印度教圣所与佛教寺院共同构成神圣景观，尼瓦尔工匠的技艺也传播到谷地之外。斯瓦扬布大佛塔和帕舒帕蒂纳特神庙都是吸引信众前来的圣地。

几个世纪以来，加德满都由马拉诸王统治，他们的宫廷赞助艺术，邻近的帕坦和巴克塔普尔也各有王廷。1628年，葡萄牙耶稣会士若昂·卡布拉尔途经此地，记下了国王对他的接待。一个半世纪后，廓尔喀的普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿围攻谷地诸国，其军队于1768年攻取加德满都，城市随即成为不断扩张的尼泊尔国家首都。廓尔喀王廷继续沿用谷地既有的建筑传统。

english: Kathua lies near the Ravi River at the foot of the Jammu hills. The Ujh, a tributary of the Ravi, flows through the surrounding country, where the plains give way to rising ground. Nearby Jasrota was the seat of a local ruling house; its ruined fort recalls a polity situated between the Ravi and Ujh. The river valleys offered routes between the Punjab plains and the hill country to the north.
simp_chinese: 卡图阿位于查谟丘陵脚下，靠近拉维河。拉维河支流乌杰河流经周围地区，平原在这里逐渐过渡为高地。附近的贾斯罗塔曾是地方统治家族的治所，堡垒遗迹见证了拉维河与乌杰河之间的地方政权。河谷提供连接旁遮普平原与北方山地的通道。

english: Katiba lies near the Ganguela River in the country north of Mavinga. This is part of the sandy watershed between the Cuito and Cuando rivers, where shallow valleys, grassland and woodland alternate across the plain. To the east, the Cuando flows south through a succession of marshes and floodplains on its way towards the Zambezi basin.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂巴位于马温加以北的甘盖拉河附近。这片沙质分水岭介于奎托河和宽多河之间，浅谷、草地与林地在平原上交错。东面的宽多河向南流经一连串沼泽和泛滥平原，最终通往赞比西流域。

english: The Katibas is a tributary of the Rajang in northern Borneo. Its own tributaries include the Asai and the Nyimoh, streams that run through a forested river basin before joining the larger waterway. The Rajang receives the Katibas and several other major tributaries as it makes its long journey through the interior toward the South China Sea. Rivers provide the natural connections through this deeply watered country of hills and valleys.
simp_chinese: 卡提巴斯河是婆罗洲北部拉让江的支流。阿赛河与尼摩河等溪流穿过森林流域，汇入卡提巴斯河。拉让江接纳这条支流与其他大河之后，继续漫长的内陆旅程，流向南海。在这片河网密布的丘陵与谷地中，河流构成天然通道，把远离海岸的森林地区与下游的广大水系联系起来。

english: Katihar lies in the low country of eastern Bihar, between the Kosi and Mahananda river systems. Its name is associated with the nearby village of Dighi-Katihar, where a large tank is said to have been dug for troops during fighting between the nawabs of Purnea and Murshidabad. Under the Mughals, the surrounding country lay within the districts of Purnea and Tajpur. In the eighteenth century it passed into the East India Company’s sphere as the authority of the Purnea governor gave way.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂哈尔位于比哈尔东部低地，地处戈西河和默哈嫩达河流域之间。据说它的名称与附近的迪吉卡蒂哈尔村有关；当地一座大水池相传是在布尔尼亚与穆尔希达巴德的纳瓦布交战时为军队开凿的。莫卧儿时期，周围地区分属布尔尼亚和泰杰布尔辖区。十八世纪，随着布尔尼亚总督权力衰落，这一地区进入东印度公司的势力范围。

english: Katima lies on the upper Zambezi near the rapids known as Katima Mulilo. The name, meaning to quench the fire in Lozi, recalls the dangerous passage of canoes through the rushing water. The river and its floodplain have long supported communities in this country, where fishing and cultivation accompany the use of surrounding grazing lands.
simp_chinese: 卡蒂马位于上赞比西河畔，靠近卡蒂马穆利洛急流。这个名称在洛齐语中意为“熄灭火”，让人想起独木舟穿越湍急水流的危险。河流与泛滥平原长期维系着当地社群，捕鱼和耕作与周围牧地的利用相伴。

english: Katingan lies along the river of the same name in southern Borneo, with Mendawai farther downstream toward the Java Sea. The distinction mattered in older political geography: the Hikayat Banjar describes Katingan and Mendawai as separate districts, each with its own menteri sakai. The region's official historical account connects them with the Banjar court and, in the seventeenth century, with the lands assigned to Prince Dipati Anta-Kasuma, who became ruler of Kotawaringin. The same chronicle describes Mendawai's port as a stopping place for Banjarmasin traders sailing to Mataram in Java. River communities thus formed part of a commercial network reaching beyond Borneo. A report attributed to Radermacher names Kyai Ingabei Suradi Raja as the local head in 1780. Agreements with the Dutch subsequently altered the territory's formal allegiance: Sultan Tahmidullah II ceded claims in 1787, and Sultan Adam ceded the Mendawai landscape in 1826. Such transfers describe court agreements, without establishing uniform Dutch control over every upstream community.
simp_chinese: 卡廷岸位于婆罗洲南部的同名河流沿岸，门达威则处在通向爪哇海的下游。两者在旧时政治地理中有所区别：《班贾尔史话》将它们记作各有一位地方长官的两个辖区。当地政府的历史介绍把这里与班贾尔王廷联系起来，并记述十七世纪卡廷岸和门达威被纳入迪帕蒂·安达－卡苏马王子的封地；他后来成为哥打瓦林因统治者。同一部史话还称，班贾尔马辛商人前往爪哇马打兰时，会在门达威港停留。河流聚落因此参与了超越婆罗洲的商业网络。拉德马赫1780年的报告将基艾·英加贝·苏拉迪拉贾列为当地首领。此后，与荷兰人的条约改变了名义上的归属：塔赫米杜拉二世于1787年让渡领地权利，亚当苏丹又在1826年让出门达威地区。这些王廷协议本身，并不能证明荷兰已同等控制每个上游社区。

english:
Katiola lay in the Tagbana country of the northern Ivorian interior, south of the commercial centre of Kong. The Tagbana formed part of the wider Senufo world, but their communities had distinct settlement traditions. Accounts of their origins recall successive migrations, meetings with earlier inhabitants and the founding of villages, rather than the expansion of a single kingdom over empty land.

Historians tracing these movements place an important route through Kong and Nanguinkaha. In the settlement traditions, Gnèkèrè Silué led a group onwards to found Gnèkèrèkaha; some companions continued farther south into the country where Katiola developed. These movements are associated with the formation of the Tagbana region between the later medieval period and the early nineteenth century. From the eighteenth century, the arrival of Baoulé groups to the south added new neighbours and pressures on settlement. Tagbana landholding communities and Mangoro pottery specialists shared the Katiola area, linking cultivation with craft production. Its early history thus belongs to overlapping village territories and remembered migrations, with Kong providing a northern connection rather than a sufficient account of every community's political allegiance.
simp_chinese:
卡蒂奥拉位于科特迪瓦北部内陆的塔格巴纳地区，北方是商业中心孔格。塔格巴纳属于广义塞努福文化世界，各社群又拥有自身的定居传统。关于起源的叙述，记载了接连迁徙、与先住居民相遇和创建村落的过程。

研究这些迁徙的历史学者，将孔格和南金卡哈视为重要节点。定居传统中，格内凯雷·西吕埃带领一支人群继续前行，建立格内凯雷卡哈，一些同伴再向南迁入卡蒂奥拉形成的地区。中世纪晚期至十九世纪初，这类迁徙逐渐塑造了塔格巴纳地域。十八世纪起，南方包勒人群的到来又带来新的邻居和定居压力。在卡蒂奥拉一带，拥有土地的塔格巴纳社群与擅长制陶的曼戈罗人共同生活，使耕作与手工业彼此联系。村落领地、迁徙记忆和地方权利构成了早期历史的主要脉络；北方孔格提供远近交往的通道，各村的具体隶属关系则各有变化。

english: Katobe a Mubebe lies near Lonhe, in the hilly country east of Quibala. The Lonhe is one of several rivers that cross this part of the Angolan highlands, alongside the Lombe, Luau and Longa. Rain falls chiefly in a wet season, feeding streams that wind through the valleys between the uplands.
simp_chinese: 卡托贝阿穆贝贝位于奎巴拉以东、洛涅附近的丘陵地带。洛涅河是流经这片安哥拉高地的河流之一，附近还有隆贝河、卢奥河和隆加河。降雨主要集中在雨季，滋养着蜿蜒穿过高地间河谷的溪流。

english: Katok was an important Nyingma monastery in eastern Kham, with scholarly traditions that remained vigorous through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. In the fifteenth century, leadership passed into the hereditary Drung line, transmitted between uncles and nephews. The rise of the Degé kingdom in the seventeenth century brought a different relationship between monastery, land and political authority. Degé rulers sent the treasure revealers Dundül Dorjé and Longsel Nyingpo to Katok; their revealed teachings became central to its religious programme, while the earlier leadership was displaced. An eighteenth-century document records a division of the monastery’s farms with Degé. Later, Getsé Mahapandita Gyurmé Tsewang Chokdrup, who lived from 1761 to 1829, revived study of the Kama, the transmitted teachings, and composed liturgies for the treasure traditions. Katok’s early nineteenth-century religious life thus combined renewed scholarship with the ritual legacies of its seventeenth-century reformers.
simp_chinese: 尕多即康区东部的重要宁玛派寺院噶陀寺，其学术传统在十四、十五世纪仍保持活力。十五世纪，寺院领导权进入叔侄相承的 Drung 世袭系统。十七世纪德格王国兴起后，寺院、土地与政治权力之间形成新的关系。德格统治者派遣伏藏师敦都多吉和龙萨宁波前往噶陀；他们的伏藏教法逐渐成为宗教课程的重要内容，原有领导系统则被取代。一份十八世纪文献还记载，寺院农庄曾与德格方面分割。此后，生于1761年、卒于1829年的格泽班智达久美策旺却珠重新推动噶玛、即传承教法的研习，并为伏藏传统编写仪轨。因此，十九世纪初的噶陀宗教生活，将复兴的学术教学与十七世纪改革者留下的仪轨传统结合在一起。

english:
Katol lies beside the Jam, a tributary of the Wardha, west of Nagpur. Its mud fort belonged to the era of Gond rule. Under Dharmaji Bhonsla, the fort was held by a confederacy of Pindaris, bands associated with mounted raiding. Their relationship with the ruler involved tribute, paid with varying regularity, and protection of the surrounding countryside against other raiders.

Katol thus preserves a revealing example of the overlap between raiding and local defence in the Nagpur country. Its religious monuments included two temples in the Hemadpanti tradition. Local stories attributed their construction to Ravana and his demons, who were said to have completed them in a single night.
simp_chinese:
卡托尔位于那格浦尔以西、瓦尔达河支流贾姆河畔。镇上的土堡可追溯至贡德王朝时期。达尔马吉·蓬斯勒当政时，一支品达里集团占据了城堡。这些以骑兵劫掠著称的队伍向统治者缴纳不甚定期的贡赋，同时保护周边乡村，抵御其他劫掠者。

卡托尔的经历展现了那格浦尔地区劫掠活动与地方防卫相互交织的一面。这里的宗教建筑包括两座赫马德潘蒂风格寺庙。地方传说将它们归于罗波那及其魔众之手，称其一夜之间便告落成。

english:
Katori's sacred centre was Katori Jingū, the leading shrine of Shimōsa Province, dedicated to Futsunushi-no-Ōkami. Its high status connected the locality with a wider ritual geography that included Kashima and Ise. The shrine's traditional foundation date belongs to sacred legend, while surviving buildings offer more securely dated evidence of early modern patronage.

In 1700 Tokugawa Tsunayoshi, the fifth shogun, had the main hall constructed. The vermilion tower gate was built in the same year, giving the entrance and central sanctuary a shared architectural history. The main hall's dark appearance and cypress-bark roof contrasted with the bright gate through which worshippers approached. These works placed the resources and authority of the Tokugawa government behind an institution with much older religious standing. Katori's early modern character was consequently shaped by the renewal of its principal shrine: an established provincial sacred centre acquired buildings that expressed both continuity of worship and the patronage of the ruling house.
simp_chinese:
香取的宗教中心是祭祀经津主大神的香取神宫，也是下总国一之宫。神宫的崇高地位，将本地同鹿岛、伊势等更广阔的祭祀地理连接起来。其传统创建年代属于神圣传说，现存建筑则为近世的资助与营造提供了较明确的年代依据。

1700年，德川第五代将军纲吉营建本殿；朱红色楼门也建于同年，使入口与中心圣所拥有共同的建筑沿革。本殿深色外观与桧皮葺屋顶，同参拜者经过的鲜明楼门形成对照。这些工程将德川政权的资源和权威投入一处拥有悠久宗教地位的机构。香取的近世面貌因而受到神宫重建的深刻影响：既有的地方祭祀中心，通过新的殿宇延续礼拜传统，同时呈现统治家族的资助。

english:
The country later called Katō lay along the northern side of the Tokachi river system in eastern Hokkaido. Before the nineteenth-century districts were created, it formed part of the world of Ainu settlements and routes along the rivers. Earthworks known as chashi occupied prominent ground overlooking the water. The Tokachi region contains many such sites, including examples beside the Tokachi and Otofuke rivers.

Chashi were built during approximately the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries. Their defining features include ditches across or around a hilltop and, probably, wooden fencing. Their functions were varied and remain debated: traditions associate them with defence, watching, ceremony and negotiations to settle disputes. They should not all be treated as identical military castles. These river-facing sites show how Ainu communities organised important places within their own landscape. In 1800, Minagawa Shūdayū surveyed the Tokachi river system under official orders. This growing external interest preceded the later administrative divisions and mass agricultural settlement that transformed the country.
simp_chinese:
后来称作河东的地域，位于北海道东部十胜水系北侧。十九世纪设郡以前，这里属于阿伊努聚落及沿河道路组成的地域。称作查希的土筑设施占据临水高地，十胜地区保存众多此类遗址，十胜川、音更川沿岸都有分布。

查希大约建于十六至十八世纪，其特征是横截或环绕丘顶的壕沟，原来可能另有木栅。用途仍有不同解释，传统将其与防守、瞭望、祭仪及解决争端的谈判相联系，不能一概视为同样的军事城堡。这些面向河流的设施，体现阿伊努社群组织重要场所的方式。1800年，皆川周太夫奉命踏查十胜川水系。外来官府对本区的关注逐渐增加，而后来改变地域的行政划分与大规模农业移民尚未展开。

english: Shimo-michi lay along the western bank of the Takahashi River and its tributaries in Bitchū. Its old district contained early Buddhist temples, including the sites at Hatawara and Yata, whose roof tiles reflect the distinctive traditions of the Kibi region. In the Edo period, the Itō lords of Okada domain established their residence in the district, first at Kawabe and later at Okada. Their small domain held lands beyond Bitchū as well.
simp_chinese: 下道郡位于备中高梁川西岸及其支流流域。郡内有早期佛寺，包括秦原和箭田的寺址，出土瓦当反映了吉备地区独特的传统。江户时代，冈田藩伊东氏在郡内设立阵屋，最初位于川边，后来迁往冈田。这个小藩在备中之外也拥有领地。
